title: Green facilitation  - Chennai
company: LEAD Consultancy and Engineering Services (India) Pvt Ltd
description:
**Company Description**
LEAD Consultancy & Engineering Services (India) Pvt Ltd (LCES) is a Bengaluru-based firm founded by experienced professionals specializing in green building consultancy and integrated building design services. The company focuses on sustainable solutions covering mechanical (HVAC), electrical, public health engineering (PHE), and life safety systems. LCES provides green building facilitation and certification support under LEED (USGBC), IGBC, and GRIHA, along with energy modeling, lighting simulation, and building commissioning services. The team also delivers advanced design and analysis services including fire detection and protection systems, integrated building management systems, sun path analysis, and carbon advisory/CDM consultancy. Applicants can expect to work in a technically driven environment committed to high-performance, sustainable buildings.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Green Facilitation role based in Chennai. The role involves supporting green building certification processes (LEED, IGBC, GRIHA) by coordinating documentation, preparing submission packages, and liaising with project stakeholders. Daily tasks include collecting and analyzing project data, assisting with energy modeling and basic sustainability calculations, and collaborating with design teams on HVAC, electrical, PHE, and life safety strategies aligned with green building requirements. The person in this role will participate in client meetings, clarify rating system requirements, monitor project compliance with sustainability goals, and maintain organized records for audits and certifications. The role also includes preparing reports, presentations, and technical notes that communicate green building strategies to clients and internal teams.
  
**Qualifications**

* Knowledge of green building rating systems and facilitation, such as LEED (USGBC), IGBC, and GRIHA, and the ability to manage certification-related documentation and processes.
* Understanding of building services design concepts, particularly HVAC, electrical systems, public health engineering (PHE), and fire detection and protection strategies in the context of sustainable design.
* Familiarity with energy modeling, lighting simulation, and basic building performance analysis; exposure to software-based simulations and sun path analysis is an advantage.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and engineering data, and translate them into clear, structured documentation for clients and certification bodies.
* Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in calculations and reporting.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and engage professionally with clients.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, architecture, or a related field; additional training or credentials in sustainability or green building (e.g., LEED/IGBC/GRIHA accreditation) are preferred.
* Ability to work on-site in Chennai, manage multiple projects and deadlines,

title: Technical Support/SKIL Instructor
description:
**About NCR Atleos**
NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
  
  
Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor
  
  
**Role Description**
As a Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor, you are considered a subject matter expert in NCR Atleos ATM products and act as an advanced level remote support analyst and technical learning instructor. You are part of our support services and learning delivery teams, and your passion for providing exceptional customer service, technical guidance, and effective instruction contributes to our world-class high level of customer satisfaction and associate readiness.
  
  
Acting as second line support to NCR Atleos Field Service Technicians and as an instructor for assigned technical learning programs, you will communicate in an open, helpful, and engaging manner with your focus being finding the right solution for each Field Service Technician, learner, and customer. You connect with Field Service Technicians to address questions and resolve various problems, including uncommon or complex issues, knowing when and who to turn to for additional support. You also facilitate classroom, lab, virtual instructor-led, and online learning experiences that enhance technical capability and improve the overall effectiveness of the business unit/organization.
  
  
You will have a proactive approach and may handle problems before they start by identifying knowledge gaps, improving course content, creating knowledge articles, and feeding live field learning back into training materials and knowledge systems. No matter the situation, your formal training, technical expertise, available knowledge repositories, and adult learning techniques will allow you to provide Field Service Technicians and learners what they need when they need it. Additionally, you will always be on the lookout for preventative measures you can take, escalate issues appropriately, contribute to continuous improvement, and serve as an ambassador for the NCR Atleos brand.
  
  
Your goal is to keep our Field Service Technicians, learners, and customers completely assured and satisfied through your technical expertise, instructional capability, consistent communication, and commitment to quality support and effective learning delivery.
  
  
Position Summary & Key Areas of Responsibility
  
  
As a Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor, you will provide support to Field Service Engineers who will generally be onsite at a customer location and requiring technical assistance.
  
  
The support will include problem identification, analysis, diagnosis, and resolution.
  
  
You will utilize Knowledge Systems provided by NCR Atleos and other vendors as appropriate to identify solutions to known problems.
  
  
You are responsible for ensuring that solutions provided are successful, ensuring first time and long-term resolution of the problem.
  
  
If no known solution can be identified, you are responsible for escalation to other support groups where deeper level skilled personnel are available.
  
  
You retain ownership of escalated problems/issues through to resolution.
  
  
You are responsible for ensuring that NCR Atleos Management is informed if resolution to a problem will take longer than contractual requirements require.
  
  
You will provide input to the Knowledge Systems as and when required and create and publish knowledge articles when required.
  
  
You will coordinate with your peers, Management, Learning teams, and other support groups in providing part numbers, technical details, field learning, and product/process information to Field Service Technicians and learners.
  
  
You will act as a second line escalation point for junior colleagues and provide coaching, mentoring, and technical guidance where required.
  
  
You will facilitate course delivery using classroom, lab, VILT (virtual instructor-led training), online, and other approved methods of instruction.
  
  
You will execute course delivery according to the published training schedule.
  
  
You will maintain classroom facilities, training center, lab environment, training equipment, and learning materials necessary for the class.
  
  
You will work collaboratively with and around other team members in a Lab environment.
  
  
You will support course development by providing subject matter expertise for assigned products, technical procedures, and service processes.
  
  
You will perform course maintenance and identify required updates to course content using existing knowledge, field feedback, service trends, and analytical skills.
  
  
You will use a variety of delivery techniques, leveraging formal and informal delivery tools such as virtual classrooms, web conferencing, discussion forums, blogs, wikis, job aids, and short-form instructional videos where applicable.
  
  
You may serve as course owner for assigned instructor-led training courses.
  
  
You will develop or support performance support materials, including job aids, technical tips, procedural guides, and YouTube-style videos where applicable.
  
  
You will mentor new instructors and support knowledge transfer across technical support and learning teams.
  
  
You will manage day-to-day operations of the learning center where assigned, including keeping it clean, organized, and ready to support the best learning environment possible.
  
  
You will use continuous improvement processes and tools to improve Services Learning and Technical Support processes and increase the value-add provided to our customers.
  
  
You will deliver quality support and enhanced results meeting established KPI and Customer SLA requirements.
  
  
You will provide onsite and lab support for equipment as required.
  
  
You must be willing and able to work flexible schedules, which may include night and weekend shifts, and perform overtime work upon management request or business need.
  
  
You will perform travel as required, where applicable.
  
  
You must maintain a valid driver’s license where required for in-country teams or travel-related responsibilities.
  
  
You will comply with NCR Atleos policies which include but are not limited to:
  
  
The Company’s Shared Values and Code of Conduct.
  
  
Employee Health and Safety policy and standards.
  
  
Accurate timekeeping and records of hours worked.
  
  
Company Fleet policies and requirements, where applicable, which include but are not limited to NCR Atleos requirements for safe driving.
  
  
You will perform other corresponding duties and tasks in accordance with your qualifications, as directed by Employer.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
High School Diploma.
  
  
Prior work experience in a Customer Support or Technical Support role is required, with experience supporting customers in the Financial sector and/or Retail and Hospitality sector being a must where applicable.
  
  
3–5 years of experience working with, supporting, troubleshooting, or servicing technical equipment, heavy machinery, ATMs, retail technology, networking hardware, or similar technical environments; or an Associate Degree in a technical field or in education.
  
  
Experience servicing NCR Atleos supported equipment or equivalent technical platforms is required where applicable.
  
  
Must be authorized to work in the country where position is posted.
  
  
Must be a local candidate for in-country teams.
  
  
PC proficiency.
  
  
Proficiency with Windows-based applications/tools and MS Office products.
  
  
Good English communication skills and telephony etiquette; other languages may be required for certain teams.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  
  
Strong demonstrated public speaking, facilitation, or presentation skills.
  
  
Ability to listen and communicate effectively in a professional environment.
  
  
Analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Strong team player with the ability to work collaboratively in a matrix-managed organization.
  
  
Ability to explain technical concepts in clear and understandable terms to Field Service Technicians, learners, and other stakeholders.
  
  
Ability to work in an office environment either full time or on a hybrid work model where applicable.
  
  
Ability to work collaboratively in a lab environment and support onsite/lab-based technical learning and troubleshooting activities.
  
  
Willingness and ability to work flexible schedules, including shift hours, nights, weekends, and overtime as required by business need.
  
  
Must have the ability to carry and lift tool kits, training equipment, or parts of varying weights up to 50 lbs. where applicable.
  
  
Must be available to work in other training locations as needed, where applicable.
  
  
Must have a valid driver’s license where required for in-country teams or travel-related responsibilities.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor’s Degree in Education, IT, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  
  
Knowledge of Electrical Engineering.
  
  
Advanced understanding of Networking Technology.
  
  
Previous experience as a field-based Field Service Technician.
  
  
Previous experience in a Learning, Education, Technical Training, or Instructor role.
  
  
2–3 years teaching adult learners technical topics, including hands-on mechanical, hardware, electrical, or networking modules.
  
  
Knowledge of NCR Atleos products, services, tools, and processes.
  
  
Experience servicing ATMs, PCs, servers, networking hardware, or related customer service technology.
  
  
Experience with course ownership, course maintenance, instructor-led training, virtual instructor-led training, and learning center operations.
  
  
Proven ability to work independently, juggle multiple projects, and adapt to frequent change.
  
  
Ability to build rapport with internal and external customers.
  
  
Ability to self-manage while maintaining accountability for support quality, learning delivery, and operational readiness.
  
  
Ability to manage and maintain a training center or lab environment in a manner that is conducive to learning.
  
  
Proven ability to learn quickly and translate field experience into training materials, knowledge articles, and performance support content.
  
  
Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.

title: GRC Platform Delivery
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

1. Platform Administration and Operational Support

· Build a working knowledge of the GRC platform, including its modules, workflows, user permissions, and underlying data structures.

· Provide operational support for the platform across various global risk and compliance processes.

· Investigate user-reported issues, perform initial troubleshooting, and coordinate escalations to the relevant teams.

· Assist with user access management, role assignments, permission updates, periodic access reviews, and onboarding activities.

· Develop and maintain platform-related documentation, operating procedures, user manuals, and knowledge resources.

2. Business Requirements and Delivery Coordination

· Engage with business, risk, compliance, and technology stakeholders to understand business needs and gather functional requirements.

· Translate business requirements into structured documentation, including user stories, process maps, functional specifications, and configuration requirements.

· Review existing workflows and business processes to identify opportunities for simplification, automation, and operational improvement.

· Monitor project deliverables, timelines, dependencies, action items, and implementation progress.

· Assist in coordinating delivery activities and ensuring requirements are clearly documented and aligned with stakeholder expectations.

3. Testing and Release Management Support

· Prepare and maintain test scenarios, test scripts, test cases, and expected outcomes for platform enhancements and changes.

· Conduct Quality Assurance (QA) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to verify that system functionality meets defined business requirements.

· Record test outcomes, identify defects, document observations, and track issues through resolution.

· Coordinate defect remediation, regression testing, retesting, and validation activities with relevant stakeholders.

· Support release preparation, deployment coordination, and post-implementation checks to confirm that changes have been delivered successfully.

4. Jira, Confluence, and Knowledge Management

· Create, update, and manage Jira tickets to track requirements, platform enhancements, defects, testing activities, and delivery progress.

· Maintain visibility into project tasks, dependencies, outstanding issues, decisions, and action items throughout the delivery lifecycle.

· Organize and update Confluence pages containing project documentation, meeting records, test evidence, release details, process flows, and user instructions.

· Ensure project and operational documentation is accurate, consistently maintained, and easily accessible to relevant stakeholders.

title: Lead - Partner enablement
description:
**About Rocketlane**

Rocketlane is a fast-growing, category-defining SaaS company transforming customer onboarding and professional services automation. Our mission is simple: help B2B companies deliver a seamless, consistent, and efficient onboarding experience — reducing chaos and driving better customer outcomes.

Today, we’re a team of 200+ passionate builders creating a product that teams genuinely love to use. Backed by leading investors like 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners, we’ve raised over $105M to fuel our growth.

As Rocketlane scales into enterprise deals, new geographies, and an expanding partner ecosystem, the Professional Services (PS) team is at the forefront of this evolution. With growth, the cost of inconsistent onboarding and reactive enablement becomes more pronounced — and we’re no longer willing to accept that trade-off.

This role exists to change that.

If you’re excited about building a high-impact enablement function within a product-led PS organization that deeply values delivery quality, ownership, and customer experience — this is your opportunity.

**The Problem You're Solving**

Right now, a new Implementation Manager at Rocketlane learns on the job. There's no structured path, no certification, no single source of truth. Status decks exist in six versions. When a new product feature ships, the PS team finds out the same way customers do. Ongoing training? Mostly ad hoc.

You're the person who fixes all of that and then makes it impossible to go back to the old way.

**What This Role Actually Is**

You've run implementations. You've been in the room when things go sideways. You know what "good delivery" looks like because you've done it and you've probably thought "someone should write this down properly."

That someone is now you.

As Enablement Lead for Professional Services, you own three things end-to-end:

1. The learning path for every new PS hire From day one to first solo customer engagement - structured, sequenced, and certified. Not a folder of decks. An actual program.

2. Feature enablement, every release cycle You sit close to Product. When something ships, your team knows about it before the customer does - with a playbook, not a Slack message.

3. The PS collateral library One version of every template. One source of truth. Always current. You own it, you maintain it, you retire things that are stale.

This isn't a content coordination role. You're building a function from scratch and running it as a continuous program — complete with certifications, gamification, and a feedback loop that actually closes.

**What You'll Own?**

**New Hire Learning Path**

* Design and run a structured onboarding curriculum from "what is Rocketlane" to "ready to own a customer engagement"
* Build the certification program: assessments, scoring rubrics, pass criteria, refresh cycles
* Create role-specific tracks for IMs, Solution Architects, and partners, not one-size-fits-all
* Gamify progression so completion is a milestone, not a checkbox

**Feature Enablement (with PM)**

* Embed yourself in the product release cycle - beta reviews, early access, pre-launch prep
* Translate every significant release into: what changed, what to demo, what to watch out for, what to update in delivery
* Deliver live sessions and async content so the team is never caught flat-footed on a customer call
* Feed practitioner feedback back to Product, you're the voice of the field

**PS Collateral & Knowledge Base**

* Own the single source of truth for all PS templates: status decks, SteerCo decks, project plans, QBR frameworks, escalation playbooks
* Establish version control and content hygiene - one template, one owner, one place to find it
* Audit the library regularly; retire anything that misleads someone in the field
* Use AI tools to create, repurpose, and update content faster

**You're Right for This If...**

* You've spent 7+ years in SaaS delivery - implementations, onboarding, or CS and have personally owned enterprise customer engagements
* You've built or maintained enablement content before and know the difference between a deck and a learning experience
* You already use AI tools to do your job faster and you're curious about what's next
* You'd rather build the playbook yourself than write a brief about why one is needed
* You get energy from teaching others and from being in the field enough to know what's worth teaching
* You're comfortable presenting to a room of skeptical senior consultants and a customer SteerCo in the same week

**Bonus Points**

* You've enabled or certified an external partner / reseller network
* You have instructional design or structured curriculum experience
* You've worked in a high-growth SaaS environment where the product changes faster than the docs

**What You Won't Find Here**

* A role where you hand off content for someone else to deliver
* A team that's figured it all out - you're building the rails, not riding them
* A manager who needs to tell you what needs fixing

**The Stack You'll Work With**

Rocketlane · Notion · LMS · AI content tools · Close collaboration with Product, CS, and the Professional Services team

**Why join us?**

At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:

**Impact and ownership:**
You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.

**Work with the best:**
We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.

**Celebrate wins:**
Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.

**Learn and grow:**
We’re all about learning—we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and learn a lot about AI.

**Flexibility and balance:**
While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).

title: PMS Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – PMS ENGINEER**

**Role - Executive PMS Engineer**

Location - Chennai, Tamil Nadu (Work from Office)

**Shift: 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM**

**Job Summary**

The PMS Engineer is responsible for developing, maintaining, standardizing, and optimizing Planned Maintenance System (PMS) databases across the managed fleet. The role involves maintaining vessel machinery and equipment structures, maintenance job plans, spare parts, running-hour counters, and compliance-related maintenance requirements. The PMS Engineer will work closely with technical teams, vessel personnel, internal stakeholders, and software providers to ensure data accuracy, regulatory readiness, consistent fleet standards, and effective technical reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. PMS Database Management & Data Quality Assurance**

* Build, update, and maintain vessel equipment hierarchies using SFI coding and company-defined standards.
* Develop and maintain PMS databases for new vessel takeovers, existing fleet vessels, fleet acquisitions, and system migrations.
* Review machinery and equipment details, including maker, model, specifications, component relationships, and associated records.
* Configure and update maintenance job plans, including job descriptions, calendar-based and running-hour intervals, and work instructions.
* Incorporate maker-recommended jobs, company-standard maintenance jobs, compliance jobs, and spare parts into the PMS database.
* Validate PMS data against maker manuals, machinery particulars, equipment lists, drawings, and other technical documents.
* Identify and resolve missing, duplicate, incorrect, or inconsistent components, jobs, spare parts, and counters.
* Support data migration, reconciliation, and validation between PMS platforms while preserving available historical maintenance records.
* Maintain standardized naming conventions, data-entry protocols, version control, and records of database changes.

**2. Maintenance Optimization & Compliance Monitoring**

* Ensure PMS maintenance jobs are aligned with maker recommendations, company SMS requirements, applicable statutory requirements, and class survey schedules.
* Verify that safety-critical, compliance-critical, and business-sensitive equipment is correctly classified and mapped in the PMS.
* Monitor maintenance intervals, running-hour counters, overdue jobs, and other compliance-related parameters.
* Review PMS data and maintenance records to identify gaps that may affect inspections, audits, vetting, or vessel maintenance.
* Support corrective and preventive actions arising from PMS reviews, vessel inspections, audits, and vetting observations.
* Assist with PMS-related requirements under ISM, SIRE, CDI, and TMSA, including relevant maintenance-management and data-governance activities.

**3. Reporting, Data Analysis & Inventory Control**

* Prepare reports on PMS database status, data quality, overdue maintenance, compliance gaps, and implementation progress.
* Use Microsoft Excel formulas, lookup functions, data-cleaning techniques, PivotTables, conditional formatting, and charts to generate reports.
* Develop and maintain reusable Excel templates and dashboards for recurring PMS reporting requirements.
* Review spare-parts mapping and identify discrepancies between equipment records, PMS data, and available inventory information.
* Analyze PMS datasets to identify recurring errors, data inconsistencies, and opportunities to improve maintenance processes.
* Collaborate with BI and data teams to improve reporting, data integration, automation, and management visibility.

**4. Fleet PMS Support & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Provide PMS database support to vessel teams, Technical Superintendents, and shore-based technical departments.
* Coordinate with vessel personnel to obtain missing machinery particulars, maker manuals, equipment details, and maintenance information.
* Liaise with PMS software providers and internal IT or technical teams to resolve application issues, data discrepancies, and system enhancement requests.
* Track issues, action items, implementation timelines, and closure status to ensure timely resolution.
* Support consistent implementation of PMS standards across new takeovers and the existing fleet.
* Participate in PMS reviews, technical meetings, familiarization sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**5. Audit Readiness & PMS Governance**

* Support internal and external audits and inspections within the scope of PMS data, maintenance jobs, and maintenance records.
* Review PMS-related observations and assist in implementing corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain PMS data standards, audit trails, database documentation, and quality-control procedures.
* Support relevant TMSA Element 4 and 4A requirements relating to maintenance management, equipment reliability, and PMS data governance.
* Ensure assigned PMS action items are completed within agreed timelines and supporting records are maintained.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marine Engineering or an equivalent marine engineering qualification.
* Typically 3–5 years of relevant experience in marine engineering, preferably including sea-going experience and hands-on shore-based PMS database management.
* Experience in a ship management company, vessel operator, or maritime technical management environment is preferred.
* Practical understanding of marine machinery, maintenance practices, maker manuals, spare parts, and technical documentation.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including lookup functions, formulas, data cleaning, PivotTables, and charts.
* High attention to detail, good organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with shipboard and shore-based stakeholders.

**Technical Skills**

* Hands-on experience with maritime PMS applications such as ShipPalm, SmartPAL, ShipNet, AMOS, BASSnet, Danaos, or Sertica is an advantage.
* Knowledge of SFI coding, equipment hierarchies, component structures, maintenance job configuration, and spare-parts mapping.
* Ability to interpret machinery particulars, maker manuals, equipment specifications, and maintenance instructions.
* Experience with PMS data migration, data reconciliation, validation, and quality assurance.
* Knowledge of Power Query and Power BI or other reporting and visualization tools is desirable.

**Soft Skills & Core Competencies**

* Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate, standardized data.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to translate technical requirements into clear data structures and reports.
* Good time management, prioritization, and follow-up skills.
* Willingness to learn new PMS platforms, reporting tools, and automation solutions.

**Experience & Qualifications**

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marine Engineering or an equivalent marine engineering qualification.

Experience: 3–5 years of relevant experience, preferably combining sea-going exposure with shore-based PMS work in a ship management company or fleet operator.

**Alternative:**
Ex-seafarers and junior engineering officers seeking to transition ashore into technical data management may be considered, particularly where they demonstrate sound knowledge of marine machinery, maintenance practices, and strong data-handling skills.

**Key Performance Expectations**

* Accurate, standardized, and up-to-date PMS databases for assigned vessels.
* Timely completion of PMS database development, updates, and migration activities.
* Reduction in missing data, duplicate records, and maintenance-job mapping discrepancies.
* Reliable mapping and monitoring of critical equipment, maintenance jobs, counters, and spare parts.
* Timely resolution and tracking of PMS data issues and support requests.
* Improved reporting, compliance visibility, and audit readiness through consistent data quality and process improvement.

**Overall Role Objective**

To ensure that PMS databases across the fleet remain accurate, standardized, compliant, and operationally effective, supporting reliable vessel maintenance, regulatory readiness, and continuous improvement in technical fleet management.

title: Associate - Reporting Production Expert
description:
**Description**
**Job Title:**
Associate
  
  
**Department:**
Asset Management – Investment Operations
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
Reporting Production Analyst
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The Reporting Production Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day execution of regulatory transaction reporting obligations across EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II covering both EU and UK jurisdictions, and ASIC Rewrite. The role sits at the heart of the first line of defense for regulatory reporting, ensuring that all reportable transactions are submitted accurately, completely and on time to the relevant Trade Repositories and Approved Reporting Mechanisms across jurisdictions.
  
  
Reporting to the Regulatory Transaction Reporting team, the Production Analyst works as part of a team with interchangeable resources, each expected to operate across all four regulatory regimes and across both EU and UK jurisdictions where applicable. This versatility is essential to ensure business continuity, balance workload across the team, and provide a single, consistent operating standard regardless of the reporting regime. For SFTR and MiFID II, the Analyst is responsible for the hands-on day-to-day production of regulatory reporting. For EMIR and ASIC, which are delegated, the Analyst is responsible for the oversight and monitoring of the production performed by the service provider, ensuring reporting obligations are met.
  
  
The role combines hands-on production (SFTR, MiFID II), oversight of outsourced reporting performed (EMIR OTC, ASIC), oversight of delegated EMIR reporting on ETD performed by clearing brokers, exception remediation, accuracy controls, reconciliations, pairing & matching, and reporting to senior stakeholders. It requires strong attention to detail, an in-depth understanding of regulatory reporting mechanics across EU and UK regimes, and the ability to challenge and monitor an outsourced provider as effectively as performing the reporting directly.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* OVERSIGHT & MONITORING OF OUTSOURCED REPORTING EMIR EU, EMIR UK, ASIC

Perform daily oversight of the EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC reporting production carried out by 3rd party Service Provider (SP), ensuring completeness, accuracy and timeliness of all reporting to DTCC.
  
  
Monitor 3rd party SP daily production, submission status and exception handling, and challenge the provider where standards are not met.
  
  
Review and validate the controls performed 3rd party SP, ensuring they are operating effectively and evidenced.
  
  
Reconcile the internal trade population against the reports submitted by 3rd party SP to identify missing, duplicated or incorrectly reported transactions.
  
  
Track and escalate persistent issues, recurring exceptions or SLA breaches by 3rd party SP to RTR team.
  
  
Maintain documented evidence of the oversight performed, supporting second-line oversight and internal/external audit requirements.
  
  
Act as the point of contact for 3rd party SP on EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC production matters.
  
  

* DAILY TRADE AND TRANSACTION REPORTING ACROSS SFTR (EU AND UK), MIFID II (EU AND UK)

Execute daily production reporting, ensuring all reportable trades and transactions are submitted within the regulatory deadlines.
  
  
Monitor reporting platforms and intraday flows to ensure timely capture and submission of all reportable events.
  
  
Validate report content against source systems post submission.
  
  
Track submission status and ensure all reports reach a final accepted state by Trade Repository or ARM/APA.
  
  

* REJECTIONS AND EXCEPTIONS REMEDIATION

Investigate and remediate all rejections (NACKs) and exceptions raised by the reporting platforms and/or Trade Repository across EU and UK regimes.
  
  
Identify root causes (data quality, mapping, reference data, timing) and apply the appropriate corrective actions.
  
  
Make the necessary amendments and resubmit corrected reports within the regulatory timeframe applicable in each jurisdiction.
  
  
Maintain a clear audit trail of remediation activities for compliance and oversight review.
  
  

* DAILY AND MONTHLY RECONCILIATION

Perform daily reconciliation on SFTR, MIFID, across EU and UK scopes to identify missing, incorrect or duplicated reports, investigate breaks, and implement remediation actions to resolve reconciliation breaks.
  
  
For EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC, reconcile the internal data against 3rd party SP reported output as part of the oversight function.
  
  
Execute monthly reconciliations to validate the consistency between source data, and data submitted.
  
  
Document reconciliation results and escalate unresolved breaks to the Regulatory Transactions Reporting team with proposed resolution actions and timeline.
  
  

* OVERSIGHT OF DELEGATED EMIR REPORTING ON ETD SCOPE PERFORMED BY CLEARING BROKERS

Validate completeness, accuracy and timeliness of reports submitted by clearing brokers.
  
  
Engage directly with clearing brokers to investigate discrepancies, request amendments and ensure corrections are made within the regulatory timeframe.
  
  
Track and escalate persistent issues or recurring reporting failures to RTR team.
  
  
Maintain documented evidence of the oversight performed, supporting RTR oversight and internal/external audit requirements.
  
  

* PAIRING AND MATCHING

Investigate and resolve unpaired or unmatched transactions across EU and UK regimes, engaging directly with counterparties where required.
  
  
Manage UTIs processing in line with internal procedures.
  
  
Monitor and secure pairing and matching rates as a key indicator of reporting quality.
  
  

* REPORTING TO RTR TEAM

Prepare and share daily statistics and dashboards for all jurisdictions (EU and UK for EMIR/MIFID/SFTR and ASIC) covering reported volumes, pairing and matching rates, accepted volumes, rejection rates and remediated volumes.
  
  
Highlight emerging/faced issues, trends or risks to the RTR team in a timely and structured manner.
  
  

* CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT AND KNOWLEDGE SHARING

Identify ad escalate recurring issues.
  
  
Maintain up-to-date procedures, runbooks and knowledge base for all four regulatory regimes.
  
  
Cross-train and support fellow team members to maintain full interchangeability across the team.
  
  
Stay updated with regulatory requirements changes and contribute to impact assessments when changes are announced.
  
  
**Specific Qualifications**

* MANDATORY:

Minimum 2–3 years’ experience in regulatory transaction reporting within the financial services industry (asset management, sell-side).
  
  
Solid understanding of regulatory reporting mechanics: report submission lifecycles, ACK/NACK handling, UTI mechanics, pairing and matching, lifecycle events and action types.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of at least one of EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II or ASIC Rewrite and the ability/willingness to acquire expertise across all four.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to monitor and challenge an outsourced reporting provider, including reviewing their controls, reconciliations and SLA performance.
  
  
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, conditional logic) for reconciliation and reporting purposes.
  
  

* NICE TO HAVE:

Working knowledge of 2 regulatory regimes or more (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite).
  
  
Hands-on experience with platforms such as: Aladdin, TRAX (ARM/APA), Tri-Optima, DTCC, IHS Markit.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Versatility and ability to switch between regimes and reporting flows depending on workload.
  
  
Strong analytical and investigative skills, with ability to perform root-cause analysis on data quality issues.
  
  
Capability to translate reporting issues into clear messages for the RTR team and management.
  
  
Capability to produce presentations and KPIs representative of reporting quality and activities in scope.
  
  
Ability to support colleagues to achieve interchangeability, through documentation, knowledge sharing and active collaboration.
  
  
**Behavioral Skills**

* Active Listening
* Adaptability
* Ability to share/pass on knowledge
* Attention to detail

**Education Level:**
Bachelor’s degree or Equivalent
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai

title: Project Journey Resident Engineer
description:
**Description**
As the
**Resident Engineer – Automatic Transmission Launch & Localization**
, you will represent Product Development onsite at a new manufacturing facility producing automatic transmissions.
  
  
You will provide technical leadership throughout equipment commissioning, pre-production builds, production validation, launch, ramp-up, and ongoing production. You will also lead regional Product Development activities associated with localization of components and assemblies.
  
  
**The Position Combines Two Closely Related Areas Of Accountability**

* Resident engineering leadership for the transmission manufacturing operation.
* Regional Product Development leadership for component localization and implementation.

You will work closely with regional and global transmission engineering teams to ensure localized products, manufacturing changes, supplier proposals, validation activities, and production approvals meet applicable engineering, functional, durability, quality, and manufacturing requirements.
  
  
The role reports to the
**Product Development General Manager for Underbody Systems in Chennai**
, with a matrix reporting relationship to the
**Global Rear-Wheel-Drive Transmission Manager**
.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Serve as the onsite Product Development technical representative**

* Act as the primary Product Development interface between the transmission plant and regional and global engineering organizations.
* Represent Product Development in decisions related to product engineering, manufacturing feasibility, quality, production readiness, and launch.
* Interpret engineering drawings, specifications, design requirements, validation results, and product acceptance criteria.
* Connect plant concerns with the appropriate Product Development, Design and Release, systems engineering, manufacturing, quality, supplier, and vehicle engineering owners.
* Establish productive working relationships with plant leadership, engineers, manufacturing personnel, suppliers, and regional and global Product Development teams.

**Support plant launch and production readiness**

* Provide onsite engineering support during installation, commissioning, pre-production builds, production validation, launch, ramp-up, and ongoing production.
* Support applicable prototype, development, validation, tooling-trial, pre-production, and production builds.
* Coordinate engineering disposition of build concerns and ensure unresolved risks have defined owners, containment actions, and closure plans.
* Support transmission and component approval for regional vehicle builds and vehicle assembly plants.
* Lead or support Product Development reviews for Production Validation, part approval, production sign-off, and Ok-to-Ship decisions.
* Identify emerging product and manufacturing concerns early and escalate issues requiring regional or global engineering support.
* Capture launch lessons learned and support the transition to stable production.

**Lead technical problem solving**

* Lead Product Development response to transmission and component concerns identified at the plant.
* Determine whether concerns originate from product design, supplier quality, manufacturing processes, assembly execution, specifications, or interactions among these areas.
* Lead structured root-cause analysis using appropriate problem-solving methods and coordinate interim and permanent corrective actions.
* Review end-of-line test results, process audit data, component measurements, transmission build history, teardown findings, and other engineering evidence when assessing product acceptability.
* Support investigation of plant concerns, vehicle assembly plant concerns, field/warranty returns, and transmission teardowns.
* Ensure significant technical issues are documented, tracked, escalated, and driven to verified closure.

**Manage engineering changes and plant concerns**

* Initiate, review, approve or reject, track, and close engineering concerns within delegated authority.
* Coordinate implementation of engineering changes at the transmission plant and affected regional vehicle assembly plants.
* Ensure manufacturing teams understand each change's technical rationale, affected components, implementation timing, validation requirements, and production risks.
* Review supplier requests for engineering approval and coordinate Design and Release and systems engineering input.
* Review Manufacturing Risk Assessments within established engineering governance and delegated authority.
* Coordinate temporary engineering deviations with appropriate regional and global engineering owners.
* Monitor component availability, supplier readiness, implementation timing, production run-out plans, and trial results.
* Maintain a current record of open engineering concerns, changes, decisions, owners, due dates, risks, and closure evidence.

**Lead regional product localization**

* Demonstrated experience resolving complex technical problems in manufacturing, product launch, or product-development environments.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, product requirements, validation results, test data, and manufacturing data.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to engineering specialists and senior leaders.

* Ability to collaborate effectively with manufacturing employees, engineering specialists, suppliers, cross-functional teams, and leadership.
* Ability to work onsite at the transmission manufacturing facility and support launch or production activities outside normal business hours when necessary.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with regional and global teams across time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with or comparable longitudinal automatic transmissions, including transmission systems, mechanical components, controls, calibration, manufacturing, or validation.
* Experience launching a new powertrain manufacturing operation, automatic transmission line, or major localized automotive product.
* Experience with APQP, PPAP/PSW, DFMEA, DVP&R, root-cause analysis, production validation, and engineering change management.
* Experience working directly with automotive component suppliers during product localization or manufacturing launch.
* Experience using structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, 5-Why analysis, Ishikawa/fishbone analysis, or equivalent methods.

title: Specialist - BPM Process Optimisation
description:
Job Title: Specialist - BPM Process Optimisation
  
  
GCL:D2
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to turn rigorous process design into enterprise outcomes that unlock time for discovery and better serve patients? As a Specialist - BPM Process Optimisation based in Chennai, you will report to the Process Optimisation Director and support the end-to-end management and evolution of our BPM platform. This permanent role blends deep analytical thinking with clear, impactful communication across a diverse global collaborator community.
  
  
You will help shape our strategy and standards, strengthen governance, and build a thriving BPM community of practice that delivers consistent, high-quality models ready for automation and insight. Your work will enable faster, smarter decision-making across the business by connecting process clarity to measurable efficiency and effectiveness. How will you translate complex operations into simple, reusable assets that scale across the enterprise?
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* BPM Strategy and Framework: Co-develop the direction of our BPM approach; maintain methodologies, modeling standards, governance and guidelines so process assets are consistent, trusted and reusable.
* Platform Governance and Administration: Act as tool administrator; manage configurations, metadata and access; ensure data integrity; and communicate directly with software providers and internal technology teams to prioritize enhancements and resolve issues at pace.
* Process Modelling Excellence: Model and document end-to-end business processes using BPMN 2.0; guide strategic projects with high-quality process maps that drive efficiency, quality and compliance outcomes.
* Community Enablement and Training: Lead onboarding of new users to the BPM platform; deliver training and certification; run clinics and office hours to build capability and foster a collaborative, supportive community.
* Insight-Driven Optimisation: Analyse and redesign business processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness; identify daily work optimisation opportunities using AI and link process insights to automation, mining and continuous improvement.
* Agile Delivery and Ways of Working: Operate within Agile methodology; manage backlogs and status analyses; work virtually across time zones with strong time management, balancing multiple initiatives without losing momentum.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Solid understanding of process modelling techniques, tools, frameworks and standards
* Strong experience in at least one BPM platform (e.g. BIC, Bizagi, Aris, Signavio etc.)
* Ability to model and document end to end business processes using BPMN 2.0
* Capable of acting as tool administrator and performing requirement gatherings and status analyses
* Ability to communicate/articulate requests directly to software providers, alongside other internal technological teams
* Analysing and designing business processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness
* Ability to seek daily work activities optimisation with AI utilization
* Energetic and self-motivated
* Strong time management skills with ability to work at pace, handling multiple initiatives at one time
* Comfortable with working virtually in a global environment
* Proficiency in English
* Experience of working in Agile methodology

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience of various related BPM capabilities such Process/Task Mining, Robotics Process Automation, Low Code automation, BPM, workflow tools.
* Experience of working in Agile methodology
* Six Sigma or Lean Management Green Belt certified
* Experience in change management projects and process optimization initiatives

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here you will power a global enterprise by building the process foundation that lets teams run faster and achieve more for patients. You’ll collaborate in a connected community that prizes thoughtful challenge, quick decision-making and shared learning, working with modern platforms and data to drive real-world impact. We blend ambition with support, valuing kindness alongside high standards, and we trust our people to take ownership, take smart risks and see things through. Your contribution will be visible and meaningful—turning clear processes into the engine of innovation across the company.
  
  
**Call To Action**
If you are ready to scale a global BPM capability, elevate efficiency and enable teams to focus on what matters most, submit your application today.
  
  
**Date Posted**
23-Oct-2026
  
  
**Closing Date**
29-Oct-2026

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

title: Product Support Engineer
description: About the jobFounded in 2021, Complyance is a developer-first e-invoicing SaaS company. Through a single API, we help businesses connect their invoicing workflows and meet e-invoicing mandates across markets, including the UAE and Saudi Arabia’s ZATCA requirements, without rebuilding e-invoicing every time they enter a new market.After five years of bootstrapped investment in engineering, we recently raised US$1.5 million in pre-series funding to accelerate an already-operating platform serving enterprise customers. We support e-invoicing projects for brands including L’Occitane, Mothercare Malaysia, LC Waikiki and RedBus, alongside Abu Dhabi-based Tadweer Group. Behind those names are real integrations, busy finance teams and business workflows that need to keep moving.We connect ERP, billing and business systems with the tools to map invoice data, validate documents, submit invoices and track their status. Product work such as ERP Reconciliation, AI Reports and our AI Support Assistant shows the range of practical problems we are building for.Life at Complyance :We take initiative, write down what matters and share what we learn. We ask good questions, communicate uncertainty honestly and use feedback to improve.Ownership also means judgement: we protect customer information, respect tenant boundaries and use approved access. And Support and Core Engineering are complementary specialisms, not junior and senior tiers.The mission :Product Support Engineering at Complyance is not about forwarding queries or closing as many tickets as possible. It is about understanding why something isn’t working, helping the customer through it, and improving the product or tools behind the experience.You will build technical depth by investigating APIs, integrations and invoicing workflows alongside Core Product Engineering, and own the customer’s conversation through a verified resolution or an accepted handover. When you are not handling client issues, you will keep building, maintaining and enhancing our internal support bot.If you enjoy helping people and want writing code to remain part of your work, this role brings both together.Where you’ll leave your mark :• Get to the bottom of technical problems: Reproduce issues in a safe environment, test hypotheses and connect evidence across browser developer tools, APIs, logs and product behaviour. Learn to tell configuration issues, integration failures, product defects and expected behaviour apart.• Own the customer’s experience: Explain what you know in clear language, agree the next action and update, keep customers informed while engineering investigates, and verify the affected workflow before calling it restored.• Write code that makes support better: Write and debug diagnostic or reproduction scripts, regression tests and support-tool improvements, and, as your skills grow, contribute reviewed bug fixes.• Build and own our internal support bot: Turn recurring support needs into useful capabilities, fix defects, add tests and keep documentation current.• Work alongside Core Product Engineering: Bring clear evidence, useful reproduction steps and a specific technical request, while keeping the customer conversation.• Make the next case easier: Turn recurring patterns into better troubleshooting guides, diagnostics, automation and product feedback that help the next person.• Learn how e-invoicing works in practice: Build knowledge of supported-country workflows, customer integrations and document journeys, working with Product, Customer Success, delivery and the ERP/Integration role.The kind of builder we’re looking for :You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:• Have experience in product support, software engineering or API/integration troubleshooting, or are a fresher with strong foundations and learning potential.• Genuinely want to work in a customer-facing product support environment.• Like understanding how systems work, not simply following a script, and can break an unfamiliar problem into useful checks.• Have a working understanding of HTTP, JSON, APIs, authentication, client-server behaviour and databases, gained through study, projects, internships or employment.• Can write, debug and test small programs, read unfamiliar code, and use logs or queries to reason about a problem.• Can explain a technical issue clearly to technical and non-technical people, and keep others updated.• Take ownership after escalation, distinguish facts from assumptions, and ask for help before an unsafe action.• Research independently, respond well to feedback and show what you learned from one problem to the next.Prior Product Support experience is not required. A particular degree or previous e-invoicing specialisation is not required either. We care about your foundations, curiosity, communication and learning potential.Bonus points :• ERP/accounting integrations, webhooks and asynchronous systems.• MongoDB or SQL, and browser developer tools.• Customer-facing troubleshooting experience.• TypeScript/JavaScript, Bun, React/Next.js and automated testing.This is useful experience, not a checklist. Complyance workflows, country-specific product behaviour and our tools are learnable; we do not expect you to arrive knowing the whole stack.What growth and success look like :You will build product understanding, diagnostic depth, customer communication and engineering skills through coaching and practical work, with learning goals that reflect your starting point.Success means sound diagnosis, safe decisions, kept communication commitments, useful tools and verified customer progress, not ticket, fix, article or pull-request quotas.Why Complyance? • Competitive base salary. The range will be shared with shortlisted candidates.• Comprehensive benefits, including health insurance for you and your family and paid time off.• The chance to build for a category that is being shaped by regulation right now, across some of the fastest-moving e-invoicing markets in the world.• A lean, collaborative team where your work is visible and your decisions matter.How to applyApply on LinkedIn with your CV, or share the profile of someone you think is a strong fit.

title: ERP Implementation Executive
description:
**ERP Implementation Executive – BOS**

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About BOS**

**BOS is a next-generation Business Operating System designed to help companies manage and connect their operations across areas such as sales, procurement, inventory, manufacturing, finance, workforce management and other business functions.**

**BOS goes beyond traditional ERP software by adapting to the operational processes of each organisation rather than forcing every business into a rigid, predefined system.**

**We are currently implementing BOS with businesses across multiple industries and are looking for an ERP Implementation Executive to work directly with customers and our product and development teams.**

**About the Role**

**As an ERP Implementation Executive, you will help businesses successfully adopt and implement BOS.**

**This is not primarily a software development role. You will work closely with business owners, department heads and operational users to understand how their business works, configure BOS around their processes, coordinate data migration, train users, support testing and take departments through go-live.**

**You will act as the bridge between the customer and the BOS product/development team**
.

The role provides significant exposure to real business operations and is suited to someone who wants to develop a career in ERP implementation, business analysis and enterprise technology consulting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Meet customers, department heads and operational users to understand their existing business processes.
* Study how departments currently operate using ERP systems, Excel, documents and manual processes.
* Document business processes, requirements, approval flows, user roles and operational rules.
* Map existing customer processes to BOS and identify configuration or product requirements.
* Work with the BOS product and development teams to translate business requirements into system requirements.
* Configure customers, users, roles, permissions, departments, workflows and other implementation settings within BOS.
* Assist with collection, cleaning, validation and migration of master and transactional data.
* Coordinate implementation activities across departments such as Commercial, Procurement, Inventory, Manufacturing, Finance and HR/Workforce.
* Conduct product demonstrations and user training for department heads and end users.
* Prepare test scenarios and coordinate functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Record issues, gaps and enhancement requirements identified during implementation.
* Work with developers to verify that issues have been correctly resolved.
* Support customers during go-live and post-implementation stabilization.
* Monitor adoption after go-live and help users transition from their existing processes to BOS.
* Maintain implementation documentation, meeting notes, action items and implementation status.
* Visit customer offices and operational locations when required.

**What We Are Looking For**

**We are looking for someone who combines business understanding, communication skills and technology aptitude**
.

The ideal candidate should:

* Be comfortable speaking with business owners, managers and operational staff.
* Be curious about how businesses actually operate.
* Be able to understand a business process and translate it into a software workflow.
* Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Be organised and capable of following multiple implementation activities simultaneously.
* Be comfortable working with Excel and business data.
* Have good written and verbal communication skills.
* Be comfortable learning complex enterprise software.
* Be willing to visit customer locations and work closely with customers during implementations.
* Take ownership of problems rather than simply passing requirements between the customer and development team.

**Preferred Experience**

**Candidates with 1–4 years of experience**
in any of the following would be particularly suitable:

* ERP implementation
* ERP functional consulting
* Business analysis
* Software implementation
* Customer onboarding for enterprise software
* Manufacturing ERP
* Inventory or warehouse systems
* Procurement systems
* HRMS / payroll implementation
* Accounting or finance software implementation

Experience with systems such as
**SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, Zoho, Tally, ERPNext or similar ERP/business applications**
would be beneficial but is not mandatory.

Candidates who have worked inside manufacturing or other operational businesses and have strong systems knowledge may also be considered.

**Educational Background**

**Relevant qualifications may include:**

* B.Com / M.Com
* BBA / MBA
* BCA / MCA
* BE / B.Tech
* Information Systems
* Operations / Supply Chain
* Finance / Accounting
* or another relevant discipline

We value practical ability and willingness to learn more than a specific degree.

**Skills That Will Be Valuable**

* ERP implementation
* Business process mapping
* Requirements gathering
* Functional documentation
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Data migration
* Microsoft Excel
* User training
* Customer communication
* Project coordination
* SQL knowledge – advantageous but not required
* Understanding of APIs/integrations – advantageous but not required
* Understanding of AI and modern business software – advantageous

**Why Join BOS?**

**BOS is being built as an alternative to the traditional approach to enterprise software.**

**Rather than joining an organisation where you repeatedly implement the same predefined ERP modules, you will have the opportunity to understand different businesses and help shape how their operations are represented within a new generation of business software.**

**You will work closely with the BOS leadership, product and engineering teams and gain exposure to:**

* Enterprise software implementation
* Business process design
* Manufacturing and operational businesses
* Product development
* Business analysis
* AI-enabled enterprise software
* Customer consulting
* Implementation project management

As BOS grows, this role can develop into
**Implementation Consultant, Senior Implementation Consultant, Implementation Manager and Implementation/Operations leadership roles**
.

title: Product Technical Engineer
Subject Matter Expert (SME) / Technical Consultant – Lithium-Ion Battery Effluent Treatment
description:
**JOB PURPOSE**

The Subject Matter Expert (SME) will provide specialized technical guidance for the Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) being executed for a large-scale Lithium-Ion Battery Manufacturing Facility. The consultant will support process review, technology validation, optimization of treatment schemes, commissioning support, troubleshooting, and customer engagement activities with a focus on battery manufacturing wastewater and NMP-containing streams.

The role will ensure that the proposed treatment systems meet performance guarantees, regulatory requirements, operational reliability standards, and project objectives.

***KEY RESPONSIBILITIES***

**Process & Design Review**

Review Process Design Basis, Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), P&IDs, mass balances, and engineering documents.

Validate process selection and treatment philosophy for battery manufacturing effluent streams.

Recommend process optimization, risk mitigation, and performance improvement measures.

Review equipment sizing, hydraulic loading, oxidation systems, biological treatment, sludge management, and tertiary treatment systems.

Support design validation of NMP wastewater treatment and advanced oxidation systems.

**Technical Advisory**

Provide technical guidance during detailed engineering, construction, commissioning, and plant stabilization.

Evaluate complex wastewater characteristics and recommend suitable treatment strategies.

Develop troubleshooting procedures and corrective action plans for critical process upsets.

Optimize treatment processes to achieve treated water quality standards and operational efficiency.

**Commissioning Support**

Provide pre-commissioning and commissioning support.

Review commissioning procedures and startup plans.

Analyze operational performance data and recommend process adjustments.

Support achievement of performance guarantees during trial runs and plant stabilization.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

Participate in technical discussions with Reliance and other project stakeholders.

Present technical evaluations, recommendations, and performance improvement initiatives.

Resolve customer technical concerns and process-related queries.

Represent WABAG as the Subject Matter Expert during key project reviews.

**Knowledge Transfer**

Conduct technical workshops and training programs for engineering, commissioning, and operations teams.

Develop process manuals, troubleshooting guides, and operational recommendations.

Share industry best practices in battery manufacturing and advanced wastewater treatment.

**DESIRED CHARACTERISTICS**

Strong expertise in Lithium-Ion Battery Manufacturing wastewater treatment.

Practical experience in NMP Oxidation Process and treatment technologies.

Proven experience with Advanced Oxidation Processes (AOP), UV/H₂O₂, Fenton, Chemical Oxidation, and related systems.

Strong understanding of industrial wastewater characterization and treatability studies.

Experience in pilot plant evaluation, process optimization, and technology commercialization.

Ability to provide practical, site-oriented solutions during commissioning and operations.

Strong customer-facing communication and presentation skills.

Experience in EPC and industrial wastewater projects is preferred.

**COMPETENCY – TECHNICAL**

Lithium-Ion Battery Industry Effluent Treatment.

NMP Recovery and Oxidation Processes.

Industrial Wastewater Treatment Technologies.

Advanced Oxidation Processes (AOP).

Chemical Treatment Systems.

Biological Treatment Processes.

Process Design Review.

PFD & P&ID Evaluation.

Treatability Studies.

Process Troubleshooting.

Commissioning & Startup Support.

Water Reuse & Resource Recovery.

Performance Testing & Optimization.

Environmental Compliance.

COMPETENCY – GENERAL

Strategic Thinking.

Technical Leadership.

Stakeholder Management.

Customer Orientation.

Communication & Presentation Skills.

Problem Solving.

Decision Making.

Collaboration & Teamwork.

Project Execution Excellence.

description:

MAKO IT LAB

We are looking for a customer-focused and technically capable
**Implementation Engineer**
to join our SaaS Implementation team.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for understanding customer requirements, designing practical solutions, configuring SaaS platforms, and delivering successful implementations.

.

* 2–5 years of experience in SaaS implementation, technical implementation, or solution consulting.
* Hands-on experience with SaaS product configuration and customer onboarding.
* Basic Python programming knowledge is mandatory, including scripting, data manipulation, and API interactions.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and Postman.
* Familiarity with AI technologies and tools is mandatory, including practical exposure to generative AI or AI-assisted development.

* Good verbal and written English communication skills.

* Willingness to work from the Chennai office during the 4:00 PM – 1:00 AM IST shift.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with CRM, PSA, project management, or customer onboarding platforms.
* Exposure to Salesforce, Zoho, HubSpot, Monday.com, or similar SaaS products.

* Experience with Workato, Zapier, Make, or similar integration platforms.
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor.
* Understanding of LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and AI workflow automation.
* Experience working with US-based customers.

What We Expect
  
  

* Strong ownership of customer implementations from discovery to go-live.
* A solution-oriented mindset rather than a task-execution approach.
* Ability to combine business understanding with technical capabilities.
* Willingness to continuously learn new SaaS products, Python, AI technologies, and automation tools.

Communication Solution Consulting Customer Onboarding ETL Basics Process Improvement Quick learner SaaS Implementation

title: Technical Consultant - ERP
description:
**Job Description**
The
**Technical Consultant - ERP**
is responsible for the analysis, design, configuration, implementation, and ongoing support of the company’s on-premise SAP HR/Payroll environment. This role will serve as a subject matter expert for SAP HR/Payroll configuration and processing. This role will collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and other technology partners to define solutions that meet business requirements and organizational objectives.
  
The SAP HR/Payroll Architect will also provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to other team members while ensuring solutions are aligned with established development, change management, security, and support processes.
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement and/or support on-premise SAP HR/Payroll ECC 6 EHP8 in a manufacturing environment.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for SAP Payroll with experience in Personnel Administration, Organizational Management, and Benefits configuration.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective SAP HR/Payroll designs and configuration solutions.
* Develop alternative solutions, evaluate options, and present recommendations to business stakeholders and IT management.
* Configure, test, implement, and support SAP HR/Payroll changes within a formal System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and change management methodology.
* Provide ongoing production support, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex SAP HR/Payroll issues.
* Implement, maintain, support, and troubleshoot the Rsite Tax Engine , including coordination with Rimini Street and the application, testing, and validation of tax updates and releases.
* Manage the impact of Rsite Tax Engine updates on SAP Payroll, including payroll configuration, tax calculations, testing, regression testing, and production implementation.
* Partner with Rimini Street and other vendors to investigate and resolve tax engine, payroll, and integration-related issues.
* Support payroll tax compliance activities by ensuring applicable federal, state, and local tax updates are appropriately tested and implemented in the Rsite Tax Engine/SAP Payroll environment.
* Understand and manage integration touchpoints between SAP HR/Payroll, Rsite Tax Engine, SuccessFactors, Kronos Workforce Management, and other downstream or upstream applications.
* Implement and support SaaS solutions and their integrations with SAP HR/Payroll.
* Manage, prioritize, and complete support requests for a large and complex organization.
* Estimate and plan work effort for projects, enhancements, upgrades, tax updates, and production support activities.
* Independently perform technical, configuration, testing, documentation, and process-related activities.
* Develop and maintain appropriate system documentation, configuration documentation, test scripts, and support procedures.
* Work collaboratively across HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendor teams with a focus on overall business success.
* Build strong relationships and trust with business users, IT stakeholders, vendors, and management.
* Provide knowledge transfer and training to team members and end users as appropriate.
* Effectively manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced, and constantly changing environment.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5–8 years of hands-on SAP HR/Payroll experience, including configuration and production support.
* Strong technical and functional knowledge of SAP HR/Payroll ECC 6.
* Strong experience with SAP Payroll including experience with Personnel Administration, , Benefits configuration, and Financial Postings.
* Demonstrated experience supporting payroll tax processing and tax-related configuration.
* Hands-on experience with Rimini Street Rsite Tax Engine, including implementation, configuration/support, testing, and application of tax updates. Other tax engine experience will be considered.
* Experience working with Rimini Street and coordinating the implementation and testing of vendor-provided tax and payroll updates is a plus.
* Understanding of integrations between SAP HR/Payroll and external HR, payroll, tax, and other applications.
* Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience working within a formal SDLC/change management process, including requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, implementation, and documentation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with end users, IT staff, business stakeholders, and management.
* Excellent communication, documentation, collaboration, and knowledge-transfer skills.
* Proactive self-starter with the ability to learn new technologies and business processes and utilize available resources effectively.
* Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a complex, fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SAP SuccessFactors.
* Experience with Kronos Workforce Management version 8 or higher.
* Experience with Rsite, BSI TaxFactory/TUBs, and/or other SAP payroll tax solutions.
* Experience with SaaS HR/payroll solutions and enterprise application integrations.
* Experience coordinating with third-party application and managed-service providers.
* Experience with payroll tax compliance, year-end processing, and tax update testing.
* Experience leading SAP HR/Payroll projects, enhancements, or major production initiatives.
