title: Robotic Engineer - Internship
description:
Internship Opportunity – Robotics Design & Development Engineer

**Company:**
AerX Space Labs

**Division:**
Robotics, Autonomous Systems & AI

**Position:**
Robotics Design & Development Intern

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Internship Duration:**
3–6 Months

**Eligibility:**
Engineering students, final-year students and recent graduates

**Internship Type:**
Full-time / Project-based

About AerX Space Labs

AerX Space Labs is focused on developing next-generation intelligent robotic and autonomous systems, including aerial drones, quadruped robotic dogs, autonomous ground robots and underwater robotic platforms.

We are looking for
**highly motivated, technically capable and hands-on robotics interns**
who can quickly contribute to the design, development, assembly, programming and testing of real-world robotic systems.

This opportunity is intended for students who have already built robotics projects and are passionate about transforming engineering concepts into functional prototypes.

Key Responsibilities
  
1. Robotics Design & Mechanical Development

* Design robotic structures, chassis, joints, mounting systems and mechanical assemblies.
* Develop 3D CAD models using SolidWorks, Fusion 360, CATIA or equivalent tools.
* Support mechanical design for quadruped robots, autonomous ground vehicles and robotic mechanisms.
* Select motors, actuators, gearboxes, bearings and mechanical components.
* Support 3D printing, fabrication, prototype assembly and mechanical testing.

2. Electronics & Embedded Systems

* Select and integrate microcontrollers, sensors, motor drivers and communication modules.
* Work with Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi or NVIDIA Jetson platforms.
* Integrate servo motors, BLDC motors, encoders, IMUs, LiDAR and cameras.
* Assist with power distribution, battery management and electronic troubleshooting.
* Develop and test embedded control systems.

3. Robotics Programming & Autonomous Navigation

* Develop robotic control software using Python and C/C++.
* Work with ROS/ROS 2 for robotic communication, control and navigation.
* Implement motion control, locomotion, obstacle avoidance and path planning.
* Support SLAM, sensor fusion and autonomous navigation.
* Integrate real-time sensor data with robotic control systems.

4. AI & Computer Vision Integration

* Integrate cameras and AI vision systems into robotic platforms.
* Support object detection, human detection, obstacle recognition and intelligent surveillance applications.
* Work with OpenCV, PyTorch, TensorFlow or YOLO-based detection systems.
* Assist with deploying AI models on edge computing devices.
* Support integration with Mirador AI for intelligent perimeter surveillance and automated alerts.

5. Prototype Assembly & Testing

* Assemble complete robotic prototypes from mechanical and electronic components.
* Perform hardware and software integration.
* Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical and programming issues.
* Conduct controlled indoor and outdoor testing.
* Document engineering designs, test results, component specifications and improvements.

Required Qualifications

Students pursuing or recently completing:

* B.E./B.Tech – Robotics & Automation
* Mechatronics Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Electrical & Electronics Engineering
* Computer Science / Artificial Intelligence

Students from other disciplines with demonstrated robotics project experience are also welcome.

Essential Skills

Candidates should have practical experience in
**at least two**
of the following areas:

* Mechanical design and CAD modelling
* Robotics hardware assembly and fabrication
* Embedded systems and motor control
* Python, C/C++ or ROS 2
* Sensors, actuators and electronic integration
* Autonomous navigation or computer vision

Preferred Experience

Preference will be given to candidates who have:

* Built a working robotic prototype independently or as part of a team.
* Participated in robotics competitions, hackathons or university robotics clubs.
* Developed quadruped robots, robotic arms, mobile robots, drones or autonomous vehicles.
* Worked with 3D printing, electronics prototyping and hardware debugging.
* Published robotics projects on GitHub or maintained technical project portfolios.

**Previous commercial work experience is not mandatory. Demonstrated practical capability is more important than academic grades alone.**

What We Expect

We are specifically looking for interns who are:

* **Hands-on builders**
  , not just theoretical learners.
* Capable of understanding an engineering requirement and quickly developing a functional prototype.
* Comfortable assembling, programming, testing and troubleshooting hardware.
* Able to work independently while collaborating with mechanical, electronics and AI teams.
* Interested in contributing directly to real product development.
* Disciplined about engineering documentation, safe testing and meeting project milestones.

Selection Process

**Stage 1 – Project Portfolio Review**

Candidates must submit photographs, videos, GitHub repositories or technical descriptions of robotics projects they have personally developed.

**Stage 2 – Technical Interview**

Assessment of mechanical design, electronics, embedded systems, robotics programming and troubleshooting skills.

**Stage 3 – Practical Engineering Assessment**

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small, time-bound robotics design or programming task using accessible tools and equipment.

**Stage 4 – Final Selection**

Selection based on technical capability, practical experience, problem-solving skills and readiness to contribute to active projects.

Internship Benefits

* Work on real-world robotics and autonomous systems.
* Hands-on exposure to mechanical design, electronics, AI and robotic software development.
* Opportunity to contribute to the development of AerX robotic products.
* Technical mentoring and collaborative engineering experience.
* Internship completion certificate based on successful participation.
* Potential consideration for full-time engineering opportunities based on performance and business requirements.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit:

1. Updated resume.
2. Details of robotics projects completed.
3. Photographs or videos demonstrating working prototypes.
4. GitHub, CAD portfolio or other relevant technical work.
5. Availability and preferred internship duration.

**Email:**
hr@miradortechnologies.ai

**Subject:**
Application – Robotics Design & Development Internship – AerX Space Labs

**AerX Space Labs**

*Design. Build. Program. Innovate.*

**We are looking for students who don't just study robotics — they build robots.**

Product Support
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**Role Definition**
Provides first line of support, coordination of services, problem resolution and/or recommendations on selected products and services.
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Addressing minor coverage issues and resolving minor complaints. Ensuring all customer communication is clearly documented.
* Answering inbound customer service inquiries. Providing health analysis or troubleshooting and redirecting them when appropriate.
* Identifying issues and determining appropriate course of action for effective resolution.
* Processing results from analysis of technical data
* Understand prime product or component health or status, if action is needed, and required next steps.

**Skill Descriptors**
**Customer Focus:**
Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Communicates the importance of customer needs/expectations and commits to resolving them.
* Researches and verifies customer needs and expectations.
* Solicits customer satisfaction feedback and acts on improvement opportunities.
* Helps link organizational objectives to customer needs and expectations.
* Meets regularly with customers to understand their wants, needs and expectations.

**Data Gathering & Analysis:**
Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Follows proper data gathering and analysis processes and policies.
* Reports problems that arise in the data collection process.
* Participates in gathering and analyzing an organization's data based on requirements.
* Documents data from various sources and in various formats.
* Utilizes basic data collection and evaluation tools and techniques.

**Service Excellence:**
Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Provides a quality of service that customers describe as excellent.
* Resolves common customer problems.
* Responds to unexpected customer requests with a sense of urgency and positive action.
* Provides direct service to internal or external customers.
* Documents customer complaints in a timely manner.

**Consulting:**
Knowledge of techniques, roles, and responsibilities in providing technical or business guidance to clients, both internal and external; ability to apply consulting knowledge appropriately.
  
  
**Level Basic Understanding:**

* Explains the roles and responsibilities of a consultant.
* Lists the typical phases of a consulting assignment or project.
* Presents a professional image, especially when dealing with customers.
* Describes the consulting process and relationship with clients.

**Decision Making and Critical Thinking:**
Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
  
  
**Level Basic Understanding:**

* Explains characteristics and steps in an effective decision-making process.
* Identifies issues and communicates with others when a decision needs to be made.
* Names decision makers in own environment and cites examples of past decisions.
* Describes types of decisions incumbent may and may not make in own job or function.

**Effective Communications:**
Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
* Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
* Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
* Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
* Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

**Problem Solving:**
Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

**Relationship Management:**
Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Provides prompt and effective responses to client requests and interactions.
* Monitors client satisfaction levels on a regular basis.
* Alerts own team to problems in client satisfaction.
* Differentiates the roles and responsibilities in a business relationship.
* Works with clients to address critical issues and resolve major problems.

This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization. It is expressly not intended to be a comprehensive list of “essential job functions” as that term is defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act.
  
  
****Posting Dates:****
October 22, 2026 - November 29, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Oracle Cloud PPM - Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Enterprise Performance**
Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level: Oracle Cloud PPM -**
**Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation**
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work You’ll Do**
As an Oracle Senior Consultant, you will be involved in the implementation of Oracle Projects processes. Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Developing programs across all RICEFW components and process areas, ensuring high-quality deliverables in line with our CMMI-certified standards.
* Reviewing functional specifications, preparing technical documentation, translating requirements into efficient code, and performing thorough technical unit testing.
* Maintaining comprehensive documentation throughout the build phase and actively participating in review processes, including self and peer reviews.
* Capturing minutes of meetings (MOM) during technical reviews.
* Actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.

**The Team**
Deloitte’s Oracle Enterprise Solutions practice provides services from ERP and Cloud Strategy, through Business Transformation and Applications Implementation, to Operate and Cloud Release Management. We modernize our client’s business and core environments to leverage technology innovations around Cloud, Digital, Mobility, and Social Collaboration. Our team helps clients address digital transformation by designing modern applications and industry-specific solutions to deliver outcomes that improve flexibility, scalability, and cost management.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 6 to 10 years of experience in the implementation of Oracle Projects processes.
* Well-versed with Oracle modules of Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Management, Project Contracts, Project Resource Management, Grants Accounting.
* Professional with at least 2 end-to-end implementations.
* Good working knowledge of modules interacting with Oracle projects like Payables, Fixed Assets, Receivables, Time & Labor.
* Demonstrated experience as a senior resource assisting in the definition of systems strategy, gathering and documenting business requirements, leading fit-gap analysis, as-is and to-be business process designs, conference room pilots (CRPs), functional configuration, testing, client user training.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, including presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint).
* A Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, or Accounting.

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Well-versed with Microsoft Project plan or equivalent.

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from an accredited university.

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. title: Design Release Engineer - BIW
description:
BIW : Pune (3 - UGNX) Chennai ( 1- CATIA)
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* To participate in the Program development right from the Pre –Development to Handing over of relevant systems/components for the completeness of the product and for the launch, with focus on Quality, Cost and Delivery targets
* To ensure (supported by the specialist Functions) the technical feasibility, design robustness, component manufacturability and the compliance of technical documentation, through the coordination of engineering (if necessary) and product suppliers.
* To point out the critical issues or any infringements of Design/Test Standards and identify the actions needed to respect the assigned targets
* To ensure the completeness/availability of all documents necessary for sourcing start-up (Sourcing Package) and to keep them up to date and consistent with sourcing closing.
* Conduct Supplier Technical Reviews and evaluation to support Purchase decisions
* To ensure the completeness/availability of all documents necessary for tooling release.
* To carry out / to ensure, with the help of specialist Functions, the diagnostic activities on the relevant systems/components.
* Ensure availability of Parts and Systems for the various builds viz., Pre-build, OTOP build, Pre-Launch and Launch/SOP, at right quality and time, by working with cross functional teams
* Provide engineering support in problem solving activities at the assembly plant from pilot phase through launch / post launch
* To work with Project Responsible and Test Plan Manager of each test departments, to finalise the technical validation plan of the systems assigned, by reducing the test loops.
* Review with PR, the test results and carryout issue resolution according to the model time line.
* To provide engineering support in problem solving activities at the assembly plant from pilot phase through launch

**Qualifications**
Education: B.E. / B. Tech. / M. E / M. Tech – Mechanical / Automotive / Electrical engineering
  
  
**Essential Skills**
Task / Deliverables
  
  

* Supported by the Engineering Functions and the SSTL, depending on the specific area of application can be responsible:
* To manage Project deliverables within his/her area.
* To manage codesign Suppliers Project deliverables within his/her area, supported by the Engineering Functions and the SSTL, responsible for Quality convergence process (e.g., APQP grid).
* To ensure the correct and efficient information flow and reporting during the project development phase to SSTL.
* To participate to any hand-over phase, if present, and to the definition with Engineering functions for relevant components/systems, technical solutions and corresponding performance, timing and cost targets (using the appropriate systems).
* To ensure the completeness/availability of all engineering documents necessary for sourcing (Sourcing Packages) on time to support Project deliverables.
* To ensure the technical feasibility, the design robustness, the component manufacturability and the compliance of technical documentation, through the coordination of engineering (if necessary) and product suppliers.
* To point out the critical issues or any infringements of Design/Test Standards and identify the actions needed to respect the assigned targets.
* To manage the design FMEAs execution performing the risk assessment and to provide support during process FMEAs execution.

To make available the documentation necessary to implement technical modifications (e.g. ODMs/CCD/CNs/ECR), to request their economic evaluations, to support the SSTL during the approval phase and to guarantee the associated drawings release. To monitor, through the accountable departments, their application in production according to the time schedule and procedures provided.
  
  

* To ensure the completeness/availability of all documents necessary for tooling release (TKO) and software release and validation
* To ensure the release of the product structure for Mules (and PWB plywood buck if requested) ensuring the Part Delivery
* To carry out/to ensure the diagnostic activities on the relevant systems/components and to provide engineering support in problem solving activities at the assembly plant (PER/VLO etc.) from pilot phase through launch, when requested.
* Own technical validation plans for ED (Engineering Design), DV (Design Validation) and PV (Process Validation) testing, ensuring they are completed on time, resolving, and escalating non compliances and providing info to PMO support team.
* In case of a maintenance model assignment, all the above-mentioned activities will be aimed to manage life cycle upgrades (i.e. MCA, Facelift), cost reductions and quality improvement

**Essential Skills**
**Desired skills**

* Vendor Development
* Supply Chain Management
* Sheet metal and Plastics/Hardware part development
* Die Process and Die Tryouts
* Panel Defect Identification / Correction
* Knowledge on manufacturing process at Body shop, paint shop & general assembly
* Knowledge on PFMEA / DV /PV Testing/PPAP

**Desirable**

* Knowledge in Die design / Mould design
* Knowledge in GD&T, exposure to Vehicle Testing, Homologation, Virtual Testing, Materials
* Sheet metal, Sealings Product design.
* Sheet metal press, Stamping, hemming, Sealing, Modules development.
* CFT convergence.
* Ability to lead the BIW domain for complete vehicle program from Concept to Launch
* OEM experience
* Homologation & Regulation compliance
* Problem solving experience.
* Team oriented, self-starter with demonstrated problem solving skills

**Experience**
6 to 8 years of relevant experience with CAD design experience – UG NX / CATIA.

title: Electronics Engineering Intern
description:
⚡ WE ARE HIRING: Electronics Hardware & Firmware Intern (Telemetry Systems) ⚡

Are you a weekend tinkerer who loves bringing hardware to life? Do you want to build a real IoT product from scratch and see it deployed in the field?

At Bridge Green Upcycle, we build second-life Li-ion battery packs for stationary energy storage. We are looking for a hands-on Intern to design, build, and deploy our next-generation proprietary telemetry unit from the ground up.

High performers have a genuine path to a full-time role! 🚀

📍 Location: Marai Malai Nagar, Chennai (On-site)

⏳ Duration: 3–6 months

📅 Start Date: Immediate

🆔 Job ID: JDI-011

💡 What You’ll Do:

• Design a telemetry PCB from scratch (Schematic, component selection, layout for MCU, sensors, and cellular modules).

• Write embedded firmware (C/C++) for data acquisition, ADC sampling, and interrupts.

• Implement MQTT-based data publishing over cellular networks to log voltage, current, temperature, and SoC data.

• Bench-test and field-test your prototype boards using oscilloscopes and multimeters.

• Own the product lifecycle from a blank page to a field-deployed unit.

🎓 What We’re Looking For:

• 3rd/4th-year students or recent graduates in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, or related fields.

• Working knowledge of MCUs (ESP32, STM32, Atmel) and embedded C/C++.

• Exposure to PCB design tools (like KiCad) and basic sensors/protocols (I2C, SPI, UART).

• Familiarity with cellular modules (SIM800/900) & MQTT is a huge plus!

• Passion for hardware—someone who builds things outside of university lab hours.

🎁 What’s In It For You?

• Direct mentorship from senior engineering leaders with automotive/battery R&D backgrounds.

• Total ownership of a real-world product to supercharge your portfolio.

• Exposure to the fast-growing second-life energy storage and battery telemetry industry.

📩 How to Apply:

Ready to build? Send your CV and a link to your GitHub or project portfolio showcasing your prior hardware/firmware work to:

📧 info@bridgegreenupcycle.com

#Hiring #HardwareEngineering #EmbeddedSystems #IoT #PCBDesign #KiCad #Firmware #ChennaiJobs #ElectronicsInternship #GreenTech #EnergyStorage

title: PDP- Automation Senior Engineer
description:
**Requisition ID: 300537**

* Relocation Authorized: None

**Extraordinary Teams Building Inspiring Projects**
Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place.
  
  
Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. We serve the Infrastructure; Nuclear, Security & Environmental; Energy; Mining & Metals, and the Manufacturing and Technology markets. Our services span from initial planning and investment, through start-up and operations.
  
  
Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments. They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report.
  
  
Bechtel’s India offices support the execution of projects and services around the world. Working seamlessly with Bechtel’s global business units, project sites, customers, and suppliers, our teams have delivered more than 125 projects since 1994. With offices in Gurgaon, Vadodara, and Chennai there are exciting career opportunities for candidates who are passionate about delivering projects that make a lasting, meaningful difference for people and communities around the world.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Automation Support role is core of Bechtel's Engineering design and delivery of Project’s completed deliverables. The candidate will be responsible to develop / deploy work-processes and ensure compliance with 3D CAD related guidelines on Project as per client and or Bechtel requirement. Responsibilities will include verifying Project set-up, coordinating customization as per project requirements, provide user support etc. Person should have knowledge of Engineering work-processes, CAD tools like S3D, drawings & reports needed on Project, knowledge of CAD tools like Smart Sketch/ MicroStation/ AutoCAD, understanding of Windows operation systems. The candidate should also have knowledge of review tools like SmartPlant Review / Navisworks etc.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

* This role will require to coordinate with his counterpart in other offices transferring model data as per Project division of responsibility (DOR) between offices.
* He / She will be responsible for conformity of drawings and reports as per Project or engineering instructions, performing 3D model data quality checks, providing Project leadership team updates on Project CAD issues, trouble-shooting user issues, escalating CAD issues requiring additional help, developing CAD instructions, suggesting work-process improvements, implementing lessons learnt from previous Projects.
* This role will also be required to perform inter-discipline coordination, managing interferences in 3D model, integrating external 3D model into existing CAD setup, facilitating client model reviews, implementation of AWP (Advanced Work Package) and data exchanges with construction and start-up.
* The candidate should also have EPC project experience and should be able to understand business requirements. Understanding of multi discipline engineering work processes will be an added advantage.

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* Engineering Degree with 12+ Years or diploma with 14+ years of industry experience from a reputed institute

**Required Knowledge And Skills**

* Good oral and written communication skills. Knowledge of various applications towards engineering and construction, related to Piping discipline's design requirements. Knowledge of industry and regulatory standards, design criteria and codes relevant to the discipline. Knowledge of 3D/2D tools especially S3D/ Plant 3D/ AutoCAD/ Microstation
* The above is normally acquired through:

+ Specialized courses in drafting, design and engineering practices, and CAD, OR
+ A recognized degree in an engineering or scientific discipline, AND
+ Extensive experience in design and drafting

* Candidate must be aware of ES&H and Sustainability aspects
* Bechtel’s internal staffing policy includes the minimum time that you need to be in your current position before applying to a new position. Please refer to the applicable policy manual and ensure you meet the minimum requirements

**Total Rewards/Benefits**
For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth. Learn more at Bechtel Total Rewards
  
  
**Diverse Teams Build The Extraordinary**
As a global company, Bechtel has long been home to a vibrant multitude of nationalities, cultures, ethnicities, and life experiences. This diversity has made us a more trusted partner, more effective problem solvers and innovators, and a more attractive destination for leading talent.
  
  
We are committed to being a company where every colleague feels that they belong-where colleagues feel part of "One Team," respected and rewarded for what they bring, supported in pursuing their goals, invested in our values and purpose, and treated equitably. title: Manager - Navigation & Control
description:
**About Planys Technologies**

Planys Technologies is a next-gen defence technology startup building intelligent autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and maritime robotic systems that give naval and security forces a real-time, machine-driven picture of the undersea battlespace. Inspired by the pace, ambition, and product mindset of modern defence innovators, we are designing persistent, ROVs, AUVs, and hybrid surface vessel edge-compute heavy payloads, and advanced undersea sensing that turn oceans into knowledgeable, navigable, and defendable environments.

Engineers and researchers work like full-stack product teams: shaping hydrodynamics and propulsion, architecting navigation and perception stacks, and building autonomy and mission-systems software that must perform in GPS-denied, low-comms, high-risk conditions. You will see your code and hardware leave the lab quickly, iterate through real sea trials, and plug into high-impact naval, coastal security, and strategic deterrence missions in India and beyond. You’ll be part of a small, high-caliber team empowered to move fast, take end-to-end ownership, and push the boundaries of what underwater systems can sense, decide, and achieve in one of the most demanding environments on Earth.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a Manager – Navigation & Control to design, develop, integrate, and validate navigation and control systems for autonomous underwater vehicles.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement navigation algorithms (INS, DVL, USBL aiding, EKF/UKF sensor fusion) for AUV platforms operating in GPS-denied environments.
* Develop and tune guidance and control systems, including autopilots, path-following (LOS, Pure Pursuit), station-keeping, and depth/heading controllers.
* Build high-fidelity simulation environments for algorithm validation, including Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing.
* Integrate and calibrate navigation sensors, including IMU, DVL, USBL, pressure sensors, and magnetometers, on vehicle hardware.
* Implement real-time GNC software on embedded Linux platforms with deterministic timing requirements.
* Develop harbour-to-harbour navigation, mission planning, and waypoint management modules, and integrate them with the vehicle autonomy stack.
* Analyse and resolve navigation and control anomalies using sea-trial data, and drive post-trial reviews.
* Define and execute verification and validation (V&V) plans for GNC subsystems against system-level requirements.
* Support system-level integration, sea trials, and field deployments, and troubleshoot vehicle behaviour on-site.
* Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and software teams on vehicle-level design trade-offs and interface definitions.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including algorithm design documents, test reports, and calibration procedures.
* Create and track team work plans, mentor junior engineers, and provide technical guidance.

**Required Skills**

* Strong mathematical and analytical background.
* Strong knowledge of navigation, estimation, sensor fusion, and control systems.
* Proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
* Experience with ROS/ROS2, Linux, Git, and simulation tools.
* Knowledge of INS, DVL, USBL, EKF/UKF, PID, LQR/MPC.
* Experience with robotic or autonomous systems.
* Strong problem-solving and teamwork skills.

**Qualification**

* M.Tech / M.S. / Ph.D. in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Ocean Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Robotics, or related fields.
* 4–8 years of relevant experience in navigation, guidance, and control for robotic/autonomous systems.
* Experience in marine or underwater robotics is preferred.
* Research/thesis experience in navigation, control, or state estimation is an added advantage.

title: Information Architect
description:

**What You'll Do**

* Define, govern, and continuously enhance enterprise content models, information architecture standards, authoring guidelines, and metadata frameworks across Technical Publications and Knowledge Services.
* Design and manage taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, content classifications, and metadata structures,
* Drive content reuse strategy, governance, measurement, and optimization across product divisions through content audits, reuse frameworks, standards, and metrics.

* Partner with Technical Publications, Systems, Product Support, Engineering, and Knowledge Management teams to align content structures with business, customer, and operational needs.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Information Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Knowledge Management, or a related field.
* 15+ years of experience in Information Architecture, Content Strategy, Technical Documentation, or Knowledge Management.
* Proven expertise in content modeling, metadata, taxonomy, controlled vocabularies, and information architecture.
* Strong knowledge of structured authoring, XML/DITA, content reuse, and content governance.
* Experience with CCMS platforms, metadata-driven publishing, and digital content delivery solutions.
* Strong analytical skills with experience defining content metrics, KPIs, and governance dashboards.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable content and information architecture solutions.
* Experience leading cross-functional content, process, and technology transformation initiatives.

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. title: Process & Requirements Analyst - VP
description:
Join us as a “
**Process & Requirements Analyst-VP**
” and help us deliver a simpler, better and more balanced experience for our colleagues and leaders across the world.
  
  
As the Process & Requirements Analyst, you will play a critical role in transforming the bank through disciplined business analysis, requirements management and process design across complex change initiatives. You will independently facilitate stakeholder discussions, capture and translate complex business needs into clear documentation, map current-state journeys and shape practical future-state designs. You will identify pain points, dependencies and testing scenarios, and translate business requirements into functional requirements for technology delivery teams. Working confidently with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams, you will simplify ambiguity, challenge assumptions and maintain end-to-end traceability from business need through design, configuration, validation and testing. You will also partner with Change and Training leads to ensure launch collateral connects the new solution to the agreed requirements and intended benefits.
  
  
To be successful as a “Process & Requirements Analyst-VP”, you should have experience with:
  
  
**Required Skills**

* Critical Reasoning, Curiosity & Attention to Detail: Must have strong analytical skills, be specific, tenacious, curious and quick to learn, with a focus on crystallizing requirements and problem statements. Should be proactive, ask the right questions, probe for clarity, and move at pace. You can look across requirements, connecting the dots across a broad set of requirements, to support creation of a coherent design solution.
* Business Analysis and Requirements Management: Independently facilitates complex stakeholder discussions, captures and analyses business needs, and translates them into clear, prioritised and traceable business and functional requirements.
* Process Mapping and Improvement: Creates clear current-state and future-state process maps, identifies pain points, dependencies and improvement opportunities, and uses tools such as Blueworks, Visio or comparable process mapping applications.
* Ability to work in dynamic, fast paced, agile environment. You are a really fast learner, understanding different information quickly, assimilating new information and being able to represent that clearly and coherently, in a manner that others, not involved, can understand.
* You are solutions oriented, credible with colleagues, People Leaders and senior leaders able to work across centres of excellence, colleague support, HR tech and the journey experience team, creating one coherent, aligned set of requirements and designs.
* Technology Change and Governance: Uses Jira to manage requirements, traceability, governance and version control across design, build and testing activities, and works effectively with technology delivery teams.
* Testing and User Acceptance: Defines realistic positive and negative test scenarios from requirements and process analysis, understands key dependencies and supports thorough user acceptance testing.
* Strategic Requirements Leadership: Translates strategic objectives into clear business outcomes, capability needs and prioritised requirements, ensuring alignment across multiple initiatives and stakeholder groups.
* Senior Stakeholder Management and Influencing: Builds trusted relationships with senior leaders, constructively challenges assumptions, facilitates evidence-based decisions and secures alignment where priorities or perspectives differ.
* Portfolio Prioritisation and Dependency Management: Assesses value, urgency, risk and delivery complexity to support prioritisation, while identifying and managing cross-functional dependencies, constraints and impacts.
* Risk, Controls and Design Governance: Embeds risk and control considerations into requirements and solution design, establishes clear decision records and traceability, and ensures appropriate governance throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Benefits and Outcome Focus: Defines measurable outcomes and acceptance criteria, links requirements to intended benefits and uses evidence to confirm that delivered solutions address the original business need.

**Additional Skills**

* Business English and Multinational Experience: Highly experienced in writing detailed specifications in business English and working with global stakeholders; experience supporting United Kingdom-based teams is highly desirable. Experience in Human Resources, Workday or process transformation environments is also desirable.

**Leadership Capabilities**

* Lead Through Ambiguity: Provides structure and direction in complex or uncertain situations, makes sound decisions with incomplete information and maintains momentum while key issues are resolved.
* Cross-functional Leadership: Leads virtual and cross-functional teams through discovery, design and validation activities, clarifying accountabilities and creating an environment in which challenge and collaboration are encouraged.
* Decision Facilitation and Conflict Resolution: Surfaces trade-offs, resolves competing priorities and facilitates timely decisions, escalating material risks or unresolved issues with clear options and recommendations.
* Coaching and Capability Building: Coaches analysts and delivery colleagues, sets quality standards, provides constructive feedback and shares practical methods that strengthen requirements and process analysis capability.
* Executive Communication: Communicates complex information in a concise and compelling way, tailoring messages for senior audiences and presenting clear insights, impacts, recommendations and decisions required.
* Accountability for Delivery Quality: Sets expectations for quality, pace and governance, monitors progress and intervenes early to address gaps, ensuring requirements remain coherent, testable and aligned to agreed outcomes.

**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree

You may be assessed on critical reasoning, business analysis, requirements management, process mapping, stakeholder engagement, change and transformation, risk and controls, business acumen, strategic thinking, and digital and technology skills. Assessment may include a process-flow exercise or case-study discussion focused on gathering requirements, structuring delivery activities, managing stakeholders and supporting project execution.
  
  
This role will primarily be based in Chennai, India, with Pune accepted as a secondary location.
  
  
Core hours for this role are 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM IST, with flexibility required for key afternoon meetings. There is a policy to attend the office 3 days in a week on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday of every week.
  
  
  

* Purpose of the role

To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.

In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.

* Ownership – Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment.

At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.

**Position Description:**
Under general direction, the Engineering Systems Analyst drives strategies to improve engineering processes and ensure systems and tools are efficient and optimized. The individual will provide functional and technical expertise in identifying, evaluating, and developing systems and procedures that are cost effective and meet user requirements while directly supporting engineering initiatives from the business. You will then deploy engineering solutions assuring its implementation, effectiveness, adaptability, responsiveness, quality, governance, and the continuous improvement. This role is responsible for providing technical assistance to other engineers. This role also frequently provides guidance to engineering staff, using extensive experience to manage the prioritization, development and completion of technology projects.

* Maintain and administer PDM and CAD systems, databases, and infrastructure. Optimize systems for efficiency and security.
* Partner with users to understand PDM, CAD, and drafting concerns, troubleshoot issues, and propose process improvements to increase user efficiency and experience.
* Troubleshoot PDM and CAD issues with the end user base. Perform root cause analysis to develop, test, and implement fixes that prevent recurrence.
* Develop and deliver training for PDM and CAD products. Establish and communicate PDM and CAD best practices. Standardize PDM and CAD environments across all workstations.
* Work with IT to develop and support communication protocols between PDM and other data systems as required.
* Manage licenses for PDM and CAD software and add-ons.
* Evaluate, maintain, and develop new tools to support the end user base.
* Evaluate operating systems and upgrades to manage impact on CAD servers and workstations
* Attends and participates, as an ‘ambassador’ for testing, in project meetings regarding solution of the requirements, design, and test plan review.
* Maintain a working knowledge of advancing technologies. Identify applicable solutions and implement with existing networks when appropriate.
* Identify creative ways to reduce cost by streamlining processes and systems (i.e. modification of responsibilities, consolidation or tasks, elimination of non-value added processes and re-engineering processes and systems).
* Drive continuous improvement through trend reporting analysis and metrics management leveraging PowerBI and other similar tools.
* Participate in blueprinting and mapping sessions with customers for PDM, Change Management, and Migrations.
* Analyze requirements and contribute to the design of CAD/PDM solutions to complex requirements
* Design and execute implementations for PDM, Change Management, and Migrations
* Mentor and collaborate with services team members on design, documentation, and implementations
* SQL queries and analysis
* Participate in large project support, system/application implementations and upgrades.
* Assist with the long term migration to standard engineering tools.
* Designing and maintaining custom applications.
* Collaborate with DBAs and Infrastructure teams.

**Job Specifications:**

* Extensive knowledge and experience in Engineering PDM and CAD applications including SolidWorks and Autodesk products
* Broad understanding of the engineering new product development process and how CAD and PDM/PLM play a role within that process.
* Excellent team player.
* Strong logic, problem solving ability, takes initiative.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering, IT, or related technical field required
* Typically has 4+ years’ engineering or IT experience
* BlueStar PLM experience preferred

**Supervisory/Responsibility:**

* Indicate if individual contributor w/no direct reports or if supervise direct reports & level of reports (individual contributors, supervisors, managers, etc.)

**Work Environment:**
Works in an office environment but may occasionally be exposed to manufacturing conditions to include noise, fumes, Odors, gases, dust, and hazards such as moving mechanical and electrical machinery. Required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided to mitigate or eliminate these hazards and all employees will be trained on appropriate use of PPE.
  
  
**Position Type:**
This is a regular, full-time position with the understanding that a regular workweek will require extended days and hours as needed to meet business needs.

No travel is expected for this position

OFFICE

Performing the role frequently uses close vision, speech, hearing, and dexterity to operate office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds.

title: Lab Support Engineer(External)
description:
**The Impact You'll Make**
As a Test & Laboratory Support Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring our testing facilities are ready to validate the next generation of variable frequency drives (VFDs) and industrial power solutions. Your work will help bring reliable, high-quality products to customers faster and more efficiently.
  
  
You will play a key role in bringing new products to life by enabling reliable testing and validation. By ensuring our laboratories, equipment, and resources are ready when needed, you will help engineering teams accelerate innovation, maintain high quality standards, and deliver value to customers worldwide.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys hands-on technical work, solving practical challenges, and continuously learning new technologies in a collaborative engineering environment.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support electrical and functional testing of VFDs and related products to help deliver reliable, high-quality solutions.
* Prepare and maintain test setups, laboratory equipment, and test bays to ensure efficient and safe testing operations.
* Coordinate calibration activities and maintain accurate documentation to support quality and compliance requirements.
* Monitor laboratory resources, consumables, and equipment availability to keep projects running smoothly.
* Drive safe working practices, 5S standards, and continuous improvements that enhance laboratory efficiency and reliability.

**What We're Looking For**

* Practical experience supporting electrical testing, laboratory operations, test infrastructure, or related engineering activities.
* Ability to understand electrical circuits, use measuring instruments, and follow electrical safety practices.
* Confidence reading basic electrical drawings and wiring diagrams.
* Experience maintaining technical documentation, calibration records, inventory, or laboratory assets.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, along with a proactive mindset and willingness to learn.

At Danfoss, you will join a purpose-driven company committed to engineering solutions that help build a more sustainable future. You will work alongside experienced engineering professionals, gain exposure to advanced testing technologies, and contribute to products that support industries around the world.

title: Manager - Governance
description:
**Job Summary**
**Purpose**
The role holder will be a part of the stress testing hub team.
  
  
Enterprise stress testing comprises the stress tests required by the Group, regions, country and risk management teams, and other senior stakeholders as required to inform Risk Appetite and the stress tests required by the Bank’s regulators.
  
  
The team has responsibility for the execution of the Bank’s stress test exercises internally and to external regulators. It is also the centre of excellence for all strategic changes and operational controls, compliance attestation and policy setting for stress testing in the enterprise. As such, this individual will be working as part of a cohesive “strategy and execution” function. The team sets and runs the production schedule for stress testing.
  
  
The intent of the hub is to primarily run central workstream production tasks and sub-tasks during the running of each stress test exercise utilising ITO (Group IT) supported technology and produce management reporting on the same.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Risk Data & Reporting Analyst to support our organization’s compliance with BCBS principles. This role will be responsible for enhancing risk data aggregation capabilities and ensuring consistent, accurate, and timely risk reporting in line with regulatory expectations.
  
  
Enterprise stress testing comprises the stress tests required by the Prudential Regulation Authority (ICAAP stress test, Bank of England’s annual concurrent stress test, Recovery Plan stress test and Reverse stress test) and the stress tests required by the management and Board to inform Risk Appetite. Country stress tests are performed for regulators like the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) and Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS)
  
  
The role reports to the Head of Stress Testing Governance and sits within the Enterprise Stress Testing team in Financial Planning & Analysis, which drives all enterprise stress testing initiatives in collaboration with teams across the Risk Function and in Group Finance, Group Treasury and the business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The role holder will ensure compliance with governance and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Specifically, The Key Responsibilities Would Include**

* Maintain and enhance the Enterprise Stress Testing (EST) governance framework, policies, standards, and procedures.
* Ensure stress testing processes remain aligned with regulatory requirements and internal governance expectations.
* Coordinate periodic reviews and updates of stress testing standards, guidance, and governance documentation.
* Monitor compliance with policy requirements and track any exceptions or deviations.
* Manage governance forums such as the Stress Testing Forum (STF) and Group Stress Test Forum (GSTF).
* Schedule meetings, prepare papers, agendas, and minutes.
* Track actions, decisions, approvals, and escalations arising from governance forums.
* Coordinate submissions for exercises such as ICAAP, BCST, Reverse Stress Testing (RST), Recovery Planning Stress Testing (RPST), VIR and regulatory stress tests.
* Manage regulatory queries, findings, and feedback.
* Coordinate responses to Internal Audit, External Audit, and Regulatory findings.
* Track management action plans (MAPs) and remediation activities through closure.
* Own and maintain the RCSA, control library, metrics, and risk assessments for the stress testing process.
* Ensure key controls are documented, tested, and operating effectively.
* Oversee governance of issues, incidents, control deficiencies, and remediation plans.
* Drive continuous improvement of the control environment.
* Maintain governance records, standards, operating procedures, and evidence repositories.
* Capture lessons learned from each stress testing cycle.
* Drive process simplification, automation, and governance enhancements.
* Promote best practices across Group and Country stress testing activities

**Risk Management**

* Ensure effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks associated with stress testing and governance activities.
* Maintain compliance with applicable risk management frameworks, policies, and regulatory requirements.
* Support Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs), control effectiveness reviews, issue remediation, and audit activities.
* Escalate emerging risks, control deficiencies, and regulatory concerns to appropriate governance forums.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Stress Testing Team
* Key Risk colleagues
* Business leadership
* Key operations and technology partners / vendors
* Global Process Owner - Stress Testing
* Global Head, Stress Testing & Analytics

**Skills And Experience**

* Strong understanding of risk management, governance, regulatory, and control frameworks.
* Experience in stress testing, ICAAP, RCSA, audit, regulatory compliance, or related risk management activities.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex requirements and assess associated risks
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively across business, risk, finance, and regulatory functions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare reports and presentations for senior management and regulators.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a team environment

**Qualifications**
The ideal candidate should possess the following:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Accounting, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification or relevant professional certification would be advantageous.

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  
**Together We**

* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,**
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Lead Analyst - Learning & Development
description:
**Company Profile**
We support key functions with a strong focus on innovation, collaboration, and digital excellence, we thrive in driving business growth and elevating customer experiences across global markets.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Capability Diagnosis & Learning Strategy
* Partner with BU HRs and leaders to identify capability gaps across technical, behavioral and leadership dimensions.
* Translate the annual Talent Development Review (TDR) and performance cycle outcomes into a prioritised, costed learning plan.
* Run a structured Training Needs Identification process with a published calendar, clear owners and visible timelines.
* Build and maintain competency frameworks for all functions
* Program Design & Facilitation
* Design learning journeys using sound instructional design principles – blended, digital-first, and measurable.
* Personally facilitate leadership, manager-effectiveness and behavioural programs; this role is expected to be in the room, not only behind the design.
* Build and run flagship programs such as first-time manager development, leadership pipeline and high-potential journeys.
* Organizational Development
* Support Individual Development Plans (IDPs), succession readiness and career pathing in partnership with BU HRs.
* Design OD interventions for engagement, team effectiveness and culture, aligned to global HR
* Support change and transformation initiatives with communication and capability-building plans.
* Data, Reporting & Governance
* Own the L&D dashboard – coverage, spend, completion, effectiveness and ROI – published on a fixed monthly and quarterly cadence.
* Maintain all learning data, trackers and program collateral in shared team locations (SharePoint / Teams) so that any stakeholder can access current information without requesting it.
* Document processes into repeatable, handover-ready playbooks so that no program depends on a single individual.
* Manage the annual L&D budget, vendor selection, contracting and performance review.
* Global Alignment
* Work with Lennox global HR and L&D counterparts across time zones to localise global programs and contribute India-built content back to the global catalogue.

Benchmark against global practice and bring externally validated methods into
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Experience & Qualifications**

* Experience: 10–13 years in Learning & Development / Organizational Development, with a minimum of 5 years inside a global multinational, GCC or shared services environment working directly with overseas stakeholders.
* Population exposure: Proven experience supporting engineering, technology or R&D populations of 500+ employees is a plus.
* Hands-on delivery: Demonstrable track record of personally designing and facilitating leadership and behavioural programs – candidates should be able to walk through artefacts they built themselves.
* Measurement: Working knowledge of Kirkpatrick or equivalent evaluation models, with real examples of learning impact measured and reported.
* Systems: Practical proficiency with an LMS, Microsoft 365 (Excel, Power BI, SharePoint, Teams, Forms), and an HRIS such as Workday or SuccessFactors.
* Education: Any graduate qualification in HR, Organizational Psychology, or Business Administration.

**Behavioral Requirements – Non-Negotiable**
These behaviours carry equal weight to technical skill in the selection decision and will be explicitly assessed.
  
  

* Collaboration by default: Works with BU HRs, business leaders and global counterparts as co-owners, not as requestors. Brings people into the design early rather than presenting a finished answer. Handles disagreement directly and professionally.

**Transparency with data:**
Treats learning data, trackers and program material as shared organizational assets. Keeps them in common locations, current and self-serve. Never holds information as leverage or as a personal dependency.

description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is an innovative, dynamic company with a rich past and a promising future. Originally Hewlett-Packard Company, HPE has continuously reinvented itself. Today, HPE is one of the world's leading technology companies and provides wired and wireless networking, core and edge networking, servers, storage, IT and Cloud services for the next generation of IT infrastructure. HPE Networking, is a leading provider of next-generation network access solutions for the enterprise edge.
  
  
We are hiring senior level Advanced Customer Engineering (ACE) engineers to work with our largest and most important customers. This position will be primarily responsible for working with our Critical Account Program customers. This work includes senior level case oversight/review, facilitating software engineering needs for defects, remote and/or onsite support depending on the nature of the issue. You must be able to deal with high pressure situations and know how to manage frustrated customers whilst being proactive in getting the information you need to be effective in these environments.
  
  
The ACE team is highly respected in the organization and is considered a senior level engineering team that is relied upon to get things done others can’t. The average tenure with Aruba is approximately 10 years and the average level of industry experience is 15-20 years. You will need to have excellent technical skills in your area of expertise but must also have outstanding communication skills. You must be able to effectively communicate to company IT executives as well as the front-line engineering staff. You must be willing to learn new technologies and be self-starter when it comes to training.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
What you’ll do:
  
  

* Working with our Critical Account Program customers acting as the senior technical resource
* Identifying sub-optimal designs and/or misconfigurations and consulting on plans to correct.
* Working with engineering escalations teams and customers while remote or onsite to identify and troubleshoot issues and/or software or hardware defects
* Build strong customer relationships and become a trusted advisor.
* Build strong relationships across the wider internal organization to increase your knowledge, get faster outcomes and build trust.
* You will be expected to be very collaborative with your teammates and the rest of the team will be expected to do the
* More communication usually provides better outcomes and increases engineering talent’s, experience and knowledge same. levels.
* Requires some travel approximately 10-40%. Travel varies based on time of year, software release cycles and new hardware releases.

**What You Need To Bring**
Education and Experience Required:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or other Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
* Typically, 10-15+ years’ experience.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* A deep understanding of one or more of the following areas of enterprise networking
* Modern enterprise network design, implementation and troubleshooting, including DNS, DHCP, spanning tree, network access control technologies, including 802.1X, IGRP routing protocols and remote access technologies including IPSec and/or SSL VPN.
* WAN/Data Center Design including IGRP and EGRP Routing Protocols, Spine/Leaf topologies and virtualization technologies.
* 802.11 wireless solutions, including design, implementation and troubleshooting in all current industry protocols including 802.11b, 802.11g, 802.11a, 802.11n, 802.11ac and 802.11ax.
* Security solutions, including IPSec, SSL/TLS, Public Key Infrastructure/Certificates, 802.1X, radius and LDAP directories, as well as how they are implemented in networking environments to meet the needs of the modern enterprise.
* Using, evaluating, and developing appropriate engineering design tools and software packages.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Conduct reviews of customer configurations and quickly identifying issues.
* Strong history of troubleshooting with customers in your current or past roles.
* Vendor and/or Industry certifications are a plus but not required.
* Must have demonstrated the ability to pick up additional skillsets outside of comfort zone
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language. Ability to effectively communicate and build relationships primarily with customer engineers but also across all levels of customer organizations up to the executive level.
* Must be willing to work as part of larger team as needed
* We are a fast-growing organization so flexibility, adaptability and a positive attitude are a must.

title: Internship Program 2026 - Build Your Career Through Real Project Experience
description:
**Job Description**

**knowledge, practical exposure, discipline, and continuous improvement are the foundation of a successful career.**
Unlike conventional training programs, this is a
**real-time industry learning opportunity**

* Are willing to accept feedback and continuously improve their performance.
