* Value knowledge, discipline, professional growth, and long-term career development.

**This program is not intended for candidates whose primary expectation is immediate stipend or salary.**
Our primary objective is to develop skilled professionals who are capable of building successful long-term careers through continuous learning, practical industry experience, discipline, and proven performance.
  
  
Who Should Not Apply?
  
  
Please carefully understand the nature of this opportunity before applying.
  
  
**Candidates Should Not Apply If They**

* Are not interested in the ERP domain or business software industry.
* Expect an immediate stipend or salary from the beginning of the internship.
* Are primarily looking for a paid internship rather than a performance-based learning opportunity.
* Are looking for an internship only to obtain a certificate.
* Are not willing to undergo strong assessments at every stage.
* Are not comfortable with performance-based continuation.
* Are looking only to complete the internship duration without focusing on learning and performance.
* Are not willing to continuously improve their knowledge and practical skills.
* Are not interested in proving their capabilities through actual work and performance.
* Are not interested in a potential long-term employment opportunity with the organization.
* Are unwilling to take ownership, accept feedback, maintain discipline, and demonstrate professional commitment.

Important
  
  
**This opportunity is not designed for candidates who are looking only for a certificate, immediate payment, or a short-term internship experience.**
**Certification is not guaranteed merely for joining or attending the program.**
This opportunity is for candidates who are genuinely willing to:
  
  
**Learn → Practice → Perform → Improve → Prove Themselves → Build a Career**
If you are genuinely interested in the ERP domain, willing to invest your time and effort in learning, and want to prove yourself through performance with the possibility of securing a
**Fresher employment opportunity**
, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Nature of the Internship
  
  
This internship follows a
**Self-Learning with Industry Mentorship Model.**
**Candidates Will Be Expected To**

* Learn independently with guidance from mentors.
* Complete assigned learning modules and project tasks.
* Work on real client and internal projects.
* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Continuously improve technical and professional skills.
* Demonstrate discipline, professionalism, and accountability throughout the program.
* Accept feedback positively and implement improvements.
* Demonstrate consistent performance throughout the internship.

Success in this internship depends largely on the candidate's willingness to learn, adapt, take responsibility, and consistently perform.
  
  
Selection Process
  
  
Stage 1 – Five-Day Assessment Program
  
  
Before being admitted into the internship program, every applicant must successfully complete a
**5-working-day assessment**
.
  
  
During this assessment, candidates will be assigned practical tasks to evaluate not only technical aptitude but also professional qualities.
  
  
**The Evaluation Includes**

* Learning ability
* Problem-solving approach
* Discipline and punctuality
* Sincerity and commitment
* Professional ethics
* Ownership and accountability
* Communication skills
* Adaptability
* Consistency in task completion
* Overall suitability for the internship program

Only candidates who successfully complete this assessment will be offered internship positions.
  
  
Internship Structure and Stipend Eligibility
  
  
The internship will be for
**150 working days**
, divided into
**six blocks of 25 working days each**
.
  
  
Block Duration Stipend Blocks 1–3 75 working days

Block 4 25 working days ₹5,000\* Block 5 25 working days ₹5,000\* Block 6 25 working days ₹5,000\*

**Candidates Who Successfully Progress To**

**Block 5 → ₹5,000 stipend**
**Block 6 → ₹5,000 stipend**
will be eligible for the applicable stipend only after satisfying the required performance standards for the respective block.
  
  
The organization reserves the right to determine stipend eligibility based on the candidate's performance assessment.
  
  
Block-Wise Performance Assessment
  
  
At the end of
**every 25-working-day block**
, candidates will undergo a
**strict performance assessment**
.
  
  
**Each Assessment Will Evaluate**

* Technical learning progress
* Practical implementation skills
* Quality of work
* Discipline and attendance

Candidates who do not meet the required standards may be discontinued from the internship and will not be allowed to progress to the next block.
  
  
Performance-Based Continuation
  
  
Continuation in the internship is
**entirely based on performance**
.
  
  
**Candidates Who Consistently Demonstrate**

with

with the organization.

title: Data Governance Operations
description:
**Key Responsibilities:-**

**1. Data Governance Operations:**

· Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the Bank’s Data Governance Framework.

· Coordinate data governance activities across Business Units (BUs) and Support Units (SUs).

· Facilitate collaboration with Data Owners, Data Stewards, and key stakeholders.

· Support governance forums, working groups, and committees through meeting preparation, reporting, and action tracking.

· Monitor adherence to data governance policies, standards, and procedures.

· Track data-related issues, remediation plans, and governance performance metrics.

· Prepare regular governance reports and management dashboards.

**2. Metadata Management, Data Lineage & KDU/KDE Governance:**

· Maintain and enhance the enterprise metadata repository and business glossary.

· Coordinate the identification, documentation, and approval of Critical Data Elements (KDEs) and Key Data Usage (KDU) processes.

· Facilitate the documentation and maintenance of end-to-end data lineage across systems, applications, and reports.

· Ensure lineage captures data sourcing, transformation, movement, consumption, and regulatory reporting requirements.

· Maintain data asset inventories and support metadata quality assessments.

· Monitor the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of metadata, lineage, and data ownership information.

· Collaborate with business and technology teams to resolve metadata and lineage gaps.

**3. Data Analytics & Regulatory Reporting Support:**

· Partner with business, analytics, and reporting teams to understand data requirements.

· Support data discovery and sourcing through metadata and lineage capabilities.

· Facilitate access to trusted, governed, and well-documented data for analytics and reporting.

· Assist in establishing consistent data definitions, standards, and business rules.

· Support regulatory reporting, management reporting, and strategic analytics initiatives through appropriate governance controls.

· Help ensure critical reporting data is traceable, well-defined, and properly governed.

**4. Data Governance Training & Awareness:**

· Develop and deliver data governance training programs for Business Units and Support Units.

· Design and maintain bank-wide e-learning modules covering data governance principles, policies, standards, and framework requirements.

· Conduct awareness initiatives to promote data ownership, stewardship, and accountability.

· Support onboarding and refresher training for Data Owners, Data Stewards, and other stakeholders.

· Monitor training participation and effectiveness.

· Identify opportunities to improve training content and governance awareness.

**5. Stakeholder Management & Regulatory Support:**

This includes expense submission, audit, settlement, and compliance with the global travel policy and internal control framework.
  
  
The role requires deep expertise in SAP Concur and strong understanding of SAP ERP integrations and related upstream/downstream systems, ensuring seamless data flow, system integrity, and compliant execution of T&E processes.
  
  
The BPE is responsible for designing and maintaining detailed end-to-end process flows, driving standardization, simplification, and harmonization across regions.
  
  
With a strong continuous improvement and simplification mindset, the role applies industry best practices (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Agile) to enhance process efficiency, strengthen controls, and improve employee experience. The BPE actively identifies optimization opportunities, including automation and digitalization within the T&E landscape.
  
  
The role plays a key part in governance and change management by:
  
  

* Coordinating and aligning with IT development teams on system enhancements and integrations
* Defining, reviewing, and approving business requirements
* Ensuring high-quality execution and validation of System Integration Testing (SIT)
* Maintaining strict attention to detail to ensure compliance with audit and control requirements

In addition, the BPE is responsible for enabling operational excellence by training and supporting operational teams, ensuring consistent understanding and execution of T&E processes, policies, and tools.
  
  
The role also requires solid knowledge of automated T&E audit solutions (e.g., AI-driven audit tools) and their application in strengthening compliance and control effectiveness.
  
  

* Contributes in defining a wide range of moderate complexity business capability that represents voice of customer, Business Units, Regions, Functions, regulators, and other key stakeholders for both shared and standard processes and in defining the minimum standard for a process and hand-over strategy to BUs/Regions for guided flexible processes.
* Provides guidance in creating Fit-For-Purpose E2E moderate complexity process by modelling in the Process Framework and ensures alignment with the supporting IT applications, data model and job families incl. relevant process KPI’s and compliance controls for standard and shared processes.
* Provides support in designing the minimum level of standard for a process and hand-over to BUs/Regions, including Process Guardrails for guided flexible processes.

Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. description:
EMC PIlot
  
  
We are looking for an EMI/EMC Engineer with 2–5 years of experience in automotive electronics to support EMC design, testing, validation, and compliance activities. The candidate should possess hands-on expertise in automotive EMC standards, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and system-level EMC validation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Plan, execute, analyze, and document EMI/EMC validation and compliance testing for automotive electronic systems and ECUs.
  
  
Perform conducted/radiated emissions, immunity, ESD, and transient testing in accordance with automotive, OEM, and international EMC standards.
  
  
Develop EMC requirements, test plans, procedures, reports, and technical documentation.
  
  
Conduct EMC design reviews and support implementation of best practices related to PCB layout, grounding, shielding, filtering, harness routing, and EMC protection techniques.
  
  
Investigate EMC test failures, perform root-cause analysis, and drive corrective actions to meet compliance requirements.
  
  
Support pre-compliance testing and provide design recommendations to improve EMC performance.
  
  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, software, system, mechanical, PCB, and validation) to resolve EMC-related issues throughout product development.
  
  
Coordinate with customers, suppliers, and external EMC test laboratories for validation and certification activities.
  
  
Review EMC test results and provide technical recommendations for design improvements and compliance.
  
  
Support product development from concept through production release, ensuring adherence to customer-specific, regulatory, and automotive EMC standards.
  
  
**Qualifications**
B.E./B.Tech/M.E. in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, power electronics or related discipline.
  
  
**Essential Skills**
Hands-on experience in EMC chambers and vehicle-level EMC testing.
  
  
Experience with hybrid/electric vehicle systems, battery management systems, or power electronics.
  
  
Exposure to global automotive development processes
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Ability to perform root cause analysis and drive technical solutions.
  
  
Excellent communication and technical documentation skills.
  
  
Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  
  
Customer-focused mindset with attention to quality and compliance.
  
  
**Experience**
EMI/EMC Engineer with 2–5 years of experience in automotive electronics

title: Content Writer
description:
**Company:**

Zynith Labs

**Experience:**

2 - 4 Years

**Location:**

Chennai (Ekattuthangal)

**Employment Type:**

Full-time | On-site

**About Zynith Lab**

Zynith Labs is a design partner working at the intersection of creativity, strategy and technology. We partner with businesses to shape digital experiences, build brands and create solutions that make a difference.

**The Role**

Good copy does more than fill a page. It gives a brand its voice, makes complex ideas easy to understand and gives people a reason to pay attention.

That's what we're looking for at Zynith Labs.

We're looking for a Copywriter who knows how to find the right words, whether it's a website that needs to make a strong first impression, an ad that needs to earn a click, or a brand that needs a voice of its own.

You'll work across brands, industries and digital touchpoints, turning briefs into ideas and ideas into words that connect with the right audience. We value someone who can think beyond writing, understand why a message matters and know how to make every word count.

**What You'll be Working on**

* Writing website content, landing pages and service pages that communicate value without sounding like everyone else.
* Crafting ad copies, campaign headlines and creative messaging that capture attention and drive action.
* Developing brand narratives, positioning statements, taglines and communication frameworks.
* Writing LinkedIn posts, social media captions and content that gives brands a distinct personality.
* Creating email campaigns, newsletters and marketing communication that people actually want to read.
* Working closely with designers and marketing teams to bring creative concepts to life through words.
* Researching brands, industries, audiences and competitors before putting pen to paper.
* Reworking, refining and challenging copy until it says exactly what it needs to say.
* Applying SEO principles naturally, without compromising the quality of the writing.

**What Makes you a Good Fit**

* 2 - 4 years of experience in copywriting, preferably in a creative agency, digital agency or B2B environment.
* You have a strong command of English and know the difference between writing correctly and writing well.
* You can switch between brand storytelling, advertising copy and conversion-focused writing without losing your voice.
* You understand how brands communicate and what makes an audience pay attention.
* You know how to turn a complicated product or service into a message people can understand and relate to.
* You are comfortable working with creative teams, taking feedback and improving your work.
* You research before you write and pay attention to the details others might overlook.
* You have a portfolio that demonstrates your writing ability across different formats and industries.

**Why Zynith Labs ?**

* Work with brands across different industries and creative disciplines.
* Be part of a team where ideas are encouraged and good work is recognised.
* Collaborate closely with the founder, leadership and creative teams.
* Take ownership of your work and see your ideas move from brief to execution.
* Grow with an organisation that believes in growing its people along the way.

**We aren't looking for someone who simply knows how to write. We're looking for someone who knows what to say, how to say it and when to leave a word out.**

If that's you, we'd like to see your work.

title: Lead Specialist, Technology Solutions - Agentic Automations
description:
**About Pearson**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple:
**Add life to a lifetime of learning.**

  
  

As a global leader in digital learning, we are transforming how people learn through innovative, AI-powered experiences that improve outcomes and create meaningful impact. Pearson is embracing a digital-first future where AI, automation, and intelligent systems enable employees to focus on higher-value work while accelerating business transformation.

  
  

The
**Office of the CTO**
powers this transformation by delivering scalable, secure, resilient, and intelligent enterprise platforms. Within Digital & Technology (D&T), the
**AgentOps Team**
leads the next generation of enterprise automation through Agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and autonomous systems that drive measurable business value.

  
  

**Why Join AgentOps?**

  
  

This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation and help shape how humans and AI agents collaborate at scale.

  
  

You will:

  

  
* Build cutting-edge agentic AI solutions deployed across Pearson's global enterprise
  
  
* Create intelligent workflows that combine automation, reasoning, and human oversight
  
  
* Solve high-impact business challenges using advanced AI technologies
  
  
* Influence enterprise-wide AI engineering and automation standards
  
  
* Help define the future of a symbiotic workforce where humans and AI agents work together seamlessly
  

  

**Role Overview**

  
  

The
**Lead Specialist, Agentic Automations**
is a senior practitioner and solution leader responsible for driving the end-to-end discovery, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions.

  
  

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.

  
  

As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.

  
  

You will play a key role in advancing Pearson's vision of an AI-enabled enterprise powered by agentic systems and intelligent automation.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Business Analysis & Opportunity Discovery**

  

  
* Lead end-to-end requirements gathering, process discovery, and stakeholder workshops for agentic automation initiatives.
  
  
* Analyze business processes to identify opportunities for intelligent automation, autonomous agents, and AI-driven workflow transformation.
  
  
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions with SMEs, product owners, operational teams, and business leaders.
  
  
* Document and validate business requirements, use cases, process maps, and success criteria.
  
  
* Translate business challenges into scalable AI and automation solutions with clearly defined value realization metrics.
  
  
* Establish measurable ROI, productivity, efficiency, quality, and cost optimization objectives.
  

  

**Solution Design & Agentic Architecture**

  

  
* Design intelligent workflows, multi-agent systems, and semi-autonomous business processes.
  
  
* Define agent behaviors, orchestration patterns, decision frameworks, escalation mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
* Create comprehensive solution artifacts including:
  
  
* Process Design Documents (PDDs)
  
  
* Solution Design Documents (SDDs)
  
  
* User Journeys
  
  
* Process Flows
  
  
* System Interaction Diagrams
  
  
* Agent Behavior Models
  
  
* Data & Integration Specifications
  
  
* Partner with architects and engineering teams to establish scalable and reusable design patterns.
  
  
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise platform, integration, security, and governance standards.
  

  

**Agentic AI & Automation Delivery**

  

  
* Lead the functional design and implementation of agentic automation solutions.
  
  
* Collaborate with developers, AI engineers, and automation specialists throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
* Design workflows incorporating:
  
  
* Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents
  
  
* Human review and approval stages
  
  
* Escalation paths
  
  
* Exception handling
  
  
* Feedback loops
  
  
* Continuous learning mechanisms
  
  
* Drive adoption of reusable components, templates, skills, prompts, and accelerators across initiatives.
  
  
* Support enterprise rollout, change management, and operational readiness activities.
  

  

**Stakeholder Management & Leadership**

  

  
* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership.
  
  
* Communicate solution vision, business value, risks, and implementation approaches to executive and technical audiences.
  
  
* Manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity in complex transformation programs.
  
  
* Facilitate decision-making and proactively escalate risks, dependencies, and roadblocks.
  
  
* Mentor team members and promote best practices in agentic automation delivery.
  

  

**Responsible AI, Governance & Risk Management**

  

  
* Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson's Responsible AI framework.
  
  
* Implement controls to mitigate:
  
  
* Hallucination risks
  
  
* Prompt injection attacks
  
  
* Data leakage
  
  
* Model misuse
  
  
* Compliance and privacy risks
  
  
* Apply governance requirements based on solution risk levels including low, medium, and high-stakes use cases.
  
  
* Support auditability, explainability, transparency, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  
  
* Partner with security, legal, privacy, and risk teams to ensure enterprise readiness.
  

  

**Delivery Excellence & Business Impact**

  

  
* Partner with program and project managers to ensure successful execution and delivery.
  
  
* Define and track success metrics including:
  
  
* Productivity improvements
  
  
* Cost reduction and avoidance
  
  
* Time savings
  
  
* Automation utilization
  
  
* Employee experience improvements
  
  
* Customer experience outcomes
  
  
* Ensure solutions integrate with enterprise observability, monitoring, telemetry, and governance platforms.
  
  
* Drive continuous optimization through performance measurement and feedback.
  

  

**Innovation & Capability Building**

  

  
* Contribute to Pearson's AgentOps roadmap and enterprise AI strategy.
  
  
* Create and maintain reusable assets including:
  
  
* Prompt libraries
  
  
* Agent templates
  
  
* Automation accelerators
  
  
* Design standards
  
  
* Playbooks and frameworks
  
  
* Evaluate emerging AI, agentic, and automation technologies.
  
  
* Champion an agentic-first mindset and culture of continuous learning across the organization.
  

  

**Technology Ecosystem**

  
  

**Agentic AI & Large Language Models**

  

  
* Azure OpenAI
  
  
* OpenAI APIs
  
  
* Claude
  
  
* Enterprise AI Platforms
  
  
* Multi-Agent Frameworks
  

  

**Automation & Orchestration**

  

  
* UiPath Studio
  
  
* UiPath Orchestrator
  
  
* UiPath Agent Builder
  
  
* UiPath Document Understanding
  
  
* Microsoft Power Automate
  

  

**Data, Integration & Enterprise Platforms**

  

  
* REST APIs

title: Service Account Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
As a Services Account Manager, you will manage assigned customer service requests and issues from initial quotation through to delivery and issue resolution. Your role ensures a seamless, high-quality customer experience across the full service lifecycle for the requests and accounts assigned to you. Your responsibilities include:
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Managing assigned customer service requests end-to-end — from initial inquiry and quotation through order fulfillment, delivery, and issue closure.
* Preparing and issuing accurate, timely quotations in response to assigned service requests, ensuring alignment with technical and commercial requirements.
* Managing the Inquiry to Order (ITO) process for assigned requests, including coordinating commercial and contractual details with internal stakeholders (engineering, operations, logistics, finance).
* Tracking assigned service requests and orders to ensure timely delivery, proactively communicating status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Coordinating with internal teams (engineering, field service, supply chain) to resolve assigned customer issues, escalations, and technical queries efficiently.
* Ensuring service excellence by monitoring resolution times, quality, and customer satisfaction for assigned requests.
* Communicating clearly with customers throughout the lifecycle of assigned requests, setting expectations and managing follow-ups.
* Identifying recurring issues or service gaps within assigned accounts and escalating/collaborating with relevant teams (Marketing, Product Line, Engineering) to drive improvement.
* Applying Six Sigma analytical tools, including Root Cause Analysis (RCA), to support resolution of reliability issues and drive continuous improvement in service delivery.
* Maintaining accurate records of service requests, interactions, and resolutions within CRM/ERP systems.
* Supporting strong working relationships with customers on assigned requests to promote satisfaction and repeat engagement.
* Regularly reporting to the APAC Services Operations Manager on assigned request status, open issues, and service delivery performance.
* Staying informed on customer needs, product/service requirements, and regional market conditions relevant to assigned accounts.
* Collaborating with the Services Product Line team to relay customer feedback and support development of new/improved service offerings.
* If you are a detail-oriented, technically proficient professional passionate about delivering exceptional customer service in the Power Conversion sector across India/APAC, we encourage you to apply for this opportunity with GE Power Conversion.

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college/university in Electrical Engineering or allied Engineering discipline. (Master's degree a plus.)
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in customer service, account management, technical support, or service operations.
* Offshore industry experience and process knowledge in one or more of: Metal, Marine, Oil & Gas, Test Bench, Material Handling, or Power Plant sectors.
* Knowledge of Power Electronics, High Voltage Equipment, and PLC systems.
* Experience with quotation preparation and ITO (Inquiry to Order) processes.
* Willingness to travel across India/APAC region as required.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Prior experience with MV/LV drives, industrial automation systems, and large motors and generators.
* Proficient in both oral and written communication in English (additional regional languages a plus).
* Strong organizational and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent service requests.
* Customer-centric mindset with a focus on responsiveness and issue resolution.
* Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, field service, and supply chain teams.
* Proactive problem-solver, comfortable working in high-pressure, matrix-based environments.
* Experience with CRM/ERP systems for tracking service requests and orders.
* Demonstrated technical proficiency coupled with strong customer service orientation

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

**Company Description**
Brillare Science Limited is a personal care company committed to delivering real solutions for hair and skin concerns rather than marketing-driven promises. title: Project Coordinator
description:
**Orchestrate Professional Services Success as a Project Coordinator**
Are you high-energy, flexible, and exceptionally detail-oriented? Do you have a passion for delighting customers, building strong cross-functional relationships, and maintaining a solid understanding of enterprise software offerings? Trimble is seeking a dedicated Project Coordinator to join our Construction Management Solutions (CMS) division in Chennai. In this vital role, you will manage project setup, oversee resource requests, and keep our system of record current, acting as a crucial operational anchor for our Professional Services organization.
  
  
**About Us**
Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB),
  
  
visit: www.trimble.com
  
  
**About Our Construction Management Solutions Division:**
CMS delivers compelling capability and connected workflows that enhance the profitability of our customers and drive business growth. We provide immense value to clients through our suite of leading products on Trimble Construction One (TC1), supported by world-class engineering, marketing, and professional services.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Great**
Operating out of our Chennai office on a night-shift schedule to support our US-based teams, you will serve as a central operational liaison across Professional Services Managers, Resource Managers, and Project Managers. You will enjoy complete ownership over project administration, data integrity, and internal communication tools, while collaborating cross-functionally whenever client needs span across business units. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love bringing order to complex schedules, this position offers an ideal platform to sharpen your project management expertise inside a global technology leader.
  
  
Key Exciting Responsibilities
  
  

* Project Setup & System Maintenance: Own the administration of project setups, ongoing consulting requests, and project maintenance within our enterprise system of record, ensuring all data remains accurate and up-to-date.
* Customer Inquiry & Request Management: Act as a primary point of contact for ongoing customer inquiries within Professional Services, directing cross-functional collaboration when customer needs extend beyond the division.
* Resource & PM Collaboration: Partner closely with Professional Services Managers, Resource Managers, and Project Managers to collect key project metrics, track deliverables, and manage tight operational timelines.
* Internal Communication Management: Maintain, organize, and improve internal team communication repositories and knowledge bases (including Google Sites and Google Drive).
* Process Optimization & Problem Solving: Identify existing or potential operational bottlenecks, propose thoughtful data-driven solutions, and continuously refine internal project tracking workflows.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Education & Experience: University degree in Business Administration or a related discipline, combined with a minimum of two years of experience coordinating projects (or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience).
* Project Coordination & Methodologies: Basic knowledge of project management practices and proven experience coordinating project activities within a matrixed corporate environment.
* Deadline & Pressure Resilience: Demonstrated ability to complete deadline-driven assignments consistently, accommodate urgent requests, and remain productive under pressure while balancing competing priorities.
* Communication Excellence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain information clearly, listen effectively, and present data accurately across business units.
* Analytical Problem Solving: Self-motivated mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities, high accountability, and a drive to pursue ongoing learning opportunities.

**Bonus Points For**

* Tooling Proficiency: Hands-on experience using Google Workspace, Salesforce, Kantata (formerly Mavenlink), and Smartsheet.
* Methodology Training: Professional coursework, certifications, or formal training in project management methodologies.
* Financial & Industry Context: Basic understanding of accounting principles/terminology and structural familiarity with the construction industry landscape.
* Technical Aptitude: Tech-oriented mindset with comfort in learning and adapting to new enterprise software technologies rapidly.

**Logistics**

* Location: Chennai, India (In-office position)
* Work Schedule: Night-shift schedule.
* Job Type: Full-Time.

Why You'll Love Working With Us
  
  
At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
  
  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.

****How to Apply:****
Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.
  
  
**Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**
At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

title: vehicle diagnostics
description:
A typical
**Vehicle Diagnostics Engineer**
role at
**Renault Nissan Technology & Business Centre India (RNTBCI)**
focuses on developing and validating vehicle diagnostic functions compliant with automotive standards.
  
  
Job Title
  
  
**Vehicle Diagnostics Engineer**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop and maintain vehicle diagnostic specifications for ECUs.
* Define and validate diagnostic functions based on UDS (ISO 14229) and OBD-II requirements.
* Configure and test Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs), Diagnostic Identifiers (DIDs), and Routine Control services.
* Analyze CAN/LIN communication and troubleshoot diagnostic issues.
* Work with software, calibration, validation, and ECU suppliers to resolve diagnostic defects.
* Perform diagnostic validation using tools such as CANoe, CANalyzer, or DDT2000.
* Support software integration, vehicle testing, and issue analysis.
* Ensure compliance with Renault-Nissan diagnostic standards and regulatory requirements.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, diagnostic specifications, and test reports.
* Participate in defect tracking and root cause analysis.

Required Skills
  
  

* Knowledge of automotive communication protocols:

+ CAN
+ LIN
+ Ethernet (preferred)

* Understanding of:

+ UDS (ISO 14229)
+ OBD-II
+ ISO 15765 (CAN Transport Protocol)

* Experience with tools such as:

+ Vector CANoe
+ CANalyzer
+ DDT2000
+ INCA (preferred)

* Understanding of ECU architecture and embedded systems.
* Familiarity with diagnostics over CAN and vehicle networks.
* Basic scripting knowledge (CAPL or Python) is an advantage.
* Strong debugging and analytical skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Automobile, or related disciplines.
* Typically 2–6 years of experience in automotive diagnostics, ECU validation, or embedded systems.

Common Interview Topics
  
  

* UDS services (0x10, 0x11, 0x19, 0x22, 0x27, 0x2E, 0x31, 0x34, 0x36, 0x37).
* DTC lifecycle and fault memory.
* OBD-II requirements and emission-related diagnostics.
* CAN protocol, CAN frames, arbitration, and message IDs.
* Diagnostic session control and security access.
* Flash programming and bootloader concepts.
* CAPL scripting basics.
* ECU communication and diagnostic troubleshooting.
* Difference between functional and physical addressing.
* Positive and negative response codes in UDS.

This role is suited to engineers with backgrounds in
**automotive electronics, ECU diagnostics, embedded systems, or vehicle network validation**
, rather than mechanical design.

As a leading engineering player putting innovation at the heart of its strategy, SEGULA Technologies manages large-scale projects, ranging from initial studies to industrialization and production. title: Team Member - Green Steel
description:
**As a strategic step towards Sustainability:**
JSW Steel has established a Steel Recycling Business to cater the growing scrap demand. As part of this initiative, the state-of-the-art Scrap Processing Facility of ~0.5 MTPA is planned in the vicinity of Chennai. This plant encompassing shredding & baling operations to ensure high-quality scrap supply to the plant in the vicinity of Chennai.
  
  
**Strengthening the Scrap Supply Chain:**
To further secure and enhance scrap availability, it is imperative to establish collection and processing centres across strategic locations.
  
  
**Role Scope & Key Deliverables**

* The role covers the entire value chain - from conducting comprehensive market studies and building the business case to securing requisite approvals, driving plant setup, and managing operations thereafter.

This includes in-depth market analysis, strong technical knowledge, project management skills, and coordination with vendors, contractors, and internal stake holders.
  
  
**Key Result Areas (Key Performance Indicators)**

* Analyze market for scrap types, supply-demand dynamics, pricing trends, and regulatory changes in the Domestic & International Market
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard partners (yards, aggregators, dismantlers, OEMs, logistics) for obsolete and prompt scrap.
* Identifying required technologies & infrastructure, Prepare capex, business case, board notes, and evaluate land/locations for setting up scrap processing centres.
* Plan and execute projects according to approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards.
* Supervise installation, testing, and commissioning activities.
* Identify project risks, delays, and technical problems and implement corrective actions.

**Critical Tasks**

* Developing Business Framework for setting up Scrap Collection & Processing Centres.
* Identifying the required technology & infrastructure for the processing units such as equipment, land & plant infra, etc
* Ensure equipment selection and design comply with project specifications and applicable engineering standards
* Prepare technical specifications, RFQs, BOQs, and equipment datasheets
* Prepare technical evaluation of mechanical equipment and vendor offers
* Ensure execution is in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and quality requirements.
* Coordinate day-to-day site activities with civil, electrical, instrumentation, and other disciplines
* Carryout commissioning, trial runs, and performance testing of mechanical systems
* Monitor project progress and identify delays, technical risks, and interface issues and initiate corrective actions
* Take over the plant for operation post commissioning

**Educational Background And Work Experience**

* Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering
* 5+ years of working in Project Execution and Supply chain

**Competencies**

* Experience in business development, sales, or supply chain roles within the steel, scrap, recycling, or waste management industry
* Knowledge of local and international scrap market regulations and compliance.
* Project planning and execution
* Site supervision
* Vendor/contractor management
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, SAP etc

title: Solutions Manager
description:
**ABOUT CULTUREMONKEY**

CultureMonkey is an AI-powered employee engagement and experience platform helping organizations build exceptional workplaces through continuous listening, people analytics, and action planning. Trusted across 100+ countries and rated 4.7/5 on G2.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* We are looking for a Solutions Manager who can become the product brain, implementation partner, and trusted advisor for our customers.
* This role sits at the intersection of Product, Customer Success, People Science, and Customer Outcomes.
* Our Customer Success Managers own the relationship and commercial health of the account.
* You will own the actual survey experience. You will make sure every survey is set up correctly, launched smoothly, understood clearly, and used meaningfully after the results come in.
* This is not a support role. This is a consulting role.
* You will guide HR leaders, people teams, sub-admins, and internal champions through the full journey... from first setup to final insights to action planning.
* You should enjoy going deep into the product, asking sharp questions, solving messy implementation problems, and helping customers get real value from CultureMonkey.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own the full survey lifecycle for your accounts, from setup to launch to reporting.
* Understand the customer’s people goals and translate them into the right survey design, platform configuration, and launch plan.
* Run onboarding sessions, product trainings, and walkthroughs for HR teams, sub-admins, managers, and employee champions.
* Guide customers on survey best practices, participation strategy, question design, anonymity, reporting, and action planning.
* Handle technical setup like employee data uploads, CSV and Excel files, custom configurations, integrations, access rules, and reporting requirements.
* Work with the People Science team to deliver reports and insights that match the customer’s real context.
* Partner closely with CSMs to flag adoption risks, unblock customers, spot expansion opportunities, and keep the account journey smooth.
* Raise and track Jira tickets for bugs, backend tasks, feature requests, and product gaps.
* Become the internal voice of the customer for Product and Engineering.
* Run roadmap and product update conversations with customers so they always know what is possible and what is coming next.
* Most importantly, make sure the customer does not just “run a survey”...
* Make sure they actually understand what their people are saying.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, Customer Service, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
* Someone who can learn a product deeply and explain it simply.
* Someone who is comfortable working with HRIS data, employee data files, CSVs, Excel, user attributes, reporting structures, and basic integration concepts.
* A clear communicator who can run a training session with an HR team and also explain technical details to an IT stakeholder.
* Strong project management habits. You follow up, track open items, document clearly, and keep multiple accounts moving without being chased.
* A consulting mindset. You ask good questions before giving answers. You can push back kindly when a customer’s approach may not help them.
* A strong eye for detail. Survey setup, data mapping, anonymity rules, access control, and reporting logic need precision.
* A collaborative nature. You will work closely with CSMs, People Science, Product, and Engineering.Comfort with flexible shifts that overlap with US time zones, because our customers are spread across geographies.

**THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE HOPING TO MEET**

* Someone who can bring calm to complexity.
* Someone who can sit with an HR leader, understand their culture problem, and translate it into a clean survey journey.
* Someone who can tell a customer, “Here's a better way to do this,” with both confidence and kindness.
* Someone who wants to build, not just maintain.
* Someone who believes customer success is not only about renewals...
* It is about making customers feel, “these people really understand us.”

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

title: Content Production Manager
description:
**About The Role**
As a Content Platform Subject Matter Expert, you will make an impact by providing deep specialist product knowledge across enterprise content technologies — including CMS, DXP, headless content, DAM, content supply chain, PIM and content migration — to support client consulting, solutioning, offering development and delivery assurance. You will be a valued member of the Cognizant Moment - Go To Market team and work collaboratively with the Enterprise Multi-Solution Architect, delivery teams and practitioners, and clients.
  
  
**In this role, you will**

* Maintain deep knowledge of your primary content platform — architecture, services, APIs, extensibility, deployment, security and operations — and translate editorial, publishing, asset and product-content needs into practical platform capabilities and implementation patterns.
* Define content models, taxonomy, metadata, workflow, governance and lifecycle patterns, and design multisite, multibrand, multilingual, authoring, publishing, search, SEO and accessibility approaches along with DAM, PIM, creative tooling and channel integrations.
* Lead platform-specific inventory, dependency, migration and modernisation assessments, defining extraction, transformation, loading, validation, reconciliation, redirect and cutover approaches with realistic estimates, assumptions and risks.
* Act as the assigned platform SME across consulting, solutioning, architecture and delivery advisory, partnering with the Enterprise Multi-Solution Architect while owning platform feasibility, patterns, estimates and implementation guidance, and contributing to RFIs, RFPs, proposals, demonstrations and proofs of concept.
* Create reusable reference architectures, playbooks, assessment frameworks and accelerators, guide delivery teams on complex configuration and migration decisions, and identify practical generative AI and agentic opportunities with appropriate security, privacy, governance and human oversight.

**Work model**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Bangalore or Chennai. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* 10-15 years of overall experience in content management, digital experience or content operations.
* At least 5 years of deep experience in a nominated enterprise content platform or product family.
* Experience in enterprise implementation, migration or modernisation as an SME, Technical Architect or Technical Lead.
* Strong understanding of content architecture, APIs, integrations, governance, performance and security.
* Experience supporting client workshops, proposals, estimates, demonstrations and technical presentations, plus working knowledge of at least one adjacent or competing content platform.

**These will help you succeed**

* Hands-on specialisation in enterprise CMS/DXP platforms such as Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Optimizely or Acquia/Drupal, or in headless and composable CMS such as Contentful, Contentstack or Sanity.
* Experience with Digital Asset Management platforms such as AEM Assets, Sitecore Content Hub, Aprimo or Bynder, including asset lifecycle, metadata, rights and renditions.
* Experience with content supply chain platforms such as Adobe Workfront, Workfront Fusion or GenStudio across planning, intake, creation, review, approval and activation.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted migration and classification tooling for inventory, mapping, transformation and quality assurance.
* Ability to connect product capabilities with editorial and business outcomes, mentor practitioners, and contribute reusable offerings without claiming ownership of the overall multi-solution architecture.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: AI Content Marketer
description:
**About CultureMonkey**

CultureMonkey is building HR tech for companies that take people seriously.

We help organisations listen to their people better through employee engagement surveys, lifecycle surveys, pulse surveys, action planning, and people analytics. But the real thing we are building is not just software...

We are helping companies build workplaces where people feel heard, understood, and valued.

We are a fast-growing B2B SaaS company working with mid-market and enterprise customers across geographies. Over a million employees in 150+ countries trust us with something important: the honest voice of how they feel at work.

And the way people find us is changing fast. They do not just Google us anymore. They ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. That shift is exactly where this role comes in.

**About the Role**

* We are looking for an AI Content Marketer who can make CultureMonkey the answer... on Google, and inside every AI engine people now ask first.
* This role sits right between content, SEO, product, and distribution.
* You will write content that HR leaders actually finish. You will make sure it ranks, gets cited, and keeps earning attention long after you hit publish.
* This is not a "write a blog and move on" role.
* This is a role about being remembered.
* You will own how a fast-growing brand gets found, read, and trusted in a search world that AI is rewriting in real time.

**What You Will Do**

* Write content people actually finish. Blogs, case studies, and playbooks that are clear, human, and genuinely useful.
* Write for the answer, not just the algorithm. Content built to rank on Google and get cited by AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
* Use AI as a real part of your workflow, for research, drafting, and scaling, then edit hard so every piece stays accurate, original, and human.
* Run keyword and prompt research in Ahrefs and Search Console to publish content that ranks and holds its place.
* Refresh and re-optimize existing content so top pages keep their rankings as search intent and SERPs shift. Content decay is where organic traffic quietly leaks.
* Build domain authority through internal linking and structured outreach: guest posts, backlinks, and partnerships.
* Distribute with intent across newsletters, LinkedIn, Reddit, and product communities. Right message, right channel, right timing.
* Partner across teams on landing pages, sales and marketing emails, and ad copy, all research-backed.
* Track what matters, from CTR and organic traffic to keyword rankings and visibility in AI answers, and let the data shape the next draft.
* Most importantly... do not just write content that fills a calendar. Write the content that people, and AI, actually trust.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 1 to 2 years in content marketing, content writing, SEO, or a similar role where your writing had to perform, not just publish.
* Someone who writes clearly because they think clearly. Practical, useful, no filler.
* Someone who treats SEO and AI search as strategy, not jargon.
* Someone who uses AI fluently but never blindly. You can tell a sharp draft from generic filler, and you fix the difference.
* Comfort with data. Rankings, CTR, and traffic should tell you what to write next, not intimidate you.
* Strong follow-through. You track open items, hit publish dates, and keep multiple pieces moving without being chased.
* A curious, proactive streak. You would rather test an idea than wait for permission.
* Someone who takes feedback without ego and turns it into sharper work.
* Bonus points if you have played with keyword tools, AI writing tools, or have a portfolio you are proud to show.

**You Will Love This Role If**

* You like writing that actually gets read, not just filed away.
* You enjoy turning a messy topic into a clean, useful piece.
* You get a quiet thrill from watching a page climb the rankings.
* You want to crack how to get cited by ChatGPT and Perplexity, not just Google.
* You like data pointing you to your next move.
* You want your work to have visible impact quickly.
* You enjoy working with people who move fast, care deeply, and still know how to have fun.

**Why Join CultureMonkey**

* You will work on content that genuinely matters to the people reading it.
* You will help companies listen to their employees better, not just push another dashboard.
* You will join a content practice that is still being shaped, so your ideas on process, tooling, and how we win AI search will actually matter.
* You will work directly with a fast-moving team that values sharp thinking, ownership, and honesty over hierarchy.
* You will be part of a team that believes people grow when they are trusted, heard, and given room to contribute.
* We practice what we build for customers: people-first experiences, high ownership, empathy, flexible work, learning, fun, and a real sense of belonging.
* Things move fast here. Decisions happen in days, not quarters. Good ideas travel quickly. And when you do good work, you will see its impact almost immediately.

**The Kind of Person We Are Hoping To Meet**

* Someone who is curious about how AI is changing search, and wants to be early to it.
* Someone who can turn a blank page into something people actually want to read.
* Someone who cares about the reader on the other side of the screen, not just the keyword.
* Someone who wants to build a content engine, not just hit publish.
* Someone who believes great content is not about volume, it is about being the answer people trust.

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

title: Senior Manager, Change Delivery
description:

* Develop and execute change management plans, including stakeholder analysis, communication strategies, and training programs.

* Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies.

* Attention to Detail

title: Lead Drive Control Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.
  
  
Impacts departmental operations and responsible for planning/execution. The role has some autonomy but is focused on execution of activities within an operating discipline covered by standard functional practices and procedures. Some judgment may be required but this is typically with guidance.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Identify, develop, evaluate, introduce, and manage engineering solutions for product control and control system technology needs. Apply control theory and mathematical modeling to design and control systems with desired behaviors. Includes operability, setting of boundaries, cycle optimization, control logic, control related software, sensors, hardware and software algorithms, and feedback to control the performance of devices, subsystems and systems.
* Developing in-depth knowledge of a technical discipline. Uses prior experience and acquired technical expertise to execute policy/strategy.
* In-depth understanding of key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work. In-depth understanding of how work of own team integrates with other teams and contributes to the area.
* Uses some level of judgment and has ability to propose different solutions outside of set parameters but with guidance. Uses prior experience and on-the-job training to solve straightforward tasks. Has access to technical skills and analytic thinking required to solve problems. May use multiple internal sources outside of own team to arrive at decisions.
* A job at this level is likely to be an individual contributor with proven interpersonal skills or an early people leader who can hire and develop talent. Provides informal guidance to new team members

**Required Qualifications**

* For roles outside of the USA- This role requires advanced experience in the Engineering/Technology & Controls Engineering. Knowledge level is comparable to a Master's / Bachelor's degree in Power electronics and Drives and controls from an accredited university or college ( or a high school diploma with relevant experience).
* Lead project engineer having experience in handling multiple project in power electronics based product development and project execution. This role requires, in addition to closely interacting with internal & external customers, strong inclusive team player with outcome focus & willing to work in Agile methodology of execution

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.
* Drive control and PWM techniques, MATLAB circuit simulation and Drive control Software, also microcontroller and FPGA based design and development knowledge is preferable.

Experience in software development & qualification for process industry
  
  
Experience with system level validation testing
  
  
Strong technical aptitude, including applicable engineering tools and systems
  
  

* Note:
* To comply with US immigration and other legal requirements, it is necessary to specify the minimum number of years' experience required for any role based within the USA. For roles outside of the USA, to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, the JDs should focus on the substantive level of experience required for the role and a minimum number of years should NOT be used.

title: Content Production
description:
**About The Role**
As a Content Platform Subject Matter Expert, you will make an impact by providing deep specialist product knowledge across enterprise content technologies — including CMS, DXP, headless content, DAM, content supply chain, PIM and content migration — to support client consulting, solutioning, offering development and delivery assurance. You will be a valued member of the Cognizant Moment - Go To Market team and work collaboratively with the Enterprise Multi-Solution Architect, delivery teams and practitioners, and clients.
  
  
**In this role, you will**

* Maintain deep knowledge of your primary content platform — architecture, services, APIs, extensibility, deployment, security and operations — and translate editorial, publishing, asset and product-content needs into practical platform capabilities and implementation patterns.
* Define content models, taxonomy, metadata, workflow, governance and lifecycle patterns, and design multisite, multibrand, multilingual, authoring, publishing, search, SEO and accessibility approaches along with DAM, PIM, creative tooling and channel integrations.
* Lead platform-specific inventory, dependency, migration and modernisation assessments, defining extraction, transformation, loading, validation, reconciliation, redirect and cutover approaches with realistic estimates, assumptions and risks.
* Act as the assigned platform SME across consulting, solutioning, architecture and delivery advisory, partnering with the Enterprise Multi-Solution Architect while owning platform feasibility, patterns, estimates and implementation guidance, and contributing to RFIs, RFPs, proposals, demonstrations and proofs of concept.
* Create reusable reference architectures, playbooks, assessment frameworks and accelerators, guide delivery teams on complex configuration and migration decisions, and identify practical generative AI and agentic opportunities with appropriate security, privacy, governance and human oversight.

**Work model**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Bangalore or Chennai. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* 10-15 years of overall experience in content management, digital experience or content operations.
* At least 5 years of deep experience in a nominated enterprise content platform or product family.
* Experience in enterprise implementation, migration or modernisation as an SME, Technical Architect or Technical Lead.
* Strong understanding of content architecture, APIs, integrations, governance, performance and security.
* Experience supporting client workshops, proposals, estimates, demonstrations and technical presentations, plus working knowledge of at least one adjacent or competing content platform.

**These will help you succeed**

* Hands-on specialisation in enterprise CMS/DXP platforms such as Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Optimizely or Acquia/Drupal, or in headless and composable CMS such as Contentful, Contentstack or Sanity.
* Experience with Digital Asset Management platforms such as AEM Assets, Sitecore Content Hub, Aprimo or Bynder, including asset lifecycle, metadata, rights and renditions.
* Experience with content supply chain platforms such as Adobe Workfront, Workfront Fusion or GenStudio across planning, intake, creation, review, approval and activation.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted migration and classification tooling for inventory, mapping, transformation and quality assurance.
* Ability to connect product capabilities with editorial and business outcomes, mentor practitioners, and contribute reusable offerings without claiming ownership of the overall multi-solution architecture.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Technical Writer
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Content Development
  
  

* Create, organize, maintain, and reuse documentation assets using the team’s approved content repository and authoring tools (currently Microsoft Word and SharePoint), while supporting future adoption of structured authoring practices.
* Conduct task analysis (TA) and prepare annotated topic lists (ATL).
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and subject matter experts (SMEs) across global regions to gather requirements and deliver project outcomes.
* Develop reusable, structured technical content aligned with Xylem’s authoring guidelines, information model, and style guide.
* Produce and maintain illustrations, graphics, and photo-realistic renderings.
* Ensure the completion of the review cycle and software-assisted checks for grammar, style, and terminology.
* Initiate translation requests and coordinate translation reviews.
* Communicate release updates to stakeholders via designated channels.
* Maintain reusable content and contribute to documentation standards, templates, and information architecture to improve content consistency and scalability.
* Quickly learn new products, custom technologies, and engineering concepts, and accurately translate them into clear, user-focused documentation.
* Contribute to the development of the CCMS structure, templates, and information model.
* Create and maintain Topics, Chaptermaps, Bookmaps, and metadata within the CCMS.
* Demonstrate flexibility in working hours to support collaboration with stakeholders across different time zones, as business needs require.
* Work effectively in a hybrid work environment while maintaining strong communication, collaboration, and accountability.
* Participate in initiatives to enhance documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and content governance.

**Required Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electronics, Aeronautical, Computer Science, or equivalent field).

**Experience**

* 3–6 years of professional experience as a Technical Writer (Senior level) in an international, English-language environment.
* Proven expertise in developing reusable technical documentation using structured or unstructured authoring approaches. Experience with DITA XML and single-sourcing practices is an advantage but not required.
* Basic experience creating technical illustrations in vector or raster formats.
* Experience documenting software, hardware, or custom-engineered solutions, with the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar technologies.

Skills and Competencies
  
  
Core Skills
  
  

* Excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Detail-oriented, structured, and dependable in meeting deadlines.
* Effective communicator with global, cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with Simplified Technical English (STE) and style guides such as the Microsoft or Chicago Manual of Style.
* Understanding of DDLC, SDLC, and Agile workflows.
* Knowledge of single sourcing, metadata management, and conditional profiling.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies, understand engineering customizations, and evaluate their impact on the end-user experience.
* Experience reusing and maintaining content from shared repositories while ensuring consistency and accuracy.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Proficiency in authoring MS Word.
* Experience using Microsoft SharePoint or similar content repositories for document management and content reuse.
* Experience with terminology and content quality tools such as Acrolinx.
* Proficiency with illustration tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Creo Illustrate, KeyShot).
* Experience with collaboration tools like JIRA and Confluence.
* Understanding of content publishing pipelines and localization workflows.
* Experience with structured authoring concepts is preferred. Familiarity with DITA XML, CCMS platforms (such as Astoria On-Demand or AEM), and XML editors (such as Oxygen XML Editor or Arbortext Editor) is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of XML-based formats and related technologies (XQuery, metadata tagging).
* Interest in GenAI and automation using Python or similar programming languages is desirable.

Assessment Process
  
  

* Candidates will complete a writing and structuring test to demonstrate technical English and content organization skills.
* Successful candidates will advance to subsequent interview rounds with technical and hiring teams.

Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: Engineer, Product Applications
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Broadband Plasma (BBP) division is the market-leading optical inspection system used by logic, foundry, and memory customers to detect critical defects at advanced nodes. These tools combine broadband plasma technology with unmatched sensitivity and speed to support high-volume manufacturing.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Application Development Engineer**
**Responsibilities:**

* Customer support: Product value demonstration during beta testing, Head-to-Heads (H2H) and tools in the ramp phase, thereby enabling product penetration/adoption at world-wide customers. This includes-investigating semiconductor manufacturing yield issues and providing inspection solutions; creating & sharing product value statements and use-cases with engineering, marketing and sales groups; training customers and other applications engineers.
* Product Demonstration: Provide specific product demonstrations on all aspects of highly complex products to customers and assess potential applications to meet customer needs
* Product Characterization: Work on test plan development and execute detailed characterization of the tool/algorithm performance and provides clear feedback to the Engineering teams for product improvement, especially during Alpha/Beta tests.
* Problem Diagnosis/Troubleshooting: Respond to customer requests and perform routine to moderately complex problem diagnosis and problem resolution.
* Customer Relationship: Interacts with customers to educate and coordinate activities. Good working knowledge of customer use case and is expected to understand customer needs and improve customer relations.
* Training: Conduct customer product demonstrations and technical training including on-site training of Field Applications Engineers and end users.
* Documentation: Document all test results and lessons learned in BKMs (Best Known Methods), training documents, Demo reports, or, Alpha/Beta test reports and transfer product knowledge to Field Applications teams.
* Presentation/Communication Skills: Generate demo and test reports and strong presentation skills for internal and customer review.

**Requirements:**

* We are looking for high energy, self-driven and motivated engineers who are interested in working in High Tech. The semiconductor space is a fast paced, high stress environment that gives applications engineers a lot of autonomy to work and drive projects on their own. Ideal candidates appreciate the opportunity to have high levels of accountability, working well with limited supervision and thrive in a work environment where they can drive projects on their own.
* Candidate must have Master’s or bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, Material Science, or related fields.
* Must have excellent oral and written communication, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills.
* Candidate must be a strong team player.
* >50% travel will be required

**Minimum Qualifications**
Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*
