title: Engineer - Controls Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.
  
  
Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team. Executes standard operational/technical tasks typically subject to instructions and work routines. There is latitude to rearrange the sequence to complete task/duties based on changing work situations.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Conducts component and product integration. All activities that span multiple components and products and are concerned with how to integrate for maximum performance and operability. Manages product and systems requirements, specifications and flow down. Drives validation and verification activities for the overall product/system, including system level testing. Responsible for defining product requirements for the module / component / subcontractors and partners teams. Manages interface between components and execution organizations. Responsible for driving CTQ / Risk trades within the teams designing the components. Manages the overall product configuration and configuration control system.
* Broadening knowledge of own technical discipline to execute policy/strategy. May include support roles with specialized technical field of knowledge; still acquiring higher level knowledge and skills.
* Basic understanding of key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work. Good understanding of how work of own team integrates with other teams and contributes to the area.
* May have some autonomy to make decisions within a defined framework. Resolves issues in situations that require good technical knowledge and judgment within established procedures. Consults more senior team members for issues outside of defined instructions/parameters.
* A job at this level requires good interpersonal skills and may be required to lead a junior team. For customer facing roles, develops strong customer relationships and serves as the interface between customer and GE. Explains technical information to others.

**Required Qualifications**

* For roles outside of the USA- This role requires basic experience in the Engineering/Technology & Systems Engineering. Knowledge level is comparable to a Master's/Bachelor's degree in power electronics and drives and controls from an accredited university or college ( or a high school diploma with relevant experience).
* Good understanding of C, C++, Matlab and Simulink and other engineering tools and systems . Ability and willingness to work "hands-on" in test labs and Customer sites

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.
* Drive control, product development, control design and real time validation

**Note**
**To comply with US immigration and other legal requirements, it is necessary to specify the minimum number of years' experience required for any role based within the USA.**
**For roles outside of the USA, to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, the JDs should focus on the substantive level of experience required for the role and a minimum number of years should NOT be used.**

Yes

title: Systems Control Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
  
  
Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung.Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und -verfahren abgedeckt wird.Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**

* Führt Komponenten- und Produktintegration durch. Alle Aktivitäten, die mehrere Komponenten und Produkte umfassen und sich mit der Integration für maximale Leistung und Bedienbarkeit befassen. Verwaltet Produkt- und Systemanforderungen, Spezifikationen und den Datenfluss. Führt Validierungs- und Verifizierungsaktivitäten für das gesamte Produkt/System durch, einschließlich Tests auf Systemebene. Verantwortlich für die Definition der Produktanforderungen für das Modul/die Komponente/Subunternehmer und Partnerteams. Verwaltet die Schnittstelle zwischen Komponenten und Ausführungsorganisationen. Verantwortlich für das Vorantreiben von CTQ/Risk-Trades innerhalb der Teams, die die Komponenten entwerfen. Verwaltet die Gesamtproduktkonfiguration und das Konfigurationssteuerungssystem.
* Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen.
* Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen.Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind.Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
* Eine Stelle auf dieser Ebene ist wahrscheinlich ein einzelner Mitarbeiter mit nachgewiesenen zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten oder Führungsnachwuchs, der Talente einstellen und entwickeln kann.Bietet informelle Anleitung für neue Teammitglieder

**Grundqualifikationen**

* Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).

**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**

* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Product Analyst
description:
* Release and catalog service parts in support of inquiry resolution globally for all North America programs
* Analyze Engineering systems, 2D Technical drawings, Teamcenter data, Bill of Material (BOM), Marketing information & other reference data and material to determine the appropriate service part levels required for vehicle repair.
* Analyze current and past model engineering changes to determine service interchangeability between engineered parts.
* Prepare and maintain parts catalogue information, as well as creating new catalogue sections, in the Parts Catalogue Database
* Ensure that all the relevant part information is included in the Catalogue database to support VIN matching in the Parts Catalogue
* Modify and create parts catalogue illustrations in line with established processes whilst ensuring that the artwork specifications are met.
* Provide timely resolution to Dealers, Global teams and Internal Customers inquiries regarding issues related to commodities within your sections of the catalog.
* Support service part needs with Engineering, Service operations and upstream activities to address level of service concerns and to ensure service requirements are corrected.
* Support downstream processes like Purchasing, Supply Chain, Packaging, Quality and Distribution to ensure best in class parts availability in support of customer needs.
* Responsible for delivering departmental objectives related to service part releasing, cataloging and customer inquiries.
* Analyst would Monitor the parts within the work queue and determine, based on vehicle program and Job #1 date, the parts that need to be actioned.
* Analyst would use the information on the SBOM to select the part and review its contents and make the decision to release for service - based on historic release information and/or engineering direction and timing.
* Analyst would collect/gather all available information about the parts and review the Engineering direction and production timing as it pertains to that part.
* Analyst reviews the content and format for the text page of the Catalog and makes the necessary changes to the contents whether in the description, model year or restriction fields, as required to fully provide service part information to the users of the Catalog.
* Analyst should update the usage and application for parts requiring corrections.
* Analyst must ensure all the callouts in the illustrations are matches exactly to text before signoff or approving request.
* Analyst should verify the contents of inquiry or concern with text and/or illustrations by using tools and systems to resolve the external and internal inquires.
* Analyst must resolve catalog inquiries and ensure necessary corrections to catalog / illustrations are completed.

**Hiring Grade - Grade 4**
**NOTE : PLEASE APPLY WITH EXTERNAL PROFILE ONLY**
Candidate should have BE / B.Tech degree with 2-4 years of experience in Automotive companies, OEM, Dealer ship or Aftermarket parts
  
  
Ability to read 2D Technical drawings & CAD data
  
  
In depth knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint & Access. Alteryx/QlikView/Power BI a plus
  
  
Must be detail oriented, a self-starter with an ability to multi-task and adhere to established deadlines
  
  
Excellent oral and written communication skills
  
  
Goal oriented individual with the ability to interpret data, evaluate actions, and reach logical conclusions.
  
  
Candidate should be willing to work late evening shift (Start: 02:00 PM to 11:30 PM)
  
  
Hybrid work schedule, 4 days’ Work from Office and 1 day Work from Home.

title: Quality Specialist - Tamil, AGI Data Services - Quality
description:
**Description**
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
* Support process documentation and implementation

A day in the life
  
  
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams.
  
  
Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams).
  
  
You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.

* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop prescriptive actions

* Demonstrated ability to build or improve quality frameworks, audit processes, or feedback loops.

title: Assistant Manager - Reporting Production Expert
description:
**Description**
**Job Title:**
Assistant Manager
  
  
**Department:**
Asset Management – Investment Operations
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
Reporting Production Expert
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The Reporting Production Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day execution of regulatory transaction reporting obligations across EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II covering both EU and UK jurisdictions, and ASIC Rewrite. The role sits at the heart of the first line of defense for regulatory reporting, ensuring that all reportable transactions are submitted accurately, completely and on time to the relevant Trade Repositories and Approved Reporting Mechanisms across jurisdictions.
  
  
Reporting to the Regulatory Transaction Reporting team, the Production Analyst works as part of a team with interchangeable resources, each expected to operate across all four regulatory regimes and across both EU and UK jurisdictions where applicable. This versatility is essential to ensure business continuity, balance workload across the team, and provide a single, consistent operating standard regardless of the reporting regime. For SFTR and MiFID II, the Analyst is responsible for the hands-on day-to-day production of regulatory reporting. For EMIR and ASIC, which are delegated, the Analyst is responsible for the oversight and monitoring of the production performed by the service provider, ensuring reporting obligations are met.
  
  
The role combines hands-on production (SFTR, MiFID II), oversight of outsourced reporting performed (EMIR OTC, ASIC), oversight of delegated EMIR reporting on ETD performed by clearing brokers, exception remediation, accuracy controls, reconciliations, pairing & matching, and reporting to senior stakeholders. It requires strong attention to detail, an in-depth understanding of regulatory reporting mechanics across EU and UK regimes, and the ability to challenge and monitor an outsourced provider as effectively as performing the reporting directly.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* OVERSIGHT & MONITORING OF OUTSOURCED REPORTING EMIR EU, EMIR UK, ASIC

Perform daily oversight of the EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC reporting production carried out by 3rd party Service Provider (SP), ensuring completeness, accuracy and timeliness of all reporting to DTCC.
  
  
Monitor 3rd party SP daily production, submission status and exception handling, and challenge the provider where standards are not met.
  
  
Review and validate the controls performed 3rd party SP, ensuring they are operating effectively and evidenced.
  
  
Reconcile the internal trade population against the reports submitted by 3rd party SP to identify missing, duplicated or incorrectly reported transactions.
  
  
Track and escalate persistent issues, recurring exceptions or SLA breaches by 3rd party SP to RTR team.
  
  
Maintain documented evidence of the oversight performed, supporting second-line oversight and internal/external audit requirements.
  
  
Act as the point of contact for 3rd party SP on EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC production matters.
  
  

* DAILY TRADE AND TRANSACTION REPORTING ACROSS SFTR (EU AND UK), MIFID II (EU AND UK)

Execute daily production reporting, ensuring all reportable trades and transactions are submitted within the regulatory deadlines.
  
  
Monitor reporting platforms and intraday flows to ensure timely capture and submission of all reportable events.
  
  
Validate report content against source systems post submission.
  
  
Track submission status and ensure all reports reach a final accepted state by Trade Repository or ARM/APA.
  
  

* REJECTIONS AND EXCEPTIONS REMEDIATION

Investigate and remediate all rejections (NACKs) and exceptions raised by the reporting platforms and/or Trade Repository across EU and UK regimes.
  
  
Identify root causes (data quality, mapping, reference data, timing) and apply the appropriate corrective actions.
  
  
Make the necessary amendments and resubmit corrected reports within the regulatory timeframe applicable in each jurisdiction.
  
  
Maintain a clear audit trail of remediation activities for compliance and oversight review.
  
  

* DAILY AND MONTHLY RECONCILIATION

Perform daily reconciliation on SFTR, MIFID, across EU and UK scopes to identify missing, incorrect or duplicated reports, investigate breaks, and implement remediation actions to resolve reconciliation breaks.
  
  
For EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC, reconcile the internal data against 3rd party SP reported output as part of the oversight function.
  
  
Execute monthly reconciliations to validate the consistency between source data, and data submitted.
  
  
Document reconciliation results and escalate unresolved breaks to the Regulatory Transactions Reporting team with proposed resolution actions and timeline.
  
  

* OVERSIGHT OF DELEGATED EMIR REPORTING ON ETD SCOPE PERFORMED BY CLEARING BROKERS

Validate completeness, accuracy and timeliness of reports submitted by clearing brokers.
  
  
Engage directly with clearing brokers to investigate discrepancies, request amendments and ensure corrections are made within the regulatory timeframe.
  
  
Track and escalate persistent issues or recurring reporting failures to RTR team.
  
  
Maintain documented evidence of the oversight performed, supporting RTR oversight and internal/external audit requirements.
  
  

* PAIRING AND MATCHING

Investigate and resolve unpaired or unmatched transactions across EU and UK regimes, engaging directly with counterparties where required.
  
  
Manage UTIs processing in line with internal procedures.
  
  
Monitor and secure pairing and matching rates as a key indicator of reporting quality.
  
  

* REPORTING TO RTR TEAM

Prepare and share daily statistics and dashboards for all jurisdictions (EU and UK for EMIR/MIFID/SFTR and ASIC) covering reported volumes, pairing and matching rates, accepted volumes, rejection rates and remediated volumes.
  
  
Highlight emerging/faced issues, trends or risks to the RTR team in a timely and structured manner.
  
  

* CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT AND KNOWLEDGE SHARING

Identify ad escalate recurring issues.
  
  
Maintain up-to-date procedures, runbooks and knowledge base for all four regulatory regimes.
  
  
Cross-train and support fellow team members to maintain full interchangeability across the team.
  
  
Stay updated with regulatory requirements changes and contribute to impact assessments when changes are announced.
  
  
**Specific Qualifications**

* MANDATORY:

Minimum 2–3 years’ experience in regulatory transaction reporting within the financial services industry (asset management, sell-side).
  
  
Solid understanding of regulatory reporting mechanics: report submission lifecycles, ACK/NACK handling, UTI mechanics, pairing and matching, lifecycle events and action types.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of at least one of EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II or ASIC Rewrite and the ability/willingness to acquire expertise across all four.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to monitor and challenge an outsourced reporting provider, including reviewing their controls, reconciliations and SLA performance.
  
  
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, conditional logic) for reconciliation and reporting purposes.
  
  

* NICE TO HAVE:

Working knowledge of 2 regulatory regimes or more (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite).
  
  
Hands-on experience with platforms such as: Aladdin, TRAX (ARM/APA), Tri-Optima, DTCC, IHS Markit.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Versatility and ability to switch between regimes and reporting flows depending on workload.
  
  
Strong analytical and investigative skills, with ability to perform root-cause analysis on data quality issues.
  
  
Capability to translate reporting issues into clear messages for the RTR team and management.
  
  
Capability to produce presentations and KPIs representative of reporting quality and activities in scope.
  
  
Ability to support colleagues to achieve interchangeability, through documentation, knowledge sharing and active collaboration.
  
  
**Behavioral Skills**

* Active Listening
* Adaptability
* Ability to share/pass on knowledge
* Attention to detail

**Education Level:**
Bachelor’s degree or Equivalent
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai

The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its

Embedded Software Engineer – Automotive (5-6 + Years Experience) (C, MATLAB/Simulink, State flow. Develops, designs, implements and tests software of embedded devices and systems; monitors and enhances the efficiency and stability of the systems.

title: ELN/LIMS configurations expert
description:
**Company Description**
DigAIT is a scientific technology and consulting partner that supports chemical and life sciences organizations in accelerating digital transformation across research, development, laboratory, manufacturing, and operations. The company combines AI, IT, scientific data, and deep domain expertise to design and implement digital solutions that make scientific processes more connected and data-driven. Its capabilities span process modeling, laboratory and manufacturing solutions, data analytics, business intelligence, and advanced AI technologies, including machine learning and generative AI. DigAIT works across the full transformation journey—from assessing current processes to implementing ELN/LIMS, integrating data, and enabling scalable analytics and AI. The team is experienced with leading platforms and tools such as LIMS, ELN, MES, ERP, SAP Signavio, BPMN, Power BI, Tableau, AWS, Azure, Python, and modern AI/LLM platforms.

**Role Description**
For Client based in Europe, we are looking for a ELN/LIMS configurations expert. This role based will be in Chennai, structured as a hybrid position that combines on-site work with some work-from-home flexibility. You will connect lab users, data science teams, and IT, ensuring that experimental data is captured in a structured, high-quality, and ML-ready form. The role combines hands-on configuration, product ownership, roll-out coordination for targeted labs and sites, and IT operations.

**Key responsibilities:**

1. Configurations and trainings

* Work with lab colleagues to design and configure workflows, data uploaders, templates, and master data especially related to formulation development process (materials, formulations, raw materials, test methods, properties, units)
* Translate lab processes in chemistry and material development into robust platform configurations
* Train users, support onboarding, and drive adoption

2. Product management

* Collect, prioritize, and manage requirements from business stakeholders
* Maintain the product backlog and roadmap, and deliver in an agile (Scrum) setup
* Run sprint planning, reviews, and stakeholder communication
* Manage releases, change requests, and configuration testing/validation

3. Integrations and IT operations

* Coordinate the development of integrations between the ELN and other systems (LIMS, ERP, PLM, instruments/CDS, data lakes, analytics/ML platforms) via APIs and interfaces
* Handle incident and problem management, second-level support, and vendor coordination
* Maintain knowledge documentation (configuration specs, SOPs, user guides, FAQs)

4. Roll-out and adoption coordination

* Coordinate roll-out activities end-to-end for specific smaller labs or sites (e.g., HTE lab, a particular site roll-out), building on the platform already established in the larger labs
* Reuse and adapt existing configurations, templates, and master data from the larger labs, and identify only the lab-specific extensions needed (e.g., HTE-specific workflows, uploaders, instrument interfaces)
* Define roll-out plans, timelines, and milestones together with the respective lab leads, IT, and data science teams
* Manage change and communication: stakeholder updates, training, user onboarding, and feedback loops
* Track adoption and roll-out KPIs (e.g., active users, workflow usage, open issues) and hand over to operations with complete documentation and support processes

5. Data governance

* Work with ML/data science teams to define rules for good data management (naming conventions, ontologies, mandatory fields, units, metadata)

**Qualifications**

* PhD or master’s degree in a relevant field such as Material science, Chemistry, physics or a related discipline is preferred.
* Experience with other ELN/LIMS/R&D platforms
  in chemical or life sciences laboratories including workflow design and data model configuration
  (Preferably Formulation data related experience). With PhD a minimum for 2-3 working experience is required and with Masters a minimum of 7-8 years working experience in required.
* Strong knowledge of application integration (REST APIs, data pipelines, SSO/identity, interfaces between lab and enterprise systems)
* Experience with Scrum/agile, backlog management, and stakeholder prioritization. Certifications such as Scrum Master/PSPO, ITIL, or relevant vendor certifications
* Experience with ITIL-based incident/change management
* Candidates should possess clear Communication skills to collaborate with scientists, IT teams, and business stakeholders and to document configurations and processes.
* Good familiarity with data science and ML concepts: data preparation, feature/data requirements, FAIR principles, data modeling
* Ability to work in a hybrid setup in Chennai, manage priorities independently, and adapt to evolving project requirements and technologies.

Join us in creating a unique cultural and architectural destination that celebrates India and inspires future generations.

**Role Description**
The Coordinator will provide project coordination, official communications and administrative support to the Office of the General Manager – Communications. The role will coordinate assigned construction and architecture matters, consultants, statutory follow-ups, correspondence and the day-to-day functioning of the General Manager’s office.

• Coordinate follow-ups with construction teams, architects, engineers, PMC and technical stakeholders.

• Track project milestones, pending submissions, technical review actions and dependencies.

• Arrange project reviews and record instructions, decisions and action items.

• Collect departmental progress updates and escalate unresolved issues.

• Track drawings, revisions, reports, review comments and clarifications.

• Maintain incoming/outgoing correspondence and response follow-up registers.

• Ensure accuracy, confidentiality and appropriate approval before dispatch.

•  Coordinate supporting documents with responsible technical and administrative teams.

• Maintain an approvals tracker and records of official meetings and responses.

• Escalate critical deadlines and outstanding requirements.

**E. Office Administration**

• Coordinate the General Manager’s calendar, appointments, official visits and travel logistics.

• Maintain central action registers, important documents and administrative records.

• Follow up on delegated tasks across departments and protect confidential information.

**F. Executive Reporting**

• Prepare daily priorities, meeting briefs and weekly project/administration updates.

• Support senior leadership and Steering Committee meeting preparation.

• Monitor action closure and promptly flag matters requiring the General Manager’s decision.

**G. Other Duties**

• Support special assignments and additional coordination duties directed by the General Manager.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications or a related field.

• Preferred MBA/Masters in Mass Commission

• Preferably 3–6 years of experience in project coordination, administration or executive office operations.

• Exposure to construction, infrastructure or large institutional projects is desirable.

•Experience coordinating with government departments and senior consultants is advantageous.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

• Strong English drafting, communication and reporting.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace and action trackers.

• Excellent scheduling, stakeholder coordination and follow-through.

• Discretion, prioritization and ability to work under deadlines.

• Tamil Hindi and/or Malayalam is an advantage.

Project coordination - Timely updates on assigned workstreams

•

Milestone tracking - Accurate construction and action registers

•

****Job Description****
The IT Application Support Analyst role is responsible for the end-to-end investigation and resolution of ERP incidents requiring deeper functional or technical expertise, including root-cause analysis, integration troubleshooting, solution validation, documentation, and effective escalation to Level 3 when required.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability****
**Incident investigation and resolution**

* Analyze ERP incidents escalated from Level 1.
* Identify root causes and provide functional or technical solutions/workarounds.
* Reproduce issues and distinguish between configuration, master data, integration, application, and infrastructure problems.

**Functional support**

* Provide expertise across assigned ERP modules and business processes.
* Troubleshoot transactional errors and incorrect system behavior.
* Assist users with complex process or application-related questions.

**Integration troubleshooting**

* Investigate failures between the ERP and connected applications.
* Analyze interfaces, error messages, batch jobs, queues, and data flows.
* Coordinate resolution with other application/support teams when the problem crosses system boundaries.

**Escalation to Level 3**

* Determine when an issue requires development, product expertise, infrastructure changes, or vendor intervention.
* Provide Level 3 with a complete analysis, including reproduction steps, logs, examples, expected versus actual results, and business impact.
* Validate the solution after Level 3 implementation.

**Problem management and root-cause analysis**

* Identify recurring incidents and underlying systemic problems.
* Lead or contribute to root-cause analysis.
* Recommend permanent corrective and preventive actions.

**Change and release support**

* Assess the impact of fixes, configuration changes, and ERP updates.
* Perform functional/system testing and coordinate business validation when appropriate.
* Support deployments and post-deployment verification.

**Monitoring and operational support**

* Monitor critical ERP processes, scheduled jobs, integrations, and interfaces.
* Investigate failures proactively where monitoring is available.
* Ensure critical business processes are restored within agreed service levels.

**Ticket and SLA management**

* Own assigned incidents through resolution rather than simply forwarding them.
* Prioritize according to severity and business impact.
* Maintain clear, accurate ticket documentation and regular communication with users.

**Knowledge management**

* Document solutions, known errors, troubleshooting procedures, and recurring issues.
* Create knowledge articles that enable Level 1 to resolve more incidents independently.
* Share knowledge with other ERP support team members.

**Business and IT coordination**

* Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams.
* Translate business symptoms into technical/functional requirements for specialists.
* Communicate technical findings in language understandable to business stakeholders.

****CRITICAL CAPABILITIES****

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* ERP Functional Expertise
* Strong understanding of core ERP processes and assigned functional areas (BaanIV, Infor LN, or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012).
* Ability to understand how transactions flow across modules.
* Ability to distinguish process, configuration, master-data, and system issues.

**Advanced Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis**

* Systematic investigation of complex incidents.
* Identify symptom vs. root cause.
* Analyze application errors, logs, jobs, interfaces, and transaction history.
* Develop and validate workarounds when immediate resolution is unavailable.

**Integration & End-to-End Process Understanding**

* Understand ERP interfaces with upstream and downstream applications.
* Trace transactions across systems.
* Determine where a failure occurred and which team/application owns it.
* Understand dependencies between ERP, middleware, databases, reporting, and external systems.

**Incident Ownership & Prioritization**

* Take ownership from escalation through resolution.
* Assess business impact, urgency, and priority.
* Drive resolution across multiple technical or functional teams.
* Maintain clear communication with impacted users and stakeholders.

**Technical Analysis**

* Ability to investigate application logs, batch processes, queues, interfaces, and error messages.
* Basic understanding of databases and data structures.
* Ability to perform data analysis and queries where appropriate.
* Understand enough of the ERP technical architecture to engage effectively with developers and infrastructure teams.

****Requirements****

* EDUCATION: Bachelor's Degree/College Diploma in a technical discipline (Engineering or IT related)
* EXPERIENCE: 3+ years of experience as an ERP application support or ERP analyst preferred.
* 3+ years of process improvement, data, or technology project experience would be a strong asset.
* 2+ years of experience working with BaanIV, Infor LN or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012.

**Job Description**
**Recruiting Solutions Project Manager, U.S. Bancorp India**
The Recruiting Solutions Project Manager will support the U.S. Bancorp India Global Capability Center recruiting organization by enabling effective, compliant, and scalable recruiting operations across India. This position will play a central role in preparing and supporting recruiters through training, process and technology enhancements, change management, communications, risk and compliance coordination, and knowledge base management.
  
  
The Recruiting Solutions Project Manager will partner with the India recruiting team, Global Enterprise Recruiting Solutions team, HR Product and Engineering, Legal, Risk, and other key stakeholders to ensure recruiting processes and technology meet local business requirements, support a consistent recruiter and candidate experience, and are successfully adopted by the recruiting organization.

* Lead and support recruiting operations, process, training, and technology initiatives for the U.S. Bancorp India GCC recruiting organization.
* Develop and deliver recruiter training, tools, job aids, and other enablement resources that strengthen recruiter readiness, process adherence, and operational consistency.
* Assess recruiter training needs and translate new or changing processes, policies, and technology capabilities into practical learning materials and communications.
* Partner with HR Product and Engineering teams to identify, document, prioritize, and track recruiting product enhancement requests based on India business and recruiter needs.
* Coordinate and participate in user acceptance testing and post-implementation validation and hyper care for recruiting tools and system changes.
* Identify technology defects, process gaps, and user experience issues, document findings and partner with product team and vendors through resolution.
* Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, and other subject matter experts to ensure India recruiting processes, procedures, communications, and technology configurations align with applicable laws, regulatory expectations, company policies, and established controls.
* Develop and deliver appropriate change management, communication, training, and adoption plans in response to recruiting process, policy, and technology changes
* Monitor adoption of new recruiting processes and tools, gather feedback from users, identify barriers, and recommend actions to strengthen adoption and effectiveness.
* Maintain India recruiting knowledge base content and ensure materials remain accurate, current, accessible, and aligned with global standards and local requirements.
* Serve as a resource for India recruiters and recruiting leaders by addressing questions, identifying appropriate referrals, and supporting resolution of complex process and technology issues.
* Leverage recruiter feedback, operational data, testing results, and adoption insights to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Build strong partnerships across India recruiting, Global Enterprise Recruiting, HR Product and Engineering, Legal, Risk, and other cross-functional teams to drive alignment and successful delivery in a matrixed environment.
* Act as a recruiting operations and enablement subject matter expert by maintaining awareness of evolving business needs, India recruiting practices, technology capabilities, and industry trends.

* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience.
* Five years of experience in recruiting operations, recruiting, change management, HR technology, learning and development, or a related field.

**Preferred Skills/Experience**

* Demonstrated experience supporting recruiting operations, recruiter enablement, HR technology, process improvement, or large-scale organizational change.
* Experience developing and facilitating recruiter training, process education, job aids, presentations, and other enablement materials.
* Knowledge of recruiting processes and technology, preferably including Workday Recruiting, Phenom, or comparable applicant tracking and candidate relationship management platforms.
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements, enhancement requests, use cases, testing scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience supporting user acceptance testing, defect documentation, issue resolution, and implementation of HR or recruiting technology.
* Understanding of India recruitment practices, employment-related compliance requirements, and the importance of partnering with Legal and Risk to translate requirements into practical recruiting procedures.
* Experience developing communications and change management plans that support successful adoption of new processes, policies, and technology.
* Strong technical writing and process documentation skills, including the ability to create clear knowledge articles, standard operating procedures, process guides, and user-facing instructions.
* Ability to synthesize complex policy, legal, risk, process, and technology information into clear and actionable guidance for recruiters.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines.

title: Senior Product Researcher Health Plan (payer) systems
description:
1. Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Product Researcher who is a subject matter expert (SME) in Health Plan (payer) systems, with deep functional knowledge across Member Enrollment, Claims Adjudication, and Payment Management. This person will research emerging market concepts and regulatory changes in the health plan space, translate client and stakeholder requirements into clear, well-structured product inputs, and guide the product team on how new capabilities should be prioritized and sequenced. The ideal candidate combines hands-on payer-domain expertise with strong research and analytical rigor.

2. Key Responsibilities

* Serve as the internal subject matter expert (SME) on core Health Plan systems, including Member Enrollment, Claims Adjudication, and Payment/Provider Reimbursement Management.
* Research emerging trends, technologies, and regulatory changes (CMS, HIPAA, ACA, state Medicaid mandates, etc.) impacting health plan operations and products.
* Gather and analyze client and business stakeholder requirements; translate ambiguous requests into clearly structured, prioritized requirement documents.
* Evaluate new product concepts and features for feasibility, compliance, and market fit before they enter the development pipeline.
* Map end-to-end payer workflows to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities across enrollment, eligibility, adjudication, and payment cycles.
* Partner with Product Managers, Business Analysts, and Engineering teams to sequence requirements into an actionable, correctly ordered backlog.
* Conduct competitive and market research on health plan administration platforms, such as core administration systems, claims engines, and enrollment portals.
* Present findings, recommendations, and requirement structures to senior stakeholders and leadership.
* Mentor junior researchers and analysts on payer-domain concepts and research methodology.
* Maintain a repository of domain knowledge, regulatory updates, and competitive intelligence specific to health plan systems.

3. Required Skills & Qualifications

* 5–8+ years of experience in product research, business analysis, or subject matter expert (SME) roles within the health plan/payer industry.
* Demonstrated hands-on expertise in at least two of the following areas: Member Enrollment, Claims Adjudication, and Payment Management.
* Strong understanding of healthcare regulatory frameworks, including HIPAA, ACA, CMS guidelines, and state Medicaid requirements.
* Proven ability to convert complex client and business requirements into structured, prioritized documentation.
* Experience with core health plan administration platforms.
* Strong analytical and research skills, with the ability to synthesize market, regulatory, and client data into actionable insights.
* Excellent stakeholder management, written communication, and presentation skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Information Systems, or a related field. A master’s degree is a plus.

title: CAPEX Excellence specialist
description:
**Support CAPEX planning, execution and reporting**
Join NKT in a role that connects CAPEX governance, system support, and business improvement across an international organization. You will own day-to-day support, adoption, and continuous improvement of the CAPEX tool, helping teams work with consistent data, reliable reporting, and clear processes. This is a valuable opportunity to contribute to the green transition by supporting investment decisions across the business. Are you motivated by combining systems, process standards, and user support in one role?
  
  
**Keep CAPEX operations stable and consistent**
In this role, you will act as the main business contact for the CAPEX tool and related process standards. You will support users, coordinate incidents and improvement requests with, and help maintain common templates, workflows, and reporting standards. The role also includes governance of master data, backlog prioritization, UAT coordination, and communication around releases and changes. You will work closely with CAPEX project managers, finance, procurement, IT, and process owners to support reliable planning, execution, and tracking across sites and functions.
  
  
**Your Responsibility Will Be To**

* Provide first-line functional support and coordinate further support when needed
* Maintain user guides, SOPs, and training materials
* Govern usage standards, workflows, and documentation requirements
* Support reports and dashboards with consistent KPI definitions
* Coordinate UAT, releases and backlog priorities

You will work across manufacturing sites and shared functions, in close collaboration with CAPEX project managers, site controllers, procurement and IT.
  
  
**Structured communicator with a clear quality focus**
We are looking for someone who is service-minded, and organized, with a practical approach to user support and process governance. You communicate clearly with both end users and management, work carefully with documentation and change control, and are comfortable balancing business needs with standard ways of working. The right person is initiative-taking, detail-oriented, and able to move issues forward while keeping compliance, auditability, and data quality in focus.
  
  
**You Also Have**

* 5+ years of experience in CAPEX controlling, project execution, PMO, finance, or a similar area using CAPEX, ERP, or project portfolio tools
* Experience translating business needs into system requirements and supporting UAT, training, and change management
* Good understanding of data structures, reporting, and integrations with finance or ERP systems
* Experience acting as system or product owner
* Training or certification in ERP/PM systems or project management

**Help improve investment quality for a greener future**
NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We are motivated to establish gender diversity at NKT and encourage all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment.
  
  
In this role, you will be part of a collaborative international setting where you can broaden your skills in CAPEX governance, systems, reporting, and change processes. You will work with colleagues across business functions and sites, contribute to continuous improvement, and support reliable investment planning that matters to NKT’s ongoing journey and the wider green transition.
  
  
“This role is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting systems, process standards, and user needs to create reliable CAPEX planning and reporting across the business,” says Hiring Manager, Karim Damiani
  
  
Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!
  
  
We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 20th November 2026. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.
  
  
We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.
  
  
Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!
  
  
**About NKT**
*NKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and employs 6,500 people. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3.6 billion in 2025. We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com*

title: Hardware Validation Engineer
description:
**Company Brief**

Planys is a deep-tech company developing mission-critical robotic and digital systems for defence and strategic infrastructure. The company designs and builds unmanned systems and advanced sensing solutions across underwater, maritime, and land domains, with a strong focus on naval, coast guard, and army applications. Planys is actively engaged in the development of Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUVs) ranging from small to extra-large platforms, along with ruggedised electronic and digital systems for armoured vehicles.

Leveraging its strong foundation in marine robotics, underwater inspection, and non-destructive evaluation (NDT), Planys integrates defence-grade electronics, sensing, and data analytics to deliver highreliability systems suitable for harsh operational environments. The company combines platform engineering, payload integration, and AI-enabled digital analytics to support situational awareness, asset integrity assessment, and data-driven decision-making for defence forces and strategic asset operators.

Planys, globally recognised for strategic infrastructure solutions, is now focused on creating a strong and enduring presence in the defence sector, delivering indigenous unmanned and digital systems for the Army, Navy, and Coast Guard. (Website: www.planystech.com)

**Key Responsibilities**

* Integrate, validate, and test electrical and electronic subsystems for autonomous and defence-grade platforms.
* Plan and execute system integration, functional validation, and qualification testing.
* Perform environmental and reliability testing, including shock, vibration, temperature, humidity, insulation resistance, and environmental stress testing.
* Execute compliance testing in accordance with applicable defence standards such as
  **MIL-STD-810**
  ,
  **MIL-STD-461**
  , and related specifications.
* Perform electrical validation activities including power-up testing, wiring verification, continuity checks, insulation resistance (IR) testing, and signal integrity verification.
* Validate PCB assemblies, cable harnesses, connectors, grounding, shielding, and electrical interfaces to ensure robustness in harsh operating environments.
* Test and troubleshoot communication interfaces including
  **CAN, RS-485, Ethernet**
  , and other embedded sensor networks.
* Investigate test failures, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Prepare and maintain detailed test procedures, reports, qualification records, compliance documentation, and issue trackers.
* Collaborate closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Embedded, Systems, Manufacturing, and Field Engineering teams to improve product reliability and manufacturability.
* Support product certification activities and coordinate with external test laboratories and certification agencies.
* Own the complete validation lifecycle from component-level verification through subsystem integration, system qualification, and field release.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 2–5 years of experience in electrical system integration, validation, testing, or qualification.
* Strong understanding of electrical schematics, wiring, connectors, PCB assemblies, and embedded electronic systems.
* Hands-on experience with electrical test equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power analyzers, signal generators, insulation resistance testers, and data acquisition systems.
* Experience in troubleshooting complex electrical and electronic systems.
* Familiarity with defence, aerospace, robotics, automotive, marine, or industrial embedded systems is preferred.
* Exposure to environmental qualification and EMI/EMC testing will be an advantage.
* Good documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

title: Growth Strategy Associate
description:
**ABOUT**
**Agnikul Cosmos is a company incubated at IIT Madras and we build rockets that can take satellites up to 500 kg to Lower Earth Orbit (LEO). In May 2024, we successfully completed our maiden launch from our own launchpad (India's first private launchpad). The launch has proven all the new technologies developed by Agnikul and also earned recognition from Honourable Prime Minister of India.**
****As an Growth Strategy Associate in the Office of the CBO, you will work at the intersection of business strategy, market intelligence, commercial partnerships, and government engagement. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role where you will support and drive workstreams that directly influence Agnikul's growth trajectory. You will work closely with the Chief Business Officer and be part of a lean, high-output team shaping Agnikul's positioning in the global new space economy.****
****RESPONSIBILITIES****

* Conduct market research and competitive intelligence on the global and Indian space launch ecosystem - customers, competitors, pricing, and trends.
* Support development of commercial proposals, pitch materials, and business development collateral for domestic and international prospects.
* Assist in tracking and managing relationships with key stakeholders, including potential customers, government bodies, and industry partners.
* Prepare briefing notes, strategy documents, and presentation decks for senior leadership and external engagements.
* Coordinate event participation for Agnikul, end-to-end, including registration, stall building, participation, representation, collaterals - build, dispatch, delivery, display and return post-event follow-ups
* Monitor policy and regulatory developments relevant to the Indian space sector (IN-SPACe, DOS, ISRO) and synthesise implications for the business.
* Coordinate cross-functional inputs to support conference participation, partnership negotiations, and bid processes.
* Track and maintain business intelligence databases - event calendars, competitor activity logs, customer pipelines, and partnership trackers.
* Support financial modelling and business case development for new opportunities, partnerships, or operating models.

Requirements
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and structured thinking - comfortable working with data, numbers, and ambiguous problem statements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Proficiency with standard productivity tools - Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides, and research platforms.
* 0-3 years of experience; fresh graduates with strong internship experience are welcome to apply.
* Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed - we're building rockets, not clocks.

****PREFERRED****

* Prior experience or internship in consulting, investment banking, business development, or a startup environment.
* Familiarity with the Indian space sector - regulatory landscape, key stakeholders, and emerging players will be an asset but not a deal breaker.
* Experience with financial modelling, market sizing, or competitive benchmarking.
* Exposure to government relations, public policy, or regulatory affairs.
* Engineering background that enables productive dialogue with technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple parallel work streams with tight deadlines and close attention to detail.

Benefits
  
  

* You will have a front-row seat to building the commercial engine of one of India's most ambitious deep-tech companies.
* Your work will directly shape how Agnikul wins customers, partners, and market share in the global launch market.
* You will engage with some of the sharpest minds in Indian space policy, technology, and industry.
* You will develop a rare combination of technical literacy and business acumen that few early-career professionals get.
* You will be part of a mission that is literally changing what India can do in space.

title: Lending Documentation Specialist
description:
**Job Summary**

* The Lending Documentation Coordinator position is primarily to support the various business units for the Non-Standard Documentation and, where applicable, Standard Documentation process in accordance with the Credit Documentation Process - General Roles and Responsibilities and any further guidance from the Global Head, LDU.
* It is a critical role in supporting multiple business units across Corporate, Commercial & Institutional Banking and ensuring client delivery through management of the Non-Standard and Standard Documentation processes. Working closely with the Regional Head LDU, this role oversees a broad, holistic perspective of transaction management challenges and requirements in the region.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Support the Regional Head LDU to set and implement the vision, strategy, direction for LDU regionally, consistent with the vision and strategy for LDU Global and in support of the Group's strategic direction and growth aspirations.
* Non-Standard Documentation Process:
* Reviewing/checking bespoke / externally prepared loan documentation for complex, structured or syndicated transactions.
* Ensuring the financing structure and documentation is in compliance with the terms and spirit of the relevant credit approval and the Bank’s policies and procedures (including Operational Risk).
* Working closely with internal legal counsel and engaging and liaising with external counsel where required.
* Reviewing and confirming satisfaction of all required finance documentation, including Conditions Precedent, Conditions Subsequent and legal registrations perfection requirements, policy requirements and approvals via formal handover confirmation to the Credit Risk Control team for the authorisation of client limits.
* Standard Documentation Process:
* Drafting and negotiation of contractual, security and parental support documentation covering uncommitted and committed bilateral facilities in line with credit approvals.
* Drafting and negotiating local and global guarantees within Region and for the wider Bank network.
* Ensuring the financing structure and documentation is in compliance with the terms and spirit of the relevant credit approval and the Bank’s policies and procedures (including Operational Risk).
* Setting and collating all condition precedent/subsequent documentation.
* Engaging external counsel in relation to capacity and authority opinions and ensuring the review and sign of all legal opinions where required.
* Drafting corporate resolutions / reviewing constitutional documentation.
* Reviewing and confirming satisfaction of all required documentation, policy requirements and approvals via formal handover confirmation to the Credit Risk Control team for the authorisation of client limits.

**Business**

* Be a business partner to and independent guardian of the business, achieving the right balance.
* Single point of contact for any transactional escalations and remediation contact.
* Be a business partner to and independent guardian of the business, achieving the right balance.
* Utilise knowledge of business products and execution / funding processes undertaken in region to work with regional / cross-regional business and functions to respond to transaction-related questions.
* Work closely with stakeholders to ensure smooth integration of LDU processes with other processes of the Bank. In particular:
* Ensure that Legal and LDU work in an integrated fashion;
* Work closely with LDU in other regions to reduce duplicative work and ensure logical allocation of work (proposing exceptions to R&R where necessary);
* Ensure that hand-offs between Credit Risk Control and LDU are smooth and efficient;
* Resolve all roadblocks and any points requiring clarity, in collaborative fashion between LDU centres or between Legal and LDU or LDU and CRC.
* Adhere to LDU KPIs, ensuring that these are within thresholds.

**Processes**

* Identify process improvement initiatives / opportunities to drive efficiency across LDU.
* Implement and adhere to standardised operational excellence processes.
* Ensure completion of the LDU Data Activity Tracker in accurate and timely manner to facilitate preparation and management of Management Information including reports and dashboards.
* Support all control checks undertaken by LDU under the Operational Risk Framework (ORF).
* Ensure all LDU management information is updated/supplied promptly and accurately as required by the Regional/Global Heads, LDU.

**Risk Management**

* Mitigate possible risk and escalate to relevant stakeholders on potential identified risks.
* Ensure timely implementation and adherence to the Operational Risk Framework.
* Ensure Control Sample Test reviews are performed in a timely manner.
* Ensure all audit issues are handled in timely and appropriate manner.

**Governance**

* The maintenance of a robust control environment to ensure:
* The execution of documentation is approved by LDU in accordance with the Bank’s policies and the Credit Documentation Process - General Roles and Responsibilities therefore ensuring the Bank is not exposed to unnecessary legal, commercial or regulatory risks.
* The timely processing of documentation and handover of condition precedent documentation to enable limit activation and collateral RWA to optimise revenue generation / return on tangible equity. Ensure the timely processing of any deferred conditions precedent / subsequent.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Client Businesses covered by LDU
* Relationship Managers
* Global Credit Markets
* Credit Risk Approvers / Analysts
* Client Managers
* Legal
* Credit Documentation Unit (CDU) / Credit Risk Control (CRC)
* Global Lending Services
* Stressed Assets Group

**Skills And Experience**

* Manage Conduct
* Manage Risk
* Manage People
* Products and Processes
* Bank Lending
* Business Partnering
* Process Management

**Qualifications**

* Degree in legal, finance or business administration studies
* Legal qualification or equivalent extensive work experience.
* Languages: English
* Relevant experience in a similar finance documentation and transaction management role in the relevant market enabling day-to-day responsibilities to be carried out with minimal supervision.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-moving, demanding environment whilst maintaining high quality output, good analytical skills, risk-based approach and excellent attention to detail. Strong organisational and prioritising skills are essential.
* Strong team player with excellent communication skills in order to effectively liaise with and develop close working relationships with stakeholders and business partners, across various jurisdictions.
* Good level of experience of international loan and security documentation (including LMA, LSTA, APLMA).
* Good level of knowledge of the Bank’s products (including Project & Export Finance, Leveraged & Acquisition Finance, Shipping, Subscription Finance, Commercial Real Estate) in relation to documentation.
* Detailed knowledge of the Bank’s relevant policies and procedures.
* Ability to quickly assimilate complex syndication and bilateral lending deals and product structures.
* Good knowledge of minimum acceptance criteria and collateral verification requirements.
* Good knowledge of the Bank’s standard template documentation.
* Good level of drafting and negotiation skills.

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. **What We Offer**

title: Industrial Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose**

To improve manufacturing productivity, efficiency, quality, and cost competitiveness through systematic analysis of work methods, time and motion studies, process optimization, lean manufacturing practices, automation initiatives, and effective man-machine interface design.

Key Responsibilities

1. Method Study & Work Simplification

* Conduct detailed method studies to identify and eliminate non-value-added activities.
* Develop and implement improved work methods and standardized operating procedures.
* Optimize material flow, workstations, and workplace layouts.
* Apply Lean Manufacturing tools to improve operational efficiency.

2. Time & Motion Study

* Perform time studies and motion studies for manufacturing operations.
* Establish and maintain standard cycle times and manpower norms.
* Develop standard work instructions and productivity benchmarks.
* Analyze operator movements and machine utilization to reduce waste and improve efficiency.

3. SMED (Single Minute Exchange of Die)

* Lead SMED projects to reduce machine setup and changeover times.
* Identify internal and external setup activities and implement conversion opportunities.
* Standardize changeover procedures and train production teams.
* Track and improve setup time reduction KPIs.

4. Process Engineering

* Analyze and improve manufacturing processes to achieve productivity and quality targets.
* Conduct process capability studies and identify bottlenecks.
* Support new product introduction through process design and capacity planning.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Kaizen, and Industrial Engineering techniques.

5. Automation & Digitalization

* Identify automation opportunities to improve safety, productivity, quality, and cost.
* Participate in selection, development, and implementation of automation projects.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Maintenance, and Engineering teams for automation integration.
* Evaluate ROI and performance improvements from automation initiatives.

6. Man-Machine Interface & Ergonomics

* Study operator-machine interactions and recommend ergonomic improvements.
* Design and optimize workstation layouts for safety and productivity.
* Improve visual management systems and operator interfaces.
* Conduct ergonomic assessments and implement corrective actions to reduce fatigue and injury risks.

7. Capacity & Productivity Improvement

* Analyze production capacity and resource utilization.
* Develop manpower planning and line balancing models.
* Monitor OEE, productivity, and efficiency metrics.
* Recommend actions to improve machine and labor utilization.

8. Continuous Improvement

* Lead Kaizen and productivity improvement projects.
* Facilitate problem-solving workshops using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Drive waste elimination projects related to manpower, machines, materials, methods, and movement.
* Support cost reduction and operational excellence initiatives.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Productivity Improvement (%)
* OEE Improvement (%)
* Setup Time Reduction (%)
* Labor Efficiency (%)
* Cycle Time Reduction (%)
* Cost Savings Generated
* Automation Project Implementation Rate
* Capacity Utilization (%)
* Ergonomic Improvement Index
* Number of Kaizen/Continuous Improvement Projects Completed

Qualifications

* Bachelor's / Masters Degree in Industrial Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Production Engineering.
* Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Six Sigma, SMED certification preferred.

Experience

* 5-8 years of experience in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or Process Improvement roles.
* Experience in discrete manufacturing, automotive, auto component, engineering, or industrial production environments preferred.

Required Skills

Technical Skills

* Method Study
* Time & Motion Study
* Work Measurement Techniques
* SMED Implementation
* Line Balancing
* Capacity Planning
* Lean Manufacturing
* Kaizen
* Value Stream Mapping (VSM)

title: BMS
description:
**Job Title - BMS Specialist – Job Description**

**Job Summary:**

**Job location: Chennai**

**Experience: 6 - 12 Years**

We are seeking an experienced BMS Specialist with strong expertise in Battery Management System (BMS) application feature development and implementation for Electric Vehicles (EVs). The role involves leading the design, development, integration, and validation of firmware and control functionalities critical to the real-time operation, safety, and performance of EV battery systems.

The ideal candidate should possess deep technical knowledge in BMS algorithms, embedded software development, functional safety, and battery system validation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Collaborate with the requirements and system engineering teams to develop functional designs and implement Battery Management System (BMS) software features.

• Design, develop, integrate, and validate battery control functionalities for EV battery systems.

• Implement and validate functional requirements using Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulators and real battery systems.

• Work closely with battery design teams and cross-functional stakeholders to gather, analyze, and convert system requirements into functional software requirements.

• Develop embedded software and control logic for safety-critical battery functionalities.

• Configure and customize existing BMS solutions to meet customer-specific application requirements.

• Support DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) activities related to battery controls and systems.

• Develop tools, test procedures, and requirements for End-of-Line (EOL) testing and in-field diagnostics.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to battery systems and safety-critical applications across multiple environments and disciplines.

• Ensure compliance with functional safety standards and best practices for high-voltage battery systems.

• Participate in Agile software development activities, including sprint planning, reviews, and technical discussions.

**Required Qualifications:**

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 8+ years of experience in Battery Management System (BMS) development.

• Strong experience in SOX algorithm development and cell characterization analysis for Li-ion batteries.

• Hands-on experience with MATLAB, Simulink, Stateflow, Embedded Coder, and M-Scripting.

• Experience in model-based development and validation, including MIL, SIL, and PIL testing.

• Strong embedded software development experience using C programming.

• Knowledge and experience in Basic Software (BSW) development.

• Experience with CAN communication protocols and tools such as CANalyzer and CANoe.

• Strong understanding of High Voltage battery systems and associated safety standards.

• Experience working in Agile software development environments.

• Proven analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.

**Good to Have:**

• Knowledge of Battery Pack Design and Development.

• Experience in software development for High Voltage Battery Systems.

• Familiarity with automotive standards and functional safety concepts (ISO 26262 preferred).

• Exposure to EV powertrain systems and battery diagnostics.

**Preferred Skills:**

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to work in cross-functional and fast-paced development environments.

• Strong ownership mindset with attention to quality and safety-critical development practices.

title: Product Support Analyst
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
  
  
**Role summary:**
Resolve customer and production issues for athenahealth’s interoperability network by combining technical support skills with clear communication as a
**Product Support Analyst**
in
**Chennai, India**
. You will support interface and workflow stability, troubleshoot problems, and use your capability to help investigate and validate production data. You will
**report to the**
**Integration Product / Connectivity Support Manager.**
**Team Summary**
The Product Support Analyst supports workflows and projects that improve the efficiency and growth of athenahealth’s interoperability network, often referred to as the backbone. This network enables the transmission of healthcare documents—including lab results, imaging results, patient demographics, charges, appointments, and prescriptions—between athenahealth, clients, and trading partners.
  
  
In this role, you will maintain relationships with interface vendors, participate in production support activities as assigned, and collaborate with internal teams across different geographies as required. You will work closely with the E
**Integration Product / Connectivity Support Manager**
in Chennai to help ensure reliable interoperability outcomes.
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Provide technical support by investigating reported issues across interfaces and production workflows.
* Troubleshoot interface and data flow problems using logs, diagnostic outputs, and established support procedures.
* Communicate status updates, findings, and next steps clearly to internal stakeholders and vendors when applicable.
* Analyze production data to identify symptoms, patterns, and likely root causes.
* Document investigation steps, results, and resolutions in required support records and knowledge bases.
* Coordinate with interface vendors to gather information, validate fixes, and confirm successful outcomes.
* Monitor issue queues and work assignments to ensure timely handling and appropriate escalation.
* Apply AI-enabled support tools to improve productivity by using AI-assisted summarization of incident details, faster extraction of key troubleshooting signals from logs, and learning updated AI workflows as they become available—while maintaining accurate human verification against technical evidence and SOPs.

**Additional Job Responsibilities**

* Assist with root-cause follow-ups and prevention plans for recurring interface issues.
* Support testing activities for interface changes, including validating outcomes and documenting results.
* Contribute to creation or updates of interface troubleshooting guides and escalation procedures.
* Participate in production readiness activities (e.g., knowledge checks, handoff preparation, standard work updates).
* Review incident trends to recommend improvements to monitoring, documentation, or support workflows.
* Help ensure consistent data handling and adherence to operational support standards.
* Support cross-team investigations involving multiple systems or dependencies.

**Expected Education & Experience**

* 1–3 years of experience in technical support, production support, integrations, or a related technology operations role.
* Strong technical support background with experience troubleshooting production or interface issues.
* Good communication skills for coordinating incident details, updates, and resolutions.
* SQL experience for querying and analyzing production or troubleshooting-related datasets.
* Familiarity with interoperability concepts (e.g., interfaces, EDI/healthcare data exchange workflows) is helpful.
* Ability to work with logs, troubleshoot systematically, and document findings accurately.
* Comfort working in a hybrid environment based in Chennai, India.
* Willingness to follow established support procedures and escalation paths.

**Travel:**
NA % travel annually.

*employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. *workspaces*
—
*some offices even welcome dogs.*
*We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,*
