*Fuller is where that happens.*
**About The Role**
As a Senior Control System Specialist, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, and commissioning of Plant Control System (PCS) projects for the cement industry. You will lead technical activities throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring high-quality, on-time delivery while collaborating with customers, project teams, and global stakeholders.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities :**

* Lead the design, development, configuration, testing, and commissioning of Plant Control System (PCS) solutions for cement industry projects.
* Manage and execute all phases of the project lifecycle, from engineering and development through testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Develop and review control system architecture, functional design specifications, control narratives, I/O lists, and engineering documentation.
* Configure and program PLC, DCS, HMI, and SCADA systems in accordance with project requirements and industry standards.
* Perform hardware engineering activities, including I/O assignment, network design, panel integration, and system validation.
* Conduct Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), and commissioning activities to ensure system performance, reliability, and compliance.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, customers, consultants, and site personnel to ensure successful project execution.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the required quality and safety standards.
* Provide technical support during installation, startup, commissioning, and system handover at customer sites globally.
* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of engineering standards, best practices, templates, and design procedures.
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance to support team capability development.
* Identify project risks, resolve technical issues proactively, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

**You bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of hands-on experience in industrial automation, process control, or plant control system engineering.
* Strong understanding of cement plant processes and industrial automation systems.
* Proficiency in interpreting Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), control philosophies, and functional specifications.
* Extensive experience in PLC/DCS engineering, including programming, configuration, troubleshooting, and commissioning.
* Hands-on experience with automation platforms such as Siemens, Rockwell, ABB, Schneider Electric, or equivalent systems.
* Experience with SCADA/HMI development, visualization design, alarm management, and operator interface configuration.
* Knowledge of industrial communication protocols including Modbus, PROFIBUS, PROFINET, Ethernet/IP, DeviceNet, OPC, and related technologies.
* Experience with Intelligent Motor Control Centers (iMCCs), variable speed drives (VSDs), and field instrumentation integration.
* Proven experience in FAT, SAT, site commissioning, startup support, and customer acceptance activities.
* Familiarity with ECS/ControlCenter solutions is an advantage.
* Strong project planning, problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in multicultural and global project environments.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and committed to continuous learning and professional development.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally for project execution, commissioning, and customer support.

We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*

Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.
  
  
No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.

Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. description: Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the FutureAt Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. title: Document Coordinator
description:
**Are you looking for a next step in your professional career?**
Join us as a
**Document Coordinator**
and play a key role in ensuring accurate, timely, and efficient document management across projects. You will work closely with customers, vendors, and project teams to manage document flow, maintain compliance with documentation schedules, and support successful project execution. In this role, your organization, attention to detail, and ability to work independently will directly contribute to delivering project documentation on time and according to contractual requirements.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Managing project document flow between Company and Customer in accordance with contract document schedule; managing electronic documents through document publication systems introduced by Company or Customer.
* Managing project document flow between Company and Vendors in accordance with contract document schedule; managing electronic documents through document publication systems introduced by Company.
* Determining of Customer documentation requirements and preparing documentation instructions accordingly for the Project and Vendors.
* Customer Document publication system training and support for the Project.
* Controlling document delivery schedule and readiness of project documents when delivered to Customer or received from Vendors.
* Controlling erection drawing deliveries to project sites in accordance with document schedule.
* Manage project document flow between the company and customers in line with contract document schedules.
* Manage project document flow between the company and vendors according to agreed documentation schedules.
* Administer document version control, language versions, and backup procedures in line with company guidelines.
* Prepare project documents in master formats suitable for distribution through paper copies, web platforms, and electronic systems.
* Publish and manage electronic documents through customer and company document management systems.
* Determine customer documentation requirements and prepare documentation instructions for project teams and vendors.
* Provide training and support on customer document publication systems to project teams.
* Monitor document delivery schedules and ensure project documents are ready before submission to customers or receipt from vendors.
* Control erection drawing deliveries to project sites according to established document schedules.
* Arrange document distribution and provide copying and administrative documentation support as required.

Expectations from you
  
  

* 4 years of relevant experience in document control, document management, or project administration.
* Experience managing document flow between multiple stakeholders, including customers, vendors, and project teams.
* Knowledge of document version control, document distribution, and backup processes.
* Familiarity with electronic document management and publication systems.
* Ability to coordinate documentation schedules and maintain accurate project records.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple documentation activities simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative, and apply sound judgment in problem solving.
* Experience supporting documentation requirements in project environments.
* Comfortable working within a primarily national geographical scope.

To succeed in this role
  
  
Success in this role requires experience managing project documentation throughout its lifecycle, strong coordination skills, and the ability to maintain accuracy while handling multiple documentation activities. You will need to effectively manage document schedules, collaborate with customers and vendors, and ensure documentation requirements are met on time. The ability to work independently, take initiative, and maintain high standards of document control is essential.
  
  
We Also Expect You To Align With Valmet’s Leadership Principles, Practical Behaviors That Guide How We Lead, Collaborate, And Succeed Together
  
  

* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
* Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value

We offer
  
  
You will be part of a team that supports project execution through effective document control and administration. The team manages documentation requirements between customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders, ensuring documents are prepared, distributed, tracked, and delivered according to project schedules and contractual requirements. You will contribute to maintaining documentation quality, enabling efficient communication, and supporting successful project delivery. The role offers opportunities to develop expertise in document management systems, project coordination, and stakeholder collaboration while working independently on varied documentation activities.
  
  
Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with opportunities to contribute to business success. You will work in a collaborative and professional environment that supports learning, development, and continuous improvement. We value our employees and provide modern tools, learning opportunities, and an environment where you can grow both professionally and personally.
  
  
When everything works together
  
  
*Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views. Join the team and lead the way with us!*

title: Commercial excellence coordinator
description:
**Coordinate tender governance and project review processes**
Are you interested in supporting commercial governance and decision-making in a global organisation? As a Commercial Excellence Coordinator, you will coordinate tender approval and project review activities across Grid Solutions, helping ensure consistent commercial execution, effective risk management, and sustainable competitiveness. This is an opportunity to work with international teams, senior stakeholders, and cross-functional partners while contributing to the continued growth of NKT. Do you want to be part of a collaborative global environment?
  
  
Coordinate commercial reviews across global teams
  
  
As a Commercial Excellence Coordinator, you will support the tender approval and project review processes across Grid Solutions. The role focuses on planning, documentation management, stakeholder coordination, meeting administration, workflow support, and process development. You will work closely with commercial teams, project execution teams, finance, and leadership stakeholders to ensure information is accurate, distributed on time, and properly documented. Your contribution will help maintain governance standards, improve decision-making, and ensure consistency across regions and hubs.
  
  
**Your Responsibility Will Be To**

* Coordinate tender approval meetings, agendas, participants, and documentation according to approval requirements
* Manage document quality reviews, distribution, archiving, and approval records
* Prepare and distribute decisions, actions, and meeting minutes within agreed timelines
* Coordinate project review meetings based on project risk categorisation and governance requirements
* Maintain workflow automation tools and support continuous process improvements

This position reports to the Head of Commercial Excellence and collaborates with global Grid Solutions stakeholders across commercial, project execution, installation management, finance, and leadership teams. Location: NKT office location to be confirmed. Limited travel may be required.
  
  
**Organised coordinator with effective stakeholder collaboration**
The ideal person enjoys bringing structure to complex activities, managing competing priorities, and working with colleagues across different locations and functions. They communicate clearly, build trusted working relationships, and maintain attention to detail even when handling multiple deadlines. They are accountable, consistent, and committed to high-quality outcomes. A continuous improvement mindset and an interest in improving processes and ways of working will support long-term performance in this role.
  
  
**You Also Have**

* Relevant degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, or equivalent
* Experience maintaining process methodologies, templates, and guidelines for tender and/or project reviews
* Experience working in global matrix organisations
* Basic understanding of risk management and project governance principles
* Professional written and spoken English
* Experience with SharePoint and Power Automate

Contribute to efficient decisions for a greener tomorrow
  
  
We aim to create a workplace where people of all backgrounds are valued, supported, and able to do their best work.
  
  
We are dedicated to increasing gender diversity at NKT and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. We welcome varied backgrounds and career paths—even if you don’t meet every single requirement. We believe inclusive teams contribute to positive results and create a better everyday work environment.
  
  
This role offers opportunities to develop your career within an international organisation while collaborating with colleagues across regions and functions. You will expand your knowledge of commercial governance, project reviews, workflow automation, and stakeholder management while contributing to process improvements that support NKT’s continued growth and the green transition.
  
  
Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!
  
  
We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than
**31st October 2026**
. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.
  
  
We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.
  
  
Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!
  
  
**About NKT**
*Join a diverse and international team within NKT’s Grid Solutions business, supporting the delivery and operation of reliable power grids worldwide. We deliver HVAC onshore cable systems and provide specialist service for AC and DC cable systems onshore and offshore. As a global organisation with operations across Europe, Australia, the United States, and the Middle East, Grid Solutions works closely with customers around the world and across the full lifecycle of power cable systems.*
*At NKT, we are all Connectors. We connect to develop leading power cable technologies that enable the world’s transition to renewable energy - and we stay connected to grow as people and professionals. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling reliable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology, building the infrastructure from the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today.*
*NKT is headquartered in Denmark, operates from more than 30 countries worldwide, and employs 6,500 people globally. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3.6 billion in 2025. NKT - We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com*

title: Catalog Manager
description:
**Job Summary** 




 The Catalogue Executive is responsible for managing the organization's product catalogue across all categories, ensuring every product is accurately represented in catalogues, quotation tools, and internal systems. The role focuses on catalogue accuracy, product data management, new product launches, SKU management, pricing updates, and supporting seamless collaboration between Category, Procurement, Design, Sales, Operations, and Technology teams. The objective is to maintain ascalable, standardized, and error\-free catalogue that enables excellent customer experience and
 



 efficient business operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Catalogue Management:** 



* Manage and maintain the master product catalogue, ensuring all product information is accurate, standardized, and up to date across all cities and platforms.
* Create, modify, and archive product records, ensuring discontinued products are removed and new products are added as per approved timelines.
* Maintain a consistent category hierarchy, product groupings, and catalogue version control.



  





**2\. Product Data Management:** 



* Ensure complete and accurate product information, including specifications, dimensions, finishes, materials, warranties, images, and descriptions.
* Validate product data received from vendors and internal stakeholders before publishing it in the catalogue
* Maintain data consistency across catalogues, quotation tools, and other business systems.



  





**3\. Pricing Management:** 



* Update product pricing, discounts, and commercial information based on approved price revisions from the Category and Procurement teams.
* Verify pricing accuracy before releasing updates to ensure error\-free quotations and customer proposals.
* Maintain historical pricing records and support periodic price revisions.



  





**4\. Product Launch Management:** 



* Coordinate the end\-to end catalogue readiness for new product launches, ensuring all product information, images, pricing, and documentation are available.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to ensure products are launched within committed timelines.
* Support the preparation of product launch materials, catalogues, and internal communication.



  





**5\. SKU Management:** 



* Create and maintain unique SKU codes for all products while ensuring there are no duplicate or incorrect entries.
* Update SKU mappings whenever products are modified, discontinued, or introduced.
* Maintain the master SKU database to support inventory, quotation, and reporting systems.



  





**6\. Quote Builder \& System Management:** 



* Coordinate with the Tech team to upload new products, pricing updates, and configuration changes into the Quote Builder and related systems.
* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate data accuracy before system releases.
* Report and follow up on system issues to ensure minimal disruption to business operations.



  





**7\. Vendor Coordination:** 



* Liaise with vendors to collect product catalogues, images, specifications, pricing, warranty information, and other required documentation.
* Follow up with vendors to ensure timely submission of updated product information.
* Maintain organized records of all vendor documents and communications.



  





**8\. Documentation Management:** 



* Maintain and regularly update product rate cards, technical specifications, installation guidelines, comparison sheets, and other catalogue\-related documents.
* Ensure all documentation follows company standards and version control practices.
* Support the preparation of internal reference documents for Sales, Design, and Operations teams.



  





**9\. Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 



* Collaborate closely with Category, Procurement, Partners to ensure seamless catalogue updates.
* Communicate product changes, launches, and pricing revisions to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.
* Support cross\-functional initiatives aimed at improving catalogue quality and business efficiency.



  





**10\. Catalogue Quality Control:** 



* Conduct regular audits to verify the accuracy of product information, pricing, images, specifications, and category mappings.
* Identify and resolve catalogue discrepancies before they impact customer quotations or project execution.
* Recommend process improvements to enhance catalogue accuracy, consistency, and operational efficiency.



  





**Educational Qualification:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Data Management or Information Management, or a related field.
* Experience in the Interior Industry is an added advantage.



  





**Experience:** 



* Minimum 2 years of experience in Catalogue Management, Product Management, Procurement Coordination, or Data Management.



  





**SKILLS REQUIRED:** 



* Advanced Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
* Data Validation
* Basic ERP/CRM understanding
* Version Control Behavioural Skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to coordinate effectively with cross\-functional teams and external vendors
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Process\-oriented with a focus on continuous improvement
* Ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to work
* Adaptability and willingness to learn new systems and processes

description:
****General Responsibilities****
* Act as the first technical contact of the project internally \& externally .

* Report progress and escalate critical issues to the Project Manager or R\&D Manager as required.
* Adhere to the specified development processes to ensure compliance with organizational (PDP, CPM, …) and industry standards (ASPICE, …).


**Accountable For The Deliverables**

* Manage the Bill of Material and associated product cost: ask for DtC activity if deviation to respect BOM cost target.
* Applies Standardization rules, exceptionally will request de\-standardizations based on sound justifications


****Responsible for the R\&D detailed budgeting****
* Contribute to identifying R\&D needs, including resources, equipment, and investments required for successful project execution for CAAV
* Responsible for budgeted R\&D hours approved in CAAV/Budget and/or IAR
* Monitor and track R\&D hours and EBOM baseline , ensuring alignment with CAAV/Budget along the project, developing "back\-on\-track" plans if deviations occur.
* Identify and document Engineering Change Requests (ECRs) as needed during the project lifecycle. Ensure the consolidation and communicate their impacts to the PM. No work on change implementation should proceed unless the additional budget is approved by PMC and updated in STR.
* Conduct monthly forecasts to estimate remaining work and ensure alignment with CAAV/Budget through the PRCL milestone.


****Responsible for the detailed scheduling****
* Develop and manage the L2 schedule, ensuring R\&D activities align with key customer and organizational milestones.
* Develop a detailed breakdown of R\&D activities to meet project milestones and align with the overall schedule.


****Manage R\&D contributors****
* Daily management of 1st level R\&D contributors \- disciplines dedicated to the project, assign to them the work packages and tasks needed, according to project needs and ensure timely delivery of assigned tasks.
* Lead weekly R\&D meetings with all contributors, focusing on key issues such as the SLI (Single List of Issues), schedule critical paths, and budget management. Documented discussions with clear meeting minutes.
* Ensure synchronization between disciplines by coordinating internal milestones and maintaining alignment across teams.
* Facilitate and arbitrate technical solutions in collaboration with discipline contributors when required.
* Conduct regular reviews with relevant stakeholders to ensure alignment between project needs, resource availability, and deliverable timelines.


****People Hierarchical Management** 
**(only Principal Product Technical Leader, in the case of leading a team of PTLs)****
* Manage his/her team: continuous team animation, perform annual appraisals, establish objectives, ….
* Competencies Evaluation \& Identify gaps, define and implement the proper action plan (training plan or others)
* Responsible for training plan achievement on his/her team.
* Perform Weekly One On One R\&D Meeting
* Participate with the team on problem solving if needed and to be focused on crucial corrective actions follow up till closure as planned

title: Martime Digital Library - Editor
description:
***Company : Evomarine Inc, USA***




***Location : Chennai***




***Work Type : Contract***




***Position : Maritime Digital Library Content Editor***




  





  





  





**1\. Technical Knowledge Library** 




  





 This to create a centralized technical library that will become the knowledge base used by the
 



  





 The documents themselves should be stored in a controlled company repository, preferably Microsoft SharePoint, with proper permissions, revision control and document ownership.
 



  





 I propose the following main folders:
 



  





 \* IMO / International Maritime Regulations
 



   \* SOLAS
 



   \* MARPOL
 



   \* relevant IMO Codes and circulars
 



   \* fire safety requirements
 



   \* lifesaving requirements
 



   \* pollution prevention requirements
 



 \* Classification Society Rules
 



   \* ABS
 



   \* DNV
 



   \* Lloyd’s Register
 



   \* Bureau Veritas
 



   \* IACS Unified Requirements / Unified Interpretations
 



 \* U.S. Navy / NAVSEA
 



   \* NAVSEA Standard Items
 



   \* JFMM requirements
 



   \* applicable NAVSEA technical manuals
 



   \* MIL\-SPEC
 



   \* MIL\-STD
 



   \* Qualified Products / approved material requirements where applicable
 



   \* welding, NDT, piping, electrical, coatings and preservation requirements
 



 \* MARAD / U.S. Government Maritime
 



   \* applicable MARAD vessel specifications
 



   \* USCG requirements
 



   \* 46 CFR requirements
 



   \* vessel\-specific technical specifications
 



   \* ABS requirements applicable to government vessels
 



   \* contract\-specific requirements
 



 \* Engineering Standards
 



   \* ASME
 



   \* ASTM
 



   \* AWS
 



   \* ISO
 



   \* IEC
 



   \* IEEE
 



   \* NFPA
 



   \* API standards where relevant
 



   \* NACE / AMPP where relevant for corrosion and coatings
 



 \* Manufacturer Technical Documentation
 



   \* valve manufacturers
 



   \* pump manufacturers
 



   \* HVAC manufacturers
 



   \* electrical equipment
 



   \* automation
 



   \* piping systems
 



   \* GRE/GRP
 



   \* steel
 



   \* cables
 



   \* switchboards
 



   \* sensors
 



   \* motors
 



   \* heat exchangers
 



   \* filters
 



   \* sewage systems
 



   \* BWTS
 



   \* scrubber equipment
 



   \* etc.
 



 \* EvoMarine Internal Knowledge
 



   \* previously approved BOMs
 



   \* previous RFQs
 



   \* successful suppliers
 



   \* approved technical submittals
 



   \* previous material substitutions
 



   \* lessons learned
 



   \* NCRs
 



   \* commissioning issues
 



   \* preferred manufacturers
 



   \* historic pricing
 



   \* delivery performance
 



   \* supplier ratings
 



   \* technical clarifications from previous projects
 



  





 All standards and controlled documents must be obtained legally from the official publisher, classification society or approved subscription service.
 



  





 We should not build the system around uncontrolled PDF copies from the internet.
 



  





**2\. Technical Requirement Matrices** 




  





 Uploading standards is not enough.
 



  





 We need to convert engineering knowledge into structured rules.
 



  





 For every major material category, we should create a Technical Requirement Matrix.
 



  





 For example, for a valve, the system should know that “3\-inch valve” is not enough information.
 



  





 Before procurement can proceed, it should check for information such as:
 



  





 \* valve type
 



 \* nominal diameter
 



 \* pressure rating
 



 \* design pressure
 



 \* operating pressure
 



 \* design temperature
 



 \* operating temperature
 



 \* fluid/service
 



 \* material of body
 



 \* trim material
 



 \* seat material
 



 \* end connection
 



 \* flange standard
 



 \* actuator/manual operation
 



 \* fail\-open/fail\-close requirement
 



 \* fire\-safe requirement
 



 \* class approval
 



 \* marine approval
 



 \* testing requirements
 



 \* certification requirement
 



 \* applicable standard
 



 \* quantity
 



 \* delivery location
 



 \* required delivery date
 



  





 If mandatory fields are missing, the AI should automatically return questions to the Project Manager or Engineer.
 



  





 The same approach should be developed for:
 



  





 \* pipes
 



 \* fittings
 



 \* flanges
 



 \* valves
 



 \* pumps
 



 \* motors
 



 \* cables
 



 \* electrical equipment
 



 \* instrumentation
 



 \* HVAC
 



 \* heat exchangers
 



 \* structural steel
 



 \* welding consumables
 



 \* insulation
 



 \* coatings
 



 \* GRE/GRP
 



 \* machinery
 



 \* automation components
 



  





 Each technical family should have its own checklist.
 



  





**3\. Hierarchy of Technical Requirements** 




  





 The system must understand that not every project follows the same standards.
 



  





 The applicable rules should depend on the project.
 



  





 For example:
 



  





 Commercial / Cruise vessel:
 



  





 Contract / Client Specification
 



 → Classification Society
 



 → IMO/SOLAS/MARPOL
 



 → Engineering Standard
 



 → Manufacturer Requirement
 



  





 U.S. Navy project:
 



  





 Contract / SOW
 



 → NAVSEA requirements
 



 → NAVSEA Standard Items / JFMM / applicable MIL\-SPEC
 



 → ABS or other class requirements if applicable
 



 → engineering standards
 



 → manufacturer requirements
 



  





 MARAD project:
 



  





 Contract / Vessel Specification
 



 → MARAD / USCG requirements
 



 → 46 CFR
 



 → ABS/class
 



 → applicable engineering standards.
 



  





 The AI must never assume that one standard automatically overrides another.
 



  





 The hierarchy must be configured by project.
 



  





  





 Qualification :
 



 M. Tech in marine Engineering
 



 Must have Sailing Experience or Working knowledge of the Maritime Laws and Codes and Standards

 Are you a seasoned structural engineer with deep expertise in Tekla Structures who thrives on solving complex technical challenges and guiding clients toward operational success? **About Us**
 Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose\-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
   

  

**Our Division:** 
 Trimble's Professional Services team provides the strategic framework, technical onboarding, and implementation rigor that enable engineering and detailing firms to maximize ROI from their software investments across the structural lifecycle.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Great**
 Reporting directly to the Manager of Professional Services, Training \& Onboarding (India), you will serve as the trusted technical advisor for net\-new and existing Tekla Structures accounts across India. You will have full ownership over discovery meetings, workflow customization, and client success roadmaps. Working at the intersection of sales, customer support, and global product development, you will play a central role in conveying real\-world customer feedback directly back to core engineering teams to influence future software capabilities.
   

  

 Key Exciting Responsibilities
   

  

* End\-to\-End Onboarding Execution: Lead full\-lifecycle software onboarding and implementation programs for new and existing clients utilizing Tekla Structures (Steel and Concrete configurations).
* Workflow Discovery \& Problem Solving: Conduct deep\-dive technical discovery sessions to analyze client requirements, troubleshoot output customization challenges, and engineer tailored structural detailing workflows.
* Implementation Collateral \& Best Practices: Develop high\-grade onboarding materials, system configurations, and best\-practice guidelines that empower clients to adopt optimal structural detailing standards.
* Project Delivery \& Client Tracking: Help clients establish realistic deployment milestones, deliver ongoing technical guidance to protect timelines, and meticulously track project deliverables and engagement logs.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Value Advocacy: Serve as the primary onboarding anchor across Sales, Support, and Product Development teams, while actively presenting the value of Professional Services to prospective clients.


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Tekla Structures Deep\-Dive Expertise: 4–5 years of direct, hands\-on experience using Tekla Structures across Steel and Concrete modules.
* Domain \& Industry Experience: 6–7 years of hands\-on structural detailing and design experience with strong domain mastery in structural steel and reinforced concrete workflows.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil, Structural, or Mechanical Engineering.
* Communication \& Engagement: Fluent written and spoken English with exceptional interpersonal skills to command credibility across client C\-suites and job\-site engineering teams.
* Independent Execution: Strong diagnostic capability to troubleshoot software issues independently, manage tight schedules, and drive project success with minimal supervision.


**Bonus Points For**
* Multilingual Capability: Fluency in spoken Hindi to engage effectively across diverse regional client bases in India.
* Global Design Codes: Direct experience executing structural detailing projects according to international engineering codes and standards.
* Customer\-Centric Mindset: Highly organized, detail\-oriented approach with an eagerness to learn complementary Trimble software products.


**Logistics**
* Location: Chennai.
* Job Type: Full\-Time.


 Why You'll Love Working With Us
   

  

 At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real\-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
   

  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose\-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like\-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self\-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.


****How to Apply:****
 Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

 At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. * Develops and conduct peer reviews of the business requirements to ensure that requirement specifications are correctly interpreted.
* Assists with the interpretation of customer requirements into feasible options, and communicating these back to the business stakeholders.
* Manages and tracks the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine as necessary.
* Communicates changes, enhancements, and modifications of business requirements — verbally or through written documentation — to project managers, sponsors, and other stakeholders so that issues and solutions are understood.
* You will report to manager \- IT


**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

 Communicate the plan and priorities for the Program Increment and define the PI goals
   

  

 Drive release behavior, incenting discipline and quality over speed
   

  

 Determine resource requirements and partner with Tech Lead or Business Owner on sourcing talent
   

  

 Integrates change management elements needed to support the desired state;
   

  

 Track key delivery issues and risks and escalating as needed.
   

  

 Accountable for validation of acceptance criteria met before accepting completed features and definition of done
   

  

 Overall responsibility to manage the Epic and Feature backlogs and Themes for measuring to key objectives, value delivery.
   

  

 Collaborate and shape design, development and implementation requirements with partners and engineering team members.
   

  

 Be responsible for training and support documentation, as well as business readiness \& service transition
   

  

 Provides consultative support in financial management, organizational change, vendor management, and operational excellence to business lead technology initiatives and to our business or enterprise shared services teams

title: Hardware Functional Safety (FuSa) Specialist
description:
**Enabling a software\-defined, electrified future.**
 Visteon is a technology company that develops and builds innovative digital cockpit and electrification products at the leading\-edge of the mobility revolution. Founded in 2000, Visteon brings decades of automotive intelligence combined with Silicon Valley speed to apply global insights that help transform the software\-defined vehicle of the future for many of the world’s largest OEMs. The company employs 10,000 employees in 18 countries around the globe. To know more about us click here .
   

  

**Mission of the Role** 
**:** 
 The Functional Safety Specialist is responsible for ensuring that automotive electronic systems comply with ISO 26262 and related safety standards. The role involves safety concept creation, hazard analysis, safety requirements engineering, technical safety architecture, verification planning, and supporting hardware/software teams through the full safety lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Functional Safety Lifecycle Management
* Lead and execute activities across the ISO 26262 V\-model safety lifecycle, from concept phase to SOP.
* Develop and maintain the Functional Safety Plan, timelines, and work products.
* Ensure processes are followed and all safety artifacts are created and reviewed.
* Safety Analysis \& Concept Development
* Perform Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) and derive ASIL levels.
* Develop Functional Safety Concept (FSC) and Technical Safety Concept (TSC).
* Define safety goals, safety mechanisms, and safety requirements (FSR/TSR).
* Requirements Engineering
* Write, review, and maintain functional and technical safety requirements.
* Ensure bi\-directional traceability between requirements, design, implementation, and validation.
* Support system, hardware, and software teams to interpret and implement safety requirements.
* Hardware \& Software Safety
* Collaborate with hardware architects to define safety mechanisms for MCU, PMIC, watchdog, self\-tests, power domains, fault handling, etc.
* Support software teams in designing safety\-compliant drivers, boot, diagnostics, and monitoring logic.
* Review MCU safety manuals, safety architecture, and vendor documentation (e.g., Infineon Traveo II, NXP, Renesas).
* Safety Analysis \& Verification
* Conduct and review FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA, Dependent Failure Analysis.
* Calculate FIT rates, single\-point fault metrics, and latent fault metrics.
* Create safety validation plans and support unit/integration/system\-level testing.
* Audits, Assessments \& Compliance
* Prepare safety case documentation for customer and auditor reviews.
* Work with internal/external assessors (TÜV, Exida, OEM auditors).
* Support ASPICE, cybersecurity (ISO 21434\), and quality\-compliance alignment.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Provide training and guidance to development teams on ISO 26262 processes.
* Work directly with system architects, hardware designers, software teams, testing, quality, cybersecurity, and program management.
* Participate in design reviews and ensure safety considerations are incorporated early.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
**Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of ISO 26262 Part 2–12 and full safety lifecycle.
* Expertise in safety analyses: FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA.
* Understanding of safety architecture for MCUs, SoCs, and automotive ECUs.
* Experience with safety mechanisms: lockstep CPUs, watchdogs, ECC, BIST/MBIST, CRC, voltage monitoring, clock monitoring, safe states, etc.
* Experience with requirements management tools: DOORS, Polarion, Jama, etc.
* Working knowledge of embedded systems, microcontrollers, hardware design, and automotive software development.


**Domain Knowledge**
* Automotive electronics: clusters, body control, powertrain, ADAS, infotainment, or battery systems.
* Exposure to ASPICE, ISO 21434 (Cybersecurity), and OEM\-specific safety processes.
* Experience
* 5–15 years of experience in automotive embedded systems.
* Minimum 5\+ years in Functional Safety roles.
* Experience delivering at least one safety\-critical product to SOP.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Certified Functional Safety Engineer/Professional (TÜV, Exida).
* Experience with safety implementation on MCUs like Infineon Traveo II, NXP S32, Renesas R\-Car, TI Hercules.
* Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, or related engineering field.
* Experience with model\-based development (MATLAB/Simulink).


**Visteon Culture:** 
 If you thrive in a fast\-paced, organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability, and a growth mindset from its employees to thrive and stay ahead of the curve Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk\-taking, and continuous learning help us keep up with the ever\-changing landscape of our industry and be Market leaders. At Visteon you can be more.

title: Customer Support Engineer
description:
Technical Product Support Engineer
 



  





**Type of Work:** 
 Full\-time

 Chennai, India
 



  





 Kaleris is a private equity\-backed software company focused on supply chain optimization. We are hiring Technical Product Support Engineers to join our Global Customer Support team supporting Terminal Operating System products including N4, Master Terminal and Octopi.
 



  





 Role Purpose
 



 The Technical Product Support Engineer serves as a product expert for Kaleris/Navis solutions and works directly with customers to diagnose product\-related issues, answer functional and technical questions, and ensure successful use of the software. This role bridges customers, Product Management, Engineering, and Services teams through technical analysis and customer advocacy without performing software development or production operations activities.

* Gain expertise in product functionalities, configurations, and workflows across multiple modules through structured product training, internal documentation, knowledge bases, and hands\-on learning.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve customer\-reported issues related to product functionality, root\-cause\-analysis, workflows, configurations, business use cases and customer\-facing technical support.
* Own customer support cases from initial triage through resolution, ensuring timely communication, documentation, and follow\-up.
* Reproduce customer\-reported issues in test environments, isolate root causes, and determine whether issues are related to product defects, configuration, integrations, or customer processes.
* Analyze application logs, system artifacts, product behavior, and configuration data to identify probable causes and recommended actions.
* Answer customer questions using product documentation, case history, knowledge bases, release notes, and internal resources.
* Act as the voice of the customer by communicating product feedback, enhancement requests, and recurring issues to internal teams.
* Participate in a global support escalation rotation for critical business\-impacting product issues, focusing on investigation and resolution management rather than infrastructure operations.
* Engage with designated customer accounts through support reviews, issue discussions, project go\-live support, and service meetings.
* Apply strong analytical thinking and technical troubleshooting skills across multiple technologies and product areas.
* Learn and support new products, technologies, and service offerings.
* Work in shifts and collaborate with global teams as required.
* Travel occasionally and work extended hours when business needs require.



  





 What This Role Is Not
 


* Not a software development role or responsible for modifying product source code.
* Not a production or infrastructure operations support role.
* Not responsible for application deployments, release management, server administration, monitoring, or database administration.



  





 Requirements
 



  





 Education
 



 Engineering Degree (B.E/B.Tech ) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related disciplines (or) BCA and MCA full time, with CGPA 7\.5 or higher.
 



  





 Experience
 


* 2\-4 years of experience in Technical Product Support (Level 2 or 3\), Enterprise Software Support, Customer Support Engineering, or similar customer\-facing technical support roles supporting commercial software products.
* Knowledge of Navis SPARCS, Navis N4/XPS or experience in container terminal operations is an advantage.
* Experience primarily focused on production operations or infrastructure support is not aligned with this role.



  





 Technical Skills
 


* Strong analytical and technical troubleshooting skills across enterprise applications and technologies.
* Ability to learn complex software functionality and independently support customers across a broad range of features and use cases.
* Ability to read and interpret application logs, stack traces, XML configurations, and client\-server application behavior.
* Experience working with Java\-based enterprise applications, XML, Apache technologies, and client\-server architectures is preferred.
* Understanding of relational databases and web\-based enterprise solutions.
* Familiarity with Core Java or Groovy for troubleshooting and understanding application behavior is advantageous but not required. The role does not involve software development responsibilities.



  





 Soft Skills
 


* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong customer\-service orientation.
* Detail\-oriented, self\-motivated, and assertive communicator.
* Strong learning agility, leadership potential, time management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in global and virtual teams.

 As the Team Manager for Technical Writing at Epiroc, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the delivery of high\-quality technical documentation that supports the safe operation and maintenance of our advanced mining, earthmoving, and drilling equipment. Your leadership will be instrumental in driving the development of instruction manuals and standard operating procedures (SOPs) that are precise, user\-friendly, and aligned with product requirements.
   

  

 You will collaborate cross\-functionally with project offices, R\&D, and service operations teams to gather, refine, and incorporate critical product information. Using advanced Content Management Systems and Technical Information platforms, you will ensure the efficient publishing and timely communication of technical documents to our customers and stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the creation and maintenance of comprehensive technical manuals and SOPs for a broad range of equipment including drill rigs, loaders, and trucks, ensuring technical accuracy and compliance with engineering standards.
* Collaborate closely with internal teams such as R\&D, project offices, and field service to acquire and validate content for publication.
* Manage and optimize the use of content management systems and technology tools like Adobe InDesign, XMetaL, Oxygen, Teamcenter, and Schema ST4 to enable modular content creation and single\-sourcing for maximum reuse and consistency.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to innovate technical communication methods, reduce translation costs, simplify content complexity, and enhance overall documentation quality and customer experience.
* Regularly engage with customers to collect feedback on documentation usability and implement improvements that strengthen client relationships and satisfaction.
* Recruit, develop, and retain a skilled technical writing team by nurturing a motivated, collaborative, and high\-performance culture.
* Provide ongoing coaching, mentoring, and performance evaluations, fostering professional growth aligned with evolving business and technology trends.
* Define, implement, and refine internal standards, workflows, and best practices to enhance operational efficiency and deliverables quality.
* Monitor team performance through metrics and reporting tools, ensuring objectives related to quality, delivery timelines, and resource management are met consistently.
* Promote Epiroc’s core values including integrity, inclusivity, and open communication within your team and broader corporate community.


**Required Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum of 12 years of industrial experience specifically within mining, earthmoving, drilling equipment, or off\-road vehicle sectors.
* Extensive experience in structured authoring, modular content development, and enterprise\-level Content Management Systems delivering single\-source publishing solutions.
* Proven expertise in technical documentation methodologies including topic\-based authoring, minimalism in communication, DITA standards, and XML authoring tools such as XMetaL or Oxygen.
* Familiarity with Simplified Technical English to ensure clarity and global usability of documentation.
* Strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign), Teamcenter, and Schema ST4 for document management and production.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to translate complex technical and customer requirements into clear, actionable tasks.
* Demonstrated effective communication and leadership capabilities with experience managing multi\-disciplinary teams in dynamic, results\-driven environments.


**Desired Behaviors and Competencies**
* Highly enthusiastic and responsible with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to excel in a fast\-paced, pressure\-driven environment.
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to foster collaboration across diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills combined with a goal\-oriented and self\-motivated mindset.
* Adaptable, open\-minded, and receptive to new ideas, technologies, and working methods.
* Committed to continuous learning and professional development for oneself and the team.


**Why Join Us?**
 This role offers a unique opportunity to take full ownership of the technical documentation lifecycle within a leading company in the mining industry. You will lead a talented team and be empowered to innovate documentation processes and technologies, contributing directly to product safety, usability, and customer satisfaction. Epiroc fosters an inclusive, values\-driven culture where integrity, collaboration, and respect are paramount. Additionally, this position provides substantial opportunities for professional growth and skill enhancement aligned with industry advancements.
   

  

**About Epiroc**
 Epiroc is a global leader in mining and infrastructure equipment, dedicated to sustainable productivity and innovation. Our commitment to safety, ethics, and diversity creates a dynamic workplace where employees thrive and contribute to impactful projects that shape the future of mining technologies.
   

  

 Join us and be part of a culture that values your unique talents and supports your career journey.
   

  

**It all starts with people.** 
 The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.
   

  

 All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future.  Learn more at www.epiroc.com

description:
**About Two Minute Reports** 




  





 Two Minute Reports is a fast\-growing B2B SaaS platform that helps marketing agencies and businesses automate reporting by connecting data from multiple marketing channels into Google Sheets and Looker Studio. We serve customers worldwide and are focused on building the most efficient reporting solution for marketers and agencies.
 



  





 We are looking for a creative and highly curious
 **YouTube Scriptwriter \& Copywriter** 
 to help us create content that educates, engages, and converts our target audience.
 



 The primary focus of this role will be
 **YouTube scriptwriting** 
 , along with writing copy for email campaigns, LinkedIn, website pages, and other marketing channels.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 As a YouTube Scriptwriter \& Copywriter, you will be responsible for turning ideas, research, customer problems, and industry insights into compelling content.
 



  





 You will create YouTube scripts that capture attention, maintain curiosity, and communicate ideas clearly, while also developing marketing copy that connects with our target audience and drives action.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on role requiring strong research, writing, storytelling, and audience understanding.
 



  





**Key ResponsibilitiesYouTube Scriptwriting** 




  




* Research and develop YouTube topics relevant to marketers, agencies, SaaS companies, and business owners.
* Develop compelling video ideas, hooks, titles, and content angles.
* Write engaging YouTube scripts with strong openings, storytelling, and clear takeaways.
* Turn complex marketing, SaaS, reporting, and business concepts into simple and engaging content.
* Research competitors, industry trends, customer problems, and successful content.
* Use real examples, data, case studies, and customer insights to strengthen scripts.
* Continuously improve scripts based on audience engagement and video performance.
* Repurpose existing content into different formats and content channels.



  





**Copywriting** 




  




* Write email campaigns, sequences, and newsletters.
* Create LinkedIn posts and other social media content.
* Develop compelling headlines, hooks, CTAs, and product messaging.
* Create marketing copy around customer pain points, use cases, and product benefits.
* Support sales and marketing campaigns with persuasive messaging.
* Review and improve existing copy based on performance and feedback.



  





**Research \& Audience Understanding** 




  




* Understand our target audience, including marketing agencies, marketers, and business owners.
* Research customer pain points, challenges, objections, and motivations.
* Understand what makes a prospect pay attention, engage, and take action.
* Translate customer and market insights into better content and messaging.
* Stay updated on trends in SaaS, MarTech, digital marketing, agencies, and content.



  





**Required QualificationsMust Have** 




  




* Strong written and spoken English.
* Excellent storytelling and communication skills.
* Strong research and analytical abilities.
* Ability to write engaging and conversational content.
* Ability to simplify complex ideas and explain them clearly.
* Strong understanding of audience psychology, attention, and persuasion.
* Ability to understand customer pain points and translate them into compelling messaging.
* Ability to write both long\-form content and short\-form copy.
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to iterate based on feedback.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced startup environment.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience writing YouTube scripts or video content.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, MarTech, AdTech, analytics, or marketing.
* Experience creating content for marketers, agencies, or business audiences.
* Experience writing emails, sales messaging, or marketing campaigns.
* Experience working with customer\-facing or growth\-oriented teams.
* Understanding of content marketing, conversion copywriting, or marketing funnels.
* Familiarity with AI tools for research, ideation, and content creation.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* Someone who is genuinely curious about
 **why people buy, click, watch, and engage** 
 .
* Someone who can turn a basic idea into a compelling story.
* Someone who understands that good copy is about the audience, not just good grammar.
* Someone who can research a topic deeply and communicate the important parts simply.
* Someone who is comfortable taking feedback and rewriting until the content is strong.
* Someone who thinks about the business objective behind every piece of content.
* Someone who is willing to learn the product, market, and customers deeply.



  





  





**Why Join Two Minute Reports?** 




  




* Opportunity to create content for a growing global B2B SaaS company.
* Work directly with founders and the marketing team.
* Build content that reaches a global audience.
* Opportunity to develop expertise across YouTube, copywriting, SaaS, and marketing.
* Fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
* Significant learning and career growth opportunities.

title: Associate Engineer - Digital & Drw Mgmt
description:
**What’s The Role**
 Technical Asset Support (TAS) is a key enabler for the accelerated delivery of Shell’s Asset Management System and will help us to reach our ultimate potential in Downstream Manufacturing, Integrated Gas and Upstream. TAS provides high quality and cost\-competitive technical resources who are not physically present at site yet are an integral part of asset teams delivering value through end\-to\-end SEAM / AMS work processes.
   

  

 As an Associate Engineer \- Digital \& Drw Mgmt, you will support engineering document and drawing management in the energy industry by reviewing redline markups, updating and quality\-checking technical drawings and documents, and ensuring compliance with document control standards. It requires experience with AVEVA P\&ID, MicroStation, EDMS, and SharePoint, along with the ability to interpret P\&IDs, isometrics, and other engineering drawings, manage metadata, validate data quality, and support intelligent P\&ID conversion and maintenance activities.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Review red line markup (RLM) changes in technical drawings, collaborating with team members, incorporating revisions, and contributing to overall work quality. Work in EDMS (Doc Management tool).
* Proficient in interpreting and understanding corrections, redline markups, and updates across related engineering drawings.
* Proficient in AVEVA P\&ID as an end user with strong practical working experience.
* Ability to read, understand, and interpret P\&IDs, Isometrics, Plot Plans, and General Arrangement (GA) drawings.
* Strong knowledge of AVEVA P\&ID application, including object attributes, relationships, and validation checks.
* Generate and analyze engineering reports, line lists, equipment lists, valve lists, and other project deliverables from the AVEVA P\&ID database.
* Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve AVEVA P\&ID application issues related to drawing connectivity, database attributes, validation errors, and reporting inconsistencies.
* Experience in preparing engineering documentation, drawing evidence, and technical records to support Root Cause Analysis (Why\-Why Analysis) and incident investigations.
* Developed automated workflows and reports to enhance engineering productivity and data integrity.
* Experience working in critical assessment and quality review environments, ensuring high accuracy and compliance.
* Hands\-on experience in conversion projects from non\-intelligent (legacy) to intelligent P\&IDs, including data structuring and tagging.
* Ability to analyze, extract, and interpret reports generated from AVEVA P\&ID for quality control and data validation.
* Good understanding of engineering data consistency, tagging philosophy, and metadata management within P\&ID systems.
* Interpret and validate Process \& Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs) based on process engineering principles, plant operations, and maintenance requirements.
* Identify discrepancies between P\&IDs, PFDs, Isometrics, Cause \& Effect diagrams, and other engineering documents.
* Perform engineering data validation to ensure compliance with asset tagging standards, drawing standards, and engineering best practices.
* Understand process flow, equipment functions, piping systems, control philosophy, and instrumentation represented in P\&IDs.
* Analyze the impact of proposed changes on equipment, piping systems, instrumentation, and associated engineering data.


**What You Bring**
* A graduate engineering degree with 3\+ years of relevant industry standard experience in combination of Process, mechanical, instrumentation \& electrical disciplines.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during peak workloads and provide flexible support across related processes within team scope.
* Hands\-on experience with AVEVA P\&ID and MicroStation is mandatory.
* Performed data validation, consistency checks, and quality assurance of P\&ID deliverables.
* Support Team Leads with drawing\-related queries and technical support needs, including training site staff on software and request tools, and assisting with pilot tests and demonstrations.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to deliver analytical solutions are essential.
* Strong stakeholder management and time management skills are required.
* Candidates should demonstrate strong learning agility and a growth mindset.
* Excellent communication skills and a quick learner. Be a good team player. Ability to prioritize and ensure delivery of priorities for the area of responsibility. Flexible and adaptable to change, with a track record of demonstrating initiative, analytical capabilities and problem\-solving.
* Ability to apply engineering best practices, codes, and standards to identify issues, recommend improvements, and implement solutions.
* Excellent stakeholder management with business interface exposure
* Strong interpersonal leadership skills are critical due to the requirement for effective communication of complex issues across multiple offices and teams.
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple projects and programs simultaneously.
* Ability to independently, resourcefully, and creatively research and implement new solutions.
* Ability to engage and effectively communicate at all levels inside and outside Shell and within different cultural settings.
* Strong interpersonal skills, ability to challenge and ability to build internal and external relationships based on trust and to integrate across multiple functions.
* Competitive applicants will have a proven track record of delivery in Asset and/or Project.
* While the hubs will remain the core locations for SEAM, we will continue to use a distributed working model. This means that our preference is to appoint the best candidate for the job on local terms working virtually from their base country.
* This role does not require global travel but may require flexibility in working hours to support collaboration across time zones, influence stakeholders, and drive business performance. Such flexibility will be considered with sensitivity to diverse family circumstances.


**What We Offer**
 You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
   

  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values\-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.
